The study first mentioned the possibility that < Dhāraṇī of the Precious Casket Seal Enshrined (寶篋印陁羅尼) > published by Hǎi yànsi (海晏寺) instead of Hǎi zhēn si (海真寺) in 1152 as it was known before. It is estimated that the dhāraṇī was made based on the reference of ≪Beomseochongjijib (梵書摠持集)≫ published in 1150.There is the letter a(□) symbolizing Vairochana Buddha (毘盧遮那佛) at the center of < Dhāraṇī of the Precious Casket Seal Enshrined (寶篋印陁羅尼) >. According to the phrase that likened this dhāraṇī to “dhātū garbhe (胎藏界) to guard All Tathagatas” from the 40 phrases of dhāraṇī in ≪Dhāraṇī Sūtra of the Precious Casket Seal Enshrined (寶篋印陀羅尼經)≫, they placed < Dhāraṇī of the Precious Casket Seal Enshrined (寶篋印陁羅尼) > with the letter a(□) symbolizing Vairochana Buddha (毘盧遮那佛) at its center and made it into an icon embodying dhātū garbhe (胎藏界).In < Mahāpratisarā-dhāraṇī (隨求陀羅尼) >, the first 57 of its entire 1,978 Sanskrit characters mark the title dhāraṇī (陀羅尼), and they were followed by the dhāraṇī of 1,921 Sanskrit characters. The previous study reported that the mantra called < Unting The Karmic Knots Of Hundred lifetimes Dharani (解百生寃家陀羅尼) > was a Mindfulness Reciting - mantra (正念誦眞言) and an example of a ritual related to mantra recitation.

articles.title_kr: 한국 관음신앙의 영속성 연구
articles.title_en: A Study on the Permanence in the Avalokiteśvara Cult of Korean Buddhism
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 『삼국유사』에 수록된 관음설화(觀音說話)를 토대로 하여 한국 관음신앙(觀音信仰)의 영속성(永續性)을 구명(究明)하고자 하였다. 법화(法華)관련 전적(典籍)의 유입과 함께 관음신앙이 전래되었으며, 한국 고대관음신앙 양상의 근간이 되는 『삼국유사』의 관음설화를 텍스트로 하여 그 영속성을 살펴보고자 한다. 이에 『삼국유사』에 수록된 관음설화와 근대 고승 및 재가불자의 관세음보살 가피 사례를 분석하여 양자 간에 일관된 관음신앙의 영속성이 존재함을 밝혔으며, 이는 다음과 같다.첫째, 사찰의 창건과 관련된 관음주처(觀音住處)의 불교적 이상세계의 설정이다. 관세음보살은 한국불교 1,600년에 걸쳐 이 땅에 상주한다는 믿음 아래 중생들을 위한 자비행을 보여준다. 이와 같은 맥락 속에서 둘째, 관세음보살의 시현을 통한 구원(救援)이다. 이는 불자들이 신행을 통해 관세음보살을 체험하였고 관세음보살을 중생의 귀의처이자 의지처로 믿었기 때문이다. 끝으로 관세음보살은 승속의 구분 없이 중생의 아픔을 치유해주는 치병제생(治病濟生)의 역할을 담당해 왔다. 달리 말해 치병제생의 구원재(救援財)의 속성은 관음신앙의 전래 이후 지속적이자 굳건한 믿음으로 현재까지 전해오는 것으로 사료된다. 불교의 다양한 보살신앙 활동의 추세 속에서도 관음신앙이 중생들의 보편적·대중적 불교신행으로 자리 잡은 것은 바로 이와 같은 영속성에 있다고 논자는 생각한다.
articles.abstract_en: This thesis attempted to clarify the permanence of the Avalokiteśvara Cult based on the Gwaneum-narrative(觀音說話) contained in 『Samgugyusa(三國遺事)』. Along with the influx of Buddhist scriptures related to Beophwa(法華), Avalokiteśvara Cult was transmitted in Korea. Therefore, the permanence of the Gwaneum-narrative of 『Samgugyusa』, which is the basis of the aspect of the ancient Avalokiteśvara Cult in Korea, was examined as a text. Therefore, by analyzing the Buddhist personally experienced stories of the Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva of modern Buddhist venerable and lay Buddhists, it is intended to clarify that there is a consistent persistence of the Avalokiteśvara Cult between the two. Through this study, the following conclusions could be drawn.First, the Gwaneum Jucheo(觀音住處) related to the establishment of the Buddhist temple as the Buddhist ideal space. The Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva shows compassion for sentient beings by residing in this land for 1,600 years in Korean Buddhism. In this context, the second is Sihyeon(示顯) of the Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva as Buddhists have experienced the true spirit of the Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva through their devotionals, and the Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva has been believed to be the refuge and will of regeneration. Lastly, the Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva has played a role in both healing the pain and saving life of sentient beings as Chibyeong Jesaeng(治病濟生) without distinction between Sangha and lay Buddhists. In other words, it is believed that an important part of the permanence of the Avalokiteśvara Cult is a salvation material for both healing the pain and saving life of sentient beings, which has been passed down since the transmission of the Avalokiteśvara Cult and with a steady and solid faith. The commentator believes that it is such permanence that the Avalokiteśvara Cult has established itself as a universal and popular Buddhist deity of regeneration, despite the trend of various Buddhist activities of Bodhisattva faith.
keywords_en: the Permanence of the Avalokiteśvara Cult

articles.title_kr: 무라야마 지준(村山智順)의 1927년 저서『조선인의 사상과 성격(朝鮮人の思想と性格)』에 나타난 불교 관련 내용에 대한 비판적 재고
articles.title_en: A Critical Review of Buddhist-Related Content in Murayama Jizun's 1927 Book Thoughts and Characteristics of Koreans
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 조선총독부 촉탁이었던 무라야마 지준이 편집한 1927년『조선인의 사상과 성격』에 나타난 조선인의 정체성, 특히 조선불교에 대해서 그가 어떻게 왜곡해서 표현했는지 비판적 시각으로 재고하기 위함이다. 이 책에서 무라야마 지준은 조선인의 성격을 20가지로 분류하면서 부정적인 견해를 부각시켰고, 나아가 조선불교를 ‘걸식(乞食) 불교’라고 비하하기까지 하였다.이러한 그의 평가 이면에는 한반도 토착 종교의 정체성을 왜곡시켜서 그들의 식민통치의 정당성을 주장하려는 의도에서 비롯되었음은 자명하다. 불행히도 한 세기 전 일본인들이 한반도를 바라보았던 비뚤어진 시각은 단순한 과거에 존재했던 인식의 문제가 아니라, 오늘날 ‘조선총독부 건물 철거’, ‘한일호감도 조사 인식차’, ‘사도 광산의 유네스코 등재’, ‘위안부 부정과 소녀상 철거’ 문제 등에서도 여전히 나타나고 있는 현재 진행형의 인식이다.이에 본고에서 무라야마 지준이 폄하한 조선불교에 대한 인식이 역사적 사실과 전혀 부합하지 않음을 밝히면서, 조선불교가 정치적·사회적 역할을 나름대로 충실히 했음과 특히 조선 후기 불교 미술의 발전도 새삼 주목할 필요가 있었다. 결론적으로 말해 이 연구는 “역사는 과거와 현재, 그리고 미래의 끊임없는 대화”라는 E. H 카의 교훈을 반면교사 삼아, 일본의 거듭된 역사 왜곡과 날조를 바로잡을 수 있는 작은 밑돌의 연구 성과가 될 것으로 기대한다.
articles.abstract_en: This study aims to analyze how Murayama Jizun, a consultant for the Government- General of Korea during the Japanese colonial period (1920-1930s), distorted the identity of Koreans through a biased evaluation of Korean Buddhism in his book Thoughts and Character of Koreans. Murayama Jizun categorized Koreans into 20 personality traits, emphasizing negative characteristics, and disparaged Korean Buddhism as a “begging Buddhism.” Although he claimed that Korean Buddhism was in decline, this evaluation is inconsistent with historical facts. This research demonstrates that Korean Buddhism was deeply rooted in the lives of the people and played a significant role in national defense and the moral character of the population, as shown through examples of patriotic Buddhism. Through this study, we critically examine how Murayama Jizun's distorted assessment served to justify colonial rule by misrepresenting the identity of Koreans.This research reveals that Murayama Jizun's evaluation of Korean Buddhism in Thoughts and Character of Koreansdoes not align with historical facts. Moreover, it confirms that Korean Buddhism had significant political and social roles. The study also highlights the development of Buddhist art during the late Joseon period. The skewed perspectives that Japanese held towards Korea over a century ago are not merely issues of the past but continue to show a lack of historical reflection and repentance today. Such perspectives still surface in contemporary debates like the demolition of the Government-General building, differences in the results of the “Korea-Japan favorability” surveys, and the “Sado Mine” controversy.In this paper, I critically examine Murayama Jizun's distorted views, re-evaluate the social and political significance of Korean Buddhism, and scrutinize historical distortions while reconsidering the cultural and religious meaning of Korean Buddhism. Furthermore, I point out that Japan's distorted historical perception persists in the present and emphasize the need for Japan's historical reflection and repentance. I hope that this research contributes a new perspective to this field of study.

articles.title_kr: 간접화행이론으로 살펴본 화두참구
articles.title_en: Hwadu Chamgu(Koan Inquiry) Through the Theory of Indirect Speech Acts
articles.abstract_kr: The purpose of this paper is to understand the specificity of the hwadu through pragmatic language analysis that emphasizes the situational context between the speaker and the listener, and to schematize and examine the process of hwadu chamgu. To this end, we first looked at the relationship between Zen Buddhism and language, and it can be seen that while acknowledging the use of language, we aimed for a practice method that was not obsessed with language. Next, we looked at pragmatics and indirect speech act theory that break away from the existing semantic interpretation of hwadu and focus on the speaker's intention and situation. Through this, the hwadu was seen as examining the appropriateness of the context and speech situation for the subjective use of language between the speaker and the listener. Lastly, we applied Daehye Seonsa's hwadu chamgu process to an indirect speech act parallel processing model that schematizes the process of intention in an actual utterance. This is a linguistic methodology that examines the process of controlling the pre-consciousness and unconsciousness through the activities of the sixth consciousness. Through this, we hope that lively discussions about hwadu and linguistics will continue, and that proper understanding of hwadu will help in practical Ganhwaseon practice.
keywords_en: Indirect Speech Act Parallel Processing Model

articles.title_kr: 스코옌 컬렉션 산스끄리뜨어 대품반야경필사본 MS2627/4 기초조사(I)
articles.title_en: A Sanskrit Manuscript of the Larger Prajñāpāramitā in the Schøyen Collection: A Preliminary Study (1)
articles.abstract_kr: 스코옌 컬렉션(Schøyen Collection)은 노르웨이의 사업가이자 고문헌 수집가인 마틴 스코옌(Martin Schøyen, 1940-)에 의해서 수집된 약 20,450종의 필사본 및 고문헌 자료들을 통칭한다. 이 중엔 2세기에서 7세기 사이 인도 북서지역에서 기원한 5,000여개의 불교 사본과 7,000여개의 작은 필사본 조각들이 포함되어 있다. 이를 다루는 연구 프로젝트는 오슬로대 옌스 브로빅(Jens Braarvig), 스탠포드대 폴 해리슨(Paul Harrison), 뮌헨대 옌스 우버 하르트만(Jens-Uwe Hartmann) 등에 의해 1997년부터 지금까지 활발히 이어져오고 있으며, 그 결과물은 Buddhist Manuscripts in the Schøyen Collection ‘스코옌 컬렉션 불교 사본 연구’ 시리즈로 현재 4권까지 출판되었다.본 논문에서는 스코옌 컬렉션에 포함되어 있는 산스끄리뜨어 ‘대품반야경(Larger Prajñāpāramitā)’ 필사본 MS2627/4에 대한 사전조사 및 기초연구 결과 일부를 다루었다. 이에 의하면, 필사본의 제작연대는 약 6-7세기경으로 소급되고, 자작나무 껍질에 브라흐미 문자(길기트/바미얀 타입 I)로 쓰였으며, 약 30 x 7cm 크기의 폴리오 70-80장으로 이루어져 있다. 이 필사본 뭉치는 진흙, 먼지, 잉크 등으로 인해 각각의 폴리오가 붙어 있는 상태로 입수되었고, 현재 붙어 있는 낱장의 해체를 포함한 보존 처리 작업이 진행 중이다. 사용된 서체와 제작 방식의 유사성, 그리고 내용의 연관성으로 인해 네 개의 뭉치MS2627/4-1, 2, 3, 4) 중 최소한 세 개가 원래 하나의 필사본에서 분리된 것으로 볼 수 있는 여지가 많았다. 이 자료는 현존하는 산스크리트어 대품반야경 필사본 중에서 시기적으로 매우 앞설 뿐만 아니라 남아 있는 분량도 적지 않기 때문에, 향후 대품반야경 문헌군의 발전 및 전승 과정 연구에 중요한 자료가 될 것으로 판단되었다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper aims to provide preliminary information on a Sanskrit Larger Prajñāpāramitā manuscript included in the Schøyen Collection, specifically indexed as MS2627/4. A preliminary investigation of the four bundles of Larger Prajñāpāramitā manuscripts (MS2627/4-1, 2, 3, 4) reveals that these bundles were written in the 6th-7th centuries on birch bark using the Brāhmī script (Gilgit/Bamiyan Type I). The material consists of 70-80 folios, each measuring approximately 30 x 7 cm. Due to mud, dust, or ink, the folios are stuck together, and preservation work, including the separation of the stuck folios, is currently in progress. Based on the similarity of the script and production method, as well as the continuity of the content, it is highly likely that at least three of the bundles (MS2627/4-2, 3, 4) were originally part of a single manuscript that was later separated. The investigation shows that this manuscript is not only one of the earliest surviving Sanskrit Larger Prajñāpāramitā manuscripts but also retains a significant amount of text that provides access to different readings from other available sources, making it a crucial resource for future research on the development and transmission of the Larger Prajñāpāramitā literature.

articles.title_kr: 오대산 부채 문제와 봉찬기도의 역사
articles.title_en: The Debt Problem of Mt. Odae and the History of Bongchan Prayer
articles.abstract_kr: 1920년대 중반에 촉발된 오대산 부채 문제는 포교와 사업이라는 새로운 변화가 한국불교에 초래한 가장 큰 규모의 사건이다. 부채 문제의 해결 과정에서 조선총독부가 개입하고 월정사의 주류세력에 변화가 이는 등 다양한 변수들이 발생했다.본 고는 오대산 부채 문제의 발생과 변동 상황을 정리하고, 이의 해결 과정으로서 한암이 주도한 봉찬회와 봉찬기도에 관해 정리했다. 이를 통해서, 오대산 부채 문제의 배경이 되는 강릉포교당의 건립, 그리고 문제의 핵심인 관동권업주식회사의 설립과 부채의 증대 과정을 이해해 보게 된다.또 부채 문제의 해결 과정에서 월정사의 주류로 부각하는 이종욱과, 이종욱이 오대산의 안정을 위해 모셔 온 한암의 관계 등이 분명해진다. 또 한암의 주도로 오대산의 안정과 쇄신 및 부채 문제 해결책이기도 한 봉찬회와 봉찬기도에 대한 부분도 명확한 이해가 도출된다. 특히 본 고에서는 봉찬회 취지문의 작성자가 한암일 것이라는 점과 봉찬 기도를 통해 부채 문제가 마무리된다는 점을 새롭게 규명해 보았다.
articles.abstract_en: The debt problem of Mt. Odae, which arose in the mid-1920s, was the largest-scale  brought about by new changes in missionary work and business in Korean Buddhism. In the process of resolving the debt problem, various variables occurred, such as the intervention of the Japanese Government-General of Korea and the change in the mainstream power of Wolseongsa Temple.This study reviews the occurrence and changes in the Odaesan debt problem, as well as the role of Bongchanhoe meeting and Bongchan prayer(奉讚祈禱) led by Hanam(漢巖) as a solution to the problem. Through this, we can understand the background of the Odaesan debt such as establishment of the Gangneung missionary hall, the establishment of the Gwangdong Geunneup Corporation, the core of the problem, and the process of increasing debt.In the process of resolving the debt problem, becomes clear the relationship between Lee Jong-wook, who stood out as the mainstream of Woljeongsa Temple, and Hanam, who was invited to Odaesan by Lee Jong-wook for the stability of Woljeongsa Temple. In addition, a clear understanding is derived on the Bongchanhoe and Bongchan Prayer, which were led by Hanam to stabilize and renew Odaesan Temple and to resolve the debt problem. In particular, this study newly shows that the writer of the prospectus for the Bongchanhoe was Hanam and that the debt issue was resolved through the Bongchan prayer.

articles.title_kr: 수까 자따까와 마하바라따 앵무새 에피소드의서사구조 비교연구
articles.title_en: A Comparative Study of the Narrative Structure of the Suka-jataka and the Parrot Episode of the Mahabharata
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 불교의 자따까와 힌두교의 마하바라따 텍스트에서 상호연관성이 높은 것으로 평가되는 ‘앵무새 자따까’ 두 편과 마하바라따의 ‘앵무새 에피소드’를 대조분석한다. 인도의 고대 우화를 차용한 두 장르는 공통적 출처의 서사를 자체적 각색과정을 거쳐 독자적인 종교문헌으로 발전시킨다. 두 문헌군의 내용과 구조적 차이점을 살펴보기 위하여 MJ와 CJ의 원전을 자따까의 삼중 플롯 구조로 해석한다. 이어서 마하바라따의 앵무새 에피소드와 줄거리, 등장인물, 상징 등과 비교한 후 주요한 덕목을 근거로 자따까와의 사상적 상이함을 순차적으로 제시한다. 각 서사의 화자인 붓다와 비슈마가 교설한 동물서사가 불교의 보살과 힌두교의 아뜨만, 친구와의 우정과 왕의 다르마로 이상화하는 과정도 고찰한다. 이를 통하여 앵무새왕이 구비한 미덕의 탁월함이 불교의 수행자와 힌두교의 왕에게 적용되어 두 종교의 윤리적 가치로 승화되도록 유도하는 서사의 골간과 그 진정한 가치를 밝히고자 한다.
articles.abstract_en: This study compares and analyzes the two ‘Suka(parrot) Jatakas’, which are considered highly interrelated in the Buddhist Jataka and Hindu ‘Parrot Episode’ of the Mahabharata. The two genres, which borrow from ancient Indian fables, develop narratives from common sources into independent religious literature through their own adaptation process. In order to examine the content and structural differences between the two groups of literature, the original texts of MJ and CJ are interpreted as the triple plot structure of the Jataka. Then, after comparing the Parrot Episode of the Mahabharata with its plot, characters, and symbols, the philosophical differences from the Jataka are presented sequentially based on major virtues. The process in which the animal fables taught by the narrators of the narrative, Buddha and Bhishma, are idealized as the Bodhisattva of Buddhism, the Atman of Hinduism, friendship(mitta) with friends, and the Dharma of the king is also examined. Through this, we aim to reveal the narrative framework and its true value, which lead to the excellence of the virtues possessed by the Sukaraja(Parrot King) being applied to Buddhist practitioners and Hindu kings, thereby sublimating them into the ethical values ​​of the two religions.

articles.title_kr: ‘식(識)’을 바탕으로 한 불교심리학의 ‘의식(consciousness)’ 연구
articles.title_en: A Study of ‘Consciousness’ in Buddhist Psychology based on the Concept of ‘Viññāṇa(識)’
articles.abstract_kr: This study examines how consciousness should be defined and understood in Buddhist psychology based on viññāṇa. Psychology is the study of the ‘subjective mind of an organism’, and this is only possible through an understanding of ‘consciousness’. In Buddhist psychology, The basic function of ‘consciousness’ is to know objects. Consciousness can be divided into “sensory consciousness,” which receives external stimuli through the sensory organs, and “reflective consciousness,” which knows all the mental operations that take place in the mind. In the context of the Twelve Links of Dependent Origination, the formula can be understood as a “stream of consciousness. By “stream of consciousness,” we mean the current that sustains the conscious state of this life and makes human conscious experience possible. It also refers to the connection between past lives and this life through the stream of consciousness. However, it does not indicate that consciousness is the subject of reincarnation.

articles.title_kr: 고구려 도교의 종교철학적 기반과정치적 수용 맥락의 이중주
articles.title_en: Dualism between the Religious and Philosophical Foundations and the Context of its Political Acceptance of Goguryeo Taoism
articles.abstract_kr: 이 글은 고구려 도교에 대한 역사적 자료 및 도교관련 연구 성과를 수렴하여, 고구려에서의 도교 수용의 과정과 종교성 문제를 검토한 후 도교 수용의 배경과 종교철학적 기반의 문제 및 도교 수용의 정치적 컨텍스트(context) 문제에 관하여 단계별로 검토해 본 것이다.고구려에서는 영류왕 때 처음 도교가 국가적 차원에서 수용될 즈음 이미 오두미교가 전파되어 큰 영향력을 미치고 있었다. 이것이 직간접적인 토대가 되어 고구려에 도교가 공식적으로 자리를 잡는 데 이바지했을 것임을 부정하기 어렵다. 도교와 함께 고구려에 전파된 노자의 󰡔도덕경󰡕에 대한 이해도 이 무렵 크게 증진되었을 것임이 분명하다. 특히 보장왕 때가 되면 연개소문에 의한 도교 진흥책이 크게 활성화되면서 도교는 국가종교로서의 위상을 갖추게 된다.한편 종교와 윤리적 방법을 기초로 한 종교철학적 기반 위에 수용된 고구려 도교는 고유의 신도 및 신선사상의 종교적 내재성 위에 틀을 잡고 착근된 성격이 있다. 그런데 연개소문에 의해 장려된 도교의 종교성 문제는 생각만큼 단순하지 않다는 점이 문제이다. 이 글은 이 점을 주목하고, 고구려 도교가 종교성이란 텍스트를 표면에 내세우면서도 그 텍스트 이면에 자리 잡고 있던 또 하나의 정치성의 맥락을 자신의 컨텍스트적 요소로 삼아 전개되었다는 점을 확인해 보고자 한 의의가 있다.
articles.abstract_en: This article collects historical data on Taoism in Goguryeo and research results related to Taoism, examines the process of accepting Taoism and issues of religiosity in Goguryeo, and then discusses the background of the acceptance of Taoism, issues of religious and philosophical foundation, and political context issues of the acceptance of Taoism step by step.In Goguryeo, when Taoism was first accepted at the national level during the reign of King Yeongnyu, Wudoumijiao (五斗米敎) had already spread and had a great influence. It is difficult to deny that this would have directly or indirectly laid the foundation and contributed to the official establishment of Taoism in Goguryeo. It is evident that the understanding of Lao Tzu's Tao Te Ching, which was spread to Goguryeo along with Taoism, was also greatly improved around this time. In particular, during the reign of King Bojang, the promotion of Taoism by Yeongaesomun was greatly activated, and Taoism acquired the status of a national religion.On the other hand, Goguryeo Taoism, which was accepted on the basis of religious philosophy based on religious and ethical methods, has the character of being framed and rooted on the religious internality of unique Shintoism and Immortal thought. However, the problem with the Taoist religiosity promoted by Yeongaesomun is that it is not as simple as one might think. The purpose of this article is to focus on this point and confirm that Goguryeo Taoism was developed by using the context of politics behind the text as its contextual element while putting the text of religion on the surface.

articles.title_kr: 서산 보원사지(普願寺址) 오층석탑사리장엄(舍利莊嚴) 고찰
articles.title_en: A Study on the Sarira Relics of the Five-Story Pagoda at the Boweonsa Temple Site in Seosan
articles.abstract_kr: The Five-Story Stone Pagoda of Bowonsa Temple Site in Seosan revealed a complete set of reliquaries during its dismantling and repair process in 1968. These reliquaries consist of a gilt-bronze outer case, an inner case, a green glass reliquary bottle, and steatite miniature pagodas. Particularly notable are the inscriptions of the Yeonki Beopsong (Verses on Dependent Arising) and the depictions of a bodhisattva and a monk on the outer case, which stand out as unique examples in East Asian Buddhist cultural studies. This study focuses on analyzing the reliquaries’ artistic craftsmanship, Buddhist doctrinal significance, and aesthetic design to elucidate their production period and historical context.The outer case holds significant meaning in its Yeonki Beopsong inscriptions and iconographic elements. The Yeonki Beopsong, a concise summary of Buddhist teachings, is linked to the sutras translated by the monk Uich’ŏng, illustrating its transmission from late Unified Silla to early Goryeo. Furthermore, the depiction of the bodhisattva and the monk is interpreted as symbolizing a scene of either receiving a prophecy (suji) or receiving the Dharma (subŏp). Its stylistic features, resembling those of the bodhisattva image in the Avatamsaka Sutra illustrations housed in the Leeum Museum, are indicative of late 9th to early 10th-century characteristics. The inner case, adorned with Four Heavenly Kings and pearl-like bead patterns, showcases intricate decorative techniques that reflect the evolution of metalwork styles from Unified Silla to early Goryeo.Beyond serving as mere offerings, these reliquaries provide critical insights into the production period of the pagoda and its significance in Buddhist art. The Five-Story Stone Pagoda of Bowonsa Temple Site is recognized as a transitional masterpiece that inherits and develops the stone pagoda traditions of late Silla and early Goryeo. While scholars generally date its construction to early Goryeo, some argue for its origin in late Unified Silla. The composition and craftsmanship of the reliquaries represent a synthesis of Silla and Goryeo stylistic elements, marking them as products of a transitional era. Notably, the Yeonki Beopsong inscription on the metal outer case, a rarity in East Asian Buddhist history, holds exceptional research value.

articles.title_kr: 극초기 우빠니샤드의 loka(세상)와 심리공간적 이원론- 인도철학이 현실적 위기에 무관심하게 된 기원을 찾아 -
articles.title_en: Loka and Psychospatial Dualism in the Earliest Upaniṣads
articles.abstract_kr: 인도철학이 현실적 위기 문제에 무관심한 경향이 있다고 평가된 것은 어제오늘의 일이 아니다. 저러한 평가의 근거 중 하나는, 인도철학이 현상계에 대해 중요한 가치를 부여하지 않음으로써 현실적이거나 세속적인 문제를 소홀히 하기 때문이라는 것이다. 그렇다면, 이 근거는 도대체 어디에서 기원하는 것일까? 저러한 평가의 정당성과는 무관하게 이 근거는 인도철학의 어디에서 그 기원을 찾아볼 수 있을까? 이 글은 그 기원을 찾는 것의 일환으로 ‘이상세계’(저 세상)와 대비하여 ‘현실세계’(이 세상)를 평가절하하는 고대인도의 공간적 이원론에 주목한다. 극초기 우빠니샤드에 등장하는 ‘loka’(세상)라는 개념을 분석함으로써 인도철학이 바로 그 기원에서부터 물리적이고 심리적인 두 가지 종류의 공간적 이원론을 공고하게 형성했다는 점을 밝히고, 특히 우빠니샤드 시대부터 심리공간적 이원론이 이미 인도철학의 주류로 정초되었다는 점을 밝히고자 한다.이 글을 통해 제시되는 몇 가지 주요한 사항은 다음과 같다. 첫째, 극초기 우빠니샤드는 브라흐마나의 우주관과 ‘loka’ 개념을 계승하지만 대체로 ‘이 세상’과 ‘저 세상’이라는 2개의 공간으로 이원화된 세계관을 보여준다. 둘째, 극초기 우빠니샤드는 구원(해방)의 세상을 심리적이고 일상적인 영역으로 더욱 확장함으로써 ‘더 나은 세상’의 확장이라고 볼 수 있는 ‘저 세상’의 확장을 이룬다. 셋째, 극초기 우빠니샤드의 이원론은 ‘구원론적(가치론적) 이원론의 특성을 가진 공간적 이원론’이라고 명명될 수 있으며, 더 세부적으로는 제의의 내부화에 따라 세상의 내부화가 야기됨으로써 구원의 공간이 심리적으로 존재하는 ‘심리공간적 이원론’이다. 넷째, 극초기 우빠니샤드에서 ‘더 나은 세상’을 얻기 위한 수단인 제의, 명상, 지식은 이원론의 양상을 매우 복합적인 것으로 만드는데, 그중에서 아뜨만에 대한 지식은 심리공간적 이원론의 정수라고 할 만하다.
articles.abstract_en: It is not a new thing that Indian philosophy has been evaluated as being indifferent to realistic crisis issues. One of the reasons for such evaluation is that Indian philosophy neglects realistic or secular issues by not giving significant value to the phenomenal world. So, where on earth does this reason come from? Regardless of the justification of such evaluation, where in Indian philosophy can the origin of this reason be found? This article focuses on the spatial dualism of ancient India, which devalues ​​the ‘real world’ (this world) in contrast to the ‘ideal world’ (the other world), as one of the ways to find its origins. By analyzing the concept of ‘loka’ (the world) that appears in the earliest Upaniṣads, it is intended to reveal that Indian philosophy has firmly formed two types of spatial dualism, physical and psychological, from its very origins, and in particular, that psychospatial dualism has already become established as the mainstream of Indian philosophy since the Upaniṣad era.Here are some key points that are presented in this article. First, the earliest Upaniṣads inherit the cosmology of the Brāhmaṇas and the concept of ‘loka’, but they generally show a worldview that is dualized into two spaces, ‘this world’ and ‘the other world’. Second, the earliest Upaniṣads further expand the world of salvation (liberation) into the psychological and everyday realm, thereby achieving an expansion of ‘the other world’ that can be seen as an expansion of the ‘better world’. Third, the dualism of the earliest Upaniṣads can be called ‘spatial dualism with the characteristics of soteriological dualism’, and more specifically, it is a ‘psychospatial dualism’ in which the space of salvation exists psychologically as the interiorization of the world occurs according to the interiorization of ritual. Fourth, in the earliest Upaniṣads, ritual, meditation, and knowledge as means to attain a ‘better world’ create a very complex aspect of dualism, and among these, the knowledge of Ātman can be said to be the essence of psychospatial dualism.

articles.title_kr: 불교적 관점에서 바라본 백제금동대향로 - 『경률이상(經律異相)』과 불경고사화(佛經故事畵)를 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: Baekje Gilt-Bronze Incense Burner Interpreted from a Buddhist Perspective: Focus on the Jing-lu-yixiang and the Paintings Originated in the Buddhist Stories
articles.abstract_kr: After the discovery in 1993, much research has been published on the Baekje Gilt-Bronze Incense Burner (百濟金銅大香爐). It is believed that the incense burner reflects various religions such as Confucianism (儒敎), Buddhism (佛敎), and Taoism (道敎). This interpretation is based on the identification of the bird at the top of the Baekje Gilt-Bronze Incense Burner as a phoenix (鳳凰) and the five musicians as figures related to Confucianism or Taoism. However, it is presumed that prior to the 6th-7th century when this incense burner is estimated to have been made, even within the Chinese Buddhist community, there was a consistent stance asserting ‘Buddhism is superior to Taoism and Confucianism’. Moreover, given that this incense burner was discovered at a Buddhist temple site (寺址), it is strongly suggested that the Baekje Gilt-Bronze Incense Burner should be interpreted from a Buddhist perspective.The bird on the top of the incense burner is characterized by holding a Maṇi-jewel (如意珠) under its neck. So, this bird can be interpreted as a Garuḍa (金翅鳥). Additionally, I believe it is reasonable to interpret the depicted mountain on the incense burner as Sumeru (須彌山). So this paper explores the references to ‘Jing-lu-yixiang (經律異相)’, which could have been consulted during the production of the incense burner. This document was compiled by the order of Emperor Wu of the Liang Dynasty (梁武帝). Considering his influence, there is a high likelihood that this book was transmitted to Baekje. Moreover, within the mountains depicted on the incense burner, various images are carved, resembling the depiction of ‘Jataka Painting (本生圖)’ or ‘the paintings originated in the Buddhist Stories(佛傳圖)’ found in the Buddhist Cave Temple (石窟寺院) of Central Asia. Therefore, I examine this images as a comparative reference. Based on these points, upon examining the icons on the incense burner, it is believed that the Baekje Gilt-Bronze Incense Burner represents Buddhist imagery.
keywords_en: the paintings depicting stories of Buddha’s past life found in Buddhist scriptures

articles.title_kr: 법화·천태사상에서 바라본 불교문화재 인식과 활용
articles.title_en: A Study on Recognition and Utilization of Buddhist Cultural Assets from the View of Dharma-Flower and Tiantai Thoughts
articles.abstract_kr: In this article, I will apply it to the recognition and utilization of buddhist cultural properties based on Dharma-flower and Tiantai thoughts. Chapter Ⅱ examines the contents applicable to the recognition of buddhist cultural assets among Dharma-flower and Tiantai thoughts. First, it is the metaphor of medicinal herbs in lotus sutra. This parable is to say that sentient beings accept the teachings of the single buddha-vehicle differently according to their religious capacity. And this can be applied to the recognition of buddhist cultural assets. It is said that people of various religious capacity have different attitudes to seeing and reacting to buddhist cultural assets around them. Second, it is the contents of never despising bodhisattva chapter. Here, it is said that never despising bodhisattva worships everyone because everyone has the potential to become a Buddha in the future. If this content is also applied to the recognition of buddhist cultural assets, it is a position that the surrounding objects are likely to become buddhist cultural assets in the future, so we do not neglect any of us. Third, it is three thousand thoughts in single thought(一念三千說). This means that the human heart holds infinite possibilities. If this is applied to the recognition of buddhist cultural assets, the position will be that there is a possibility that surrounding objects will also be recognized as buddhist cultural assets in the future. Fourth, it is three insight in one thought(一心三觀). This refers to emptiness, nominal existence(假有), and middle way. If this is applied to the recognition of buddhist cultural assets, it is a position to look buddhist cultural assets from a balanced point of view, that is, in the context of middle way. ChapterⅢ examines the contents applicable to the use of buddhist cultural assets among Dharma-flower and Tiantai thoughts. First, it is the contents of teacher of the dharma chapter. Here, it is said that in order to spread lotus sutra widely, the buddhist monk needs four things, including the spirit of patience. If this is applied to the utilization of buddhist cultural assets, it is necessary to have a spirit of patience  that can overcome the indifference of those around us in order to widely publicize and disseminate buddhist cultural assets. Second, ten objects-ten vehicle meditation(十境十乘觀法) is a specific method of practice in Tiantai zong. Ten objects are the object of śamatha and vipaśyanā, and  ten vehicle meditation refers to the ten methods of practicing śamatha and vipaśyanā. If ten objects is applied to the use of buddhist cultural assets, it will be to identify and prepare in advance various problems that may arise when trying to utilize buddhist cultural assets. And if ten vehicle meditation is applied to the use of buddhist cultural assets, it means that buddhist cultural assets must be used in the strict manner as if they were practicing.
articles.abstract_en: 이 글에서는 법화사상과 천태사상의 내용을 불교문화재의 인식과 활용에 적용해본다. Ⅱ장에서는 법화와 천태사상 가운데 불교문화재의 인식에 적용할 수 있는 내용에 대해 알아본다. 첫째, 『법화경』의 ｢약초유품｣의 비유이다. 이 비유는 중생이 근기에 따라 일승의 가르침을 다르게 수용하고 있음을 말하는 것이다. 그런데 이 내용을 불교문화재의 인식에 적용할 수 있다. 여러 근기의 사람이 주변의 불교문화재를 보고 반응하는 태도도 각기 다르다는 것이다. 둘째, ｢상불경보살품｣의 내용이다. 여기서는 상불경보살이 모든 사람이 미래에 부처가 될 가능성이 있는 존재이므로 예배드린다고 한다. 이 내용도 불교문화재의 인식에 적용하면, 주변의 사물도 미래에 불교문화재가 될 가능성이 있으므로 어느 것 하나도 소홀하게 대하지 않는다는 입장이 된다. 셋째, 천태의 일념삼천설이다. 이는 사람의 한 마음은 무한한 가능성이 간직하고 있다는 말이다. 이것을 불교문화재의 인식에 적용하면, 주변의 사물도 미래에는 불교문화재로 인정받을 가능성이 있다는 입장이 될 것이다. 넷째, 천태의 일심삼관이다. 이는 공, 가유(假有), 중도(中道)를 말하는 것이다. 이것을 불교문화재 인식에 적용하면, 불교문화재를 균형잡힌 시각, 곧 중도의 맥락으로 보아야한다는 입장이 된다. Ⅲ장에서는 법화사상과 천태사상 가운데 불교문화재의 활용에 적용할 수 있는 내용에 대해 살펴본다. 첫째, ｢법사품｣의 내용이다. 여기서는 법사는 『법화경』을 널리 전하기 위해서 인욕의 마음을 포함한 4가지가 필요하다고 한다. 이것을 불교문화재의 활용에 적용하면, 불교문화재를 널리 알리고 전파하기 위해서는 주위의 무관심을 이겨낼 수 있는 인욕의 마음 등이 필요하다는 것이 된다. 둘째, 십경십승관법은 천태종의 구체적 수행방법이다. 십경은 지관의 대상이 되는 10가지 경계를 말하는 것이고, 십승관법은 지관 수행을 하는 10가지 방법을 말하는 것이다. 십경을 불교문화재의 활용에 적용하면, 불교문화재를 활용하고자 할 때 생길 수 있는 여러 가지 문제점을 미리 파악하고 준비하는 것이 될 것이다. 그리고 십승관법을 불교문화재의 활용에 적용하면, 수행을 하듯이 엄밀한 태도로 불교문화재를 활용해야 한다는 것이 된다.

articles.title_kr: 근대 한국불교에서 ‘세계종교’ 및 ‘종교의 본질’ 담론 - 1910~1940년대 불교잡지에 나타난 틸레, 슐라이어마허,그리고 “지·정·의” 범주 -
articles.title_en: Discourses on ‘World Religion’ and ‘Essence of Religion’ in Modern Korean Buddhism - Tiele, Schleiermacher, and “knowing, feeling, and willing” Categories in Buddhist Magazines from the 1910s to the 1940s
articles.abstract_kr: 이 글은 근대 한국불교계에 등장한 ‘종교의 본질’과 ‘세계종교’ 담론에 코르넬리우스 틸레의 종교이론, 일본을 통해 전해온 “지·정·의” 담론, 그리고 슐라이어마허의 종교론이 주요한 이론적 근거로 작동하고 있음을 밝히고자 한다. 틸레의 종교이론은 열등종교와 고등종교라는 진화론적 분류체계와 ‘세계종교(보편적 종교)’ 범주의 창안을 특징으로 한다. “지·정·의” 담론은 근대 일본에서 문학·과학·철학 등의 분과 형성과 더불어 종교의 영역을 정립하는 데 이론적 근거로 활용되던 것으로, 근대 한국불교계에서도 종교가 “지·정·의” 가운데 어디에 속하는지를 규명하는데 많은 기여를 하였다. 이 때 개신교 자유주의신학의 정립자로 불리는 슐라이어마허의 종교론이 종교가 지·정·의 범주 가운데 “정”의 영역에 귀속되는 데 큰 영향을 주었다.이와 같은 종교담론들은, 한국 불교계가 근대문화의 유입으로 종교의 영역이 새롭게 설정되고 있음을 자각하고 불교를 그 영역 안에 배치하기 위한 여러 논리를 개발했음을 의미한다. 논의의 핵심에는 종교의 본질, 종교에서 불교의 위치, 불교와 종교 범주와의 관계가 필수적인 것으로 자리잡고 있다. 이 과정에서 서양의 불교학과 종교학이 중요한 역할을 한 것은 물론, 이 담론들의 준거점이 되고 있다. 불교학과 종교학이라는 비교적 역사가 길지 않고 그 역시 근대의 산물이기도 한 이들 학문에 따라 근대불교계는 전근대의 불교세계와 다른 풍경을 구성하게 되었다. 이들로 인해 한국불교에서도 근대적 사고가 가능해졌으며 모더니티를 부여받게 되었다. 1910년대부터 불교잡지에 등장한 근대적 의미의 학술적 종교담론들은 주로 일본에 유학했던 유학생들을 통해 빠르게 한국으로 유입된 것이었다. 그 결과 한국불교계는 근대 유럽의 ‘종교’ 담론의 자장 속에 포섭되었고, 근대 이전에는 볼 수 없었던 새로운 종교관의 형성에 동참하게 되었다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines three major theories of religion that provided foundational frameworks for discussions on ‘the essence of religion’ and ‘world religion’ in modern Korean Buddhism: first, Cornelius Tiele’s religious theory; second, the discourse on “knowing, feeling, and willing” transmitted through Japan; and lastly, Friedrich Schleiermacher’s theory of religion. Tiele’s theory is notable for its evolutionary classification of religions into inferior and higher types and its introduction of the concept of ‘world religion (universal religion).’ The “knowing, feeling, and willing” discourse, prominent in modern Japan, helped define the boundaries of religion alongside the development of literature, science, and philosophy. Korean Buddhists actively engaged with this framework to understand how religion fit within these categories. Schleiermacher’s theory, a significant influence in Protestant liberal theology, emphasized the importance of religion within the realm of “feeling.” These discourses reflect how modern cultural influences reshaped the concept of religion, prompting the Korean Buddhist community to develop arguments that positioned Buddhism within this new framework. Central themes included defining the essence of religion, Buddhism’s place within the broader religious landscape, and its relationship to the wider category of religion. The influence of Western Buddhist studies and religious studies was crucial in this process, providing key reference points that helped distinguish the modern Korean Buddhist experience from its pre-modern past. As relatively new fields and products of the modern era, Western Buddhist studies and religious studies facilitated the adoption of contemporary perspectives within Korean Buddhism, enabling Korean Buddhists to embrace modernity. The academic religious discourses in the modern sense that appeared in Korean Buddhist magazines from the 1910s were quickly introduced to Korea, mainly through students who had studied abroad in Japan. As a result, modern Korean Buddhism was absorbed into the broader sphere of ‘religious’ discourses shaped by modern European thought, contributing to the emergence of a new religious perspective that had not existed before the modern era.

articles.title_kr: 茶禪一味가 한국 禪茶에 미친 영향
articles.title_en: A Study on the Origins of the Concept of Daseon Ilmi in Korean Zen Tea Culture
articles.abstract_kr: This paper examines the origins and developmental processes of the concept of daseon ilmi(茶禪一味) within the history of Chinese tea culture, focusing on its influence on Korean Seoncha from a historical perspective.To this end, the study explores the close relationship between tea and Zen Buddhism, particularly centered on Gangseo Castle. The foundational philosophy that elevated the act of tea drinking into an everyday practice of enlightenment lies in Mazu’s doctrine of Ordinary mind is the Way The Zen koan, Have a cup of tea Huatous from Master Zhao Zhou, which represents Mazu's philosophy, became always a drank tea in Zen daily life. This eventually led to the emergence of the term daseon ilmi by Won Oh Geuk Geun.The origins of daseon ilmi in Korean Seoncha can be traced from two perspectives. First, the Gangseo Castle of China, which had the greatest influence on Korean tea culture, saw the concurrent introduction and development of Zen and tea. First, the transmission of Mazu’s tea tradition to Silla and Second, two theories are explored: the connection of Mazu’s Seoncha to the Linji Yixuan tradition of China. The latter included the dharma lineage of Seogogcheonggong, which led to the tea lineage at Daedunsa Temple. The study further examines the daseon ilmi philosophy as represented in the tea practices of Cheongheo, the initiator of the tea culture at Haenam Daeheungsa Temple, along with the 12th-generation monk Yeondam Yuil and the 13th-generation monk Choeui Eui-soon.In identifying the origins of daseon ilmi in Korean Seoncha, the study confirms the deep connections between the Zen lineage transmission, the meditation sites of Korean monks who founded the Nine Seon Schools during the Silla period, and Korean tea culture. It also observes how the relationships among these Zen monks were reflected in the acceptance, development, and inheritance of the Zen tradition. Furthermore, it highlights how the traditional Zen lineage of the Linji Yixuan school was transmitted to the tea saint Choeui and flourished as the tea culture of Daeheungsa Temple.

articles.title_kr: 도원의 ｢山水經｣과 중국 산수화의 관련성 연구
articles.title_en: A Study on the Relationship Between Dao Yuan's ｢Sansugyeong｣ and Chinese Sansuhwa
articles.abstract_kr: 본고는 道元의 『正法眼藏』에 수록되어 있는 ｢山水經｣에 나타난 산수의 의미를 살펴봄으로써 도원의 자연관을 통해 선종사상의 관점으로 밝히고자 한다. 또한 중국의 산수화를 통해 산수화가들의 정신과 인격수양에 관하여 살펴보고 중국 선종사상이 산수화와 어떤 관련성이 있는지 고찰하는 것을 목적으로 한다.일본 조동종의 종조였던 도원선사는 중국 조동종의 선승이었던 長翁如淨禪師에게 그 가르침을 전해 받고 송나라(1227)에서 묵조선을 수행했던 것으로 전해진다. 일본의 선종사찰과 자연과의 합일된 점은 사찰 내부의 조경형식으로 들어나게 되었다. 중국의 산수화풍은 동진의 顧愷之에서부터 시작하여 송나라 원나라에 이르기까지 폭넓게 자리하기 시작하였다. 宗炳 산수화의 이념과 양식 등은 荊浩에 의해 확산, 전이 되었고 郭熙를 통해 볼 수 있는 것(有爲)과 볼 수 없는 것(無爲)의 차이의 접근을 통일시키기에 이르렀다. 곽희의 이런 사상은 과거 종병이 펼친 산수의 靈을 세속의 정신이 초월된 것으로 보아 遠의 관념으로 발전 변화시킨 것이다. 산수화풍이 통일되면서 형식미만 갖춘 그림이 아닌 정신도 함께 담은 회화가 집대성되기 시작하였다. 많은 산수화가들 가운데 형호의 기운론은 내용적 발전을 드러내면서 가슴에 담았던 산수를 기운을 통해 회화로 표현되어 산수화의 발전을 가져오게 되었다.형호가 활발한 활동을 하던 당말과 곽희가 산수화의 三遠이론을 전개시키던 북송 때에는 禪學이 발달하였으며 선종사상이 풍미하던 시대였다. 이런 시대적 배경 속에 산수(자연주의)를 배경으로 한 山林文學과 不立文字를 내세운 선종사상은 많은 이들에게 철학적, 예술적 깊이를 더해 주었다. 자연의 풍미가 가득하고 선종사상이 팽배했던 시대에 자연경관과 대상을 통한 회화에 관한 묘사는 기운을 통해 수립될 수밖에 없었다.이들이 활동하던 당시의 시대적 배경을 살펴볼 때 선학이 알려지며 많은 이들에게 관심의 대상이 되었던 것은 분명한 사실일 것이다.당의 시대적 배경을 고스란히 앉고 송나라는 시작되면서 그 시대 도원선사는 유학길에 올랐으며 그의 사상적, 예술적 깊이를 통해 쓴 글이 『정법안장』이다. 『정법안장』에 담긴 ｢산수경｣을 바탕으로 본인의 실제 체험한 경험과 자신의 입장 전모 뿐 아니라 당시 송나라 선종의 모습도 파악할 수 있다. 송나라 유학길에 올랐던 도원선사가 산수절경에 감탄하여 쓴 ｢산수경｣이 어떤 내용으로 전개되고 있는지 살펴보고, 중국 산수화를 통해 회화적 표현으로 전개되는 산수의 본질적 모습도 함께 살펴보고자 한다.
articles.abstract_en: This study explores the meaning of landscapes as depicted in ｢Sansu Gyeong｣ included in Do Won's 󰡔Jeongbeop Anjang󰡕, aiming to illuminate Do Won's view of nature from the perspective of Zen Buddhism. Additionally, it aims to examine the spiritual and character cultivation of landscape painters in China, and the connection between Chinese Zen Buddhism and landscape painting.Do Won, the founding patriarch of the Soto Zen sect in Japan, is said to have received teachings from the Chinese Zen monk Jang Ongyeongseon and practiced silent meditation in the Song Dynasty(1227). The integration of Zen temples and nature in Japan was reflected in the landscaping within the temples. Chinese landscape painting, starting from the Eastern Jin Dynasty, gained prominence during the Song and Yuan Dynasties. The ideologies and styles of landscape painting were spread and transformed by the artist Hwang He, culminating in a unification of the visible(有爲) and the invisible(無爲). Hwang He's philosophy further evolved the spiritual transcendence of landscapes, previously depicted by landscape painters, into a concept of remoteness(遠). With the unification of landscape painting styles, paintings became more than just formalistic art; they also embodied the artists' spirits. Among many landscape painters, Hwang He's theory of qi(energy) significantly contributed to the development of landscape painting, expressing the landscapes held in the artist's heart through qi.During the late Tang Dynasty, when Hwang He was active, and the Northern Song Dynasty, when the “Three Distances” theory in landscape painting was developed, Zen Buddhism flourished. In this era, Zen Buddhism, with its emphasis on naturalism in landscape-oriented literature and non-reliance on written words, added philosophical and artistic depth. The paintings of natural landscapes and subjects from this era had to be established through qi, given the prevalence of Zen Buddhism.Considering the historical context of the Tang Dynasty and the beginning of the Song Dynasty, it is evident that Zen Buddhism gained significant attention. Do Won began his scholarly journey during this era, and his philosophical and artistic depth are reflected in 󰡔Jeongbeop Anjang󰡕. By examining ｢Sansu Gyeong｣ in 󰡔Jeongbeop Anjang󰡕, one can understand not only Do Won's personal experiences and perspectives but also the state of Zen Buddhism in the Song Dynasty. This study aims to explore the content of ｢Sansu Gyeong｣, written by Do Won in admiration of natural landscapes, and to examine the essential nature of landscapes as expressed in Chinese landscape painting.

articles.title_kr: 위덕왕대 사찰창건 배경과 특징
articles.title_en: A Study on the Background of Temple Founding During the Reign of King Wideok
articles.abstract_kr: 백제 위덕왕은 재위 기간 동안 능사와 왕흥사를 창건하는 두 차례의 대규모 불사를 추진하였다. 관상성 전투에서 패배한 직후인 555년에는 100명을 도승시키고, 번개를 많이 만들도록 하였다. 이 과정에서 사리봉안의식, 무차대회 등과 같은 불교의례가 설행되었을 것이다.기존 연구에서는 위덕왕이 두 차례의 불사를 추진한 배경을 왕권강화와 관련시켜 이해하는 경향이 많았다. 그러나 두 사찰이 창건된 시기와 배경을 볼 때, 불교를 통해 백제사회를 통합하고자 위한 노력으로 파악된다.한편, 567년 관산성 전투에서 전사한 성왕을 추복하기 위해 창건된 능사에는 전몰자의 명복을 기원하는 불교의례가 설행되었다. 557년에는 2월 15일에는 왕흥사에 목탑을 세우고 진신사리를 공양하였으며, 같은 해 10월 위덕왕은 신라를 공격하였다. 위덕왕은 능사와 왕흥사 두 사찰에 목탑을 세우고 진신사리를 공양함으로써 불교적 이상군주인 전륜성왕으로서의 면모를 보이고자 하였다. 위덕왕의 사찰창건, 전몰자 명복 불사, 목탑건립 및 진신사리 공양 등은 지속되는 전쟁으로 인한 사회적 불안을 해소하고 나아가 국론을 결집하기 위해 불교의례를 적극 활용한 것으로 볼 수 있다.
articles.abstract_en: King Wideok built two large temples, ‘Neung-sa(陵寺)’ and ‘Wangheung-sa(王興寺)’, while he was on the throne. And in 555, 100 people were ordained as monks and were instructed to make ‘beongae’, tools used in Buddhist rituals. Existing study understood the background of King Wideok's opening of two new Buddhist temples in relation to the strengthening of royal power. but, ‘Neungsa(陵寺)’, a temple to commemorate ‘Seong of Baekje(百濟 聖王)’ who died in the Battle of Gwansanseong Fortress, a Buddhist ceremony was held to pray for the souls of the fallen. In 557, on February 15th, a wooden pagoda was built at Wangheungsa Temple and an offering of ‘Relics of the Buddha(眞身舍利)’ was made. This is a ritual to show oneself as a ‘chakravarti(轉輪聖王)’, a perfect monarch according to Buddhism. like this Considering the time and background of the temple's founding, it can be seen as an effort to integrate Baekje society through Buddhism.

articles.title_kr: 불교적 염원의 시각화 - 통일신라 불탑의 상징성과 신장 이미지 -
articles.title_en: Visualizing the Sacred: Unveiling the Symbolism of Unified Silla’s Buddhist Pagodas, Guardian Deities Imagery, and Their Alignment with Buddhist Ideals
articles.abstract_kr: This paper examines the relationship between the symbolism of Buddhist Pagodas the imagery of Buddhist Guardian Deities and the orientation of Buddhism during the Unified Silla period. It analyzes how the ideology of the Unified Silla Buddhist society shapes the spatial perception of Pagodas and the arrangement of Guardian Deities imagery. The focus is primarily on the Pagodas erected around Gyeongju, with particular attention to the consistency in placement, such as the presence of Vajrapani and the Four Heavenly Kings on the surface of the first story of the Pagoda and the positioning of the Eight Great Devas on the surface of the upper part of the pedestal. The aim is to illuminate the context in which the imagery of the deities emerges on Pagodas within the contemporary Buddhist spatial perception.This paper interprets Pagodas during the Unified Silla period as a reflection of the layout of temples centered around a Geumdang (“golden hall”). It speculates that the arrangement of the Deities imagery is consistent based on this perception. Fundamentally, Silla's perception of Buddha’s relics extends to the aspirations for the living presence of Buddha and Buddha Land shared within Silla's Buddhist society at the time. The arrangement of deities imagery on Pagodas visually manifests this sentiment. Therefore, the aspiration for Buddha's living presence and the role of the imagery in affirming these aspirations were common trends in Unified Silla Buddhism. Additionally, the paper proposes that the aspiration for Buddha's living presence and the perception of the role of the Guardian Deities images, which guarantee it, represent a general tendency in the religious practices of Unified Silla Buddhism.The paper takes an essential approach by moving beyond the perspective of hoguk bulgyo (“nation protecting Buddhism”) in elucidating the function of Guardian Deities images on the surface of Buddhist pagodas. Thus it captures the characteristic aspect of Unified Silla Buddhism’s orientation towards the Pure Land, or Buddhist paradise. The paper is expected to contribute to a better understanding of the unique characteristics of ancient Korean Buddhism and the understanding of Buddhism through artworks as well.

articles.title_kr: 인류무형유산 연등회- 관(官)의 의례에서 민간의 축제로 -
articles.title_en: Lotus Lantern Festival: From Rite to Festival
articles.abstract_kr: 한국불교를 대표하는 불교의례로는 그 규모가 장엄하면서 참여자가 많은 대표적인 것들로 연등회(燃燈會), 영산재(靈山齋), 수륙재(水陸齋), 생전예수재(生前預修齋) 등을 들 수 있다. 이 중에서 연등회는 2012년 국가무형유산으로 지정되어 보존·전승되고 있으며, 2020년에는 ‘유네스코 인류무형유산 대표목록’으로 등재되었다현재 한국불교에서 연등으로 상징되는 연등회는 축제적 성격을 띤 의례로 전환되고 있다. 그러나 연등의 등불은 본원적으로 붓다의 지혜를 상징함과 동시에 붓다에 대한 예경의 그 자체를 상징하며 헌공의 대상이다. 일련의 행위의 과정에서 등불은 붓다와 중생을 이어 주는 매개체로서의 역할을 하는 상징성을 띤다고도 할 수 있다.본 논문은 현재 단순한 불교의례를 넘어서 한국을 대표하는 축제로 유네스코가 지정한 연등회의 성격을 밝혀 보고자 한다. 우선 연등회의 기원과 역사를 축제적 성격의 근원을 찾을 수 있는 측면에서 살펴본다. 그리고 유네스코가 규정하고 있는 연등회의 특징과 성격을 분석한다. 그리고 연등회를 비롯한 불교의 무형유산의 발굴과 체계화를 위한 과제들에 대해 논의해 본다.
articles.abstract_en: Buddhist rituals representing Korean Buddhism are representative of large-scale and large numbers of participants. can be heard Among them, Lotus was designated as a national intangible cultural property in 2012 and has been preserved and transmitted, and in 2020 it was registered as a ‘UNESCO Representative List of Intangible Heritage of Humanity’.These characteristics are now being converted into a kind of festive ritual through the Lotus Lantern, symbolized by the lotus lantern in Korean Buddhism. The lamp again symbolizes the wisdom of the Buddha and at the same time symbolizes the very respect for the Buddha, and is an object of dedication. In addition, in the process of a series of actions, it can be said that the lamp takes on a symbolic role as a medium that connects the Buddha and sentient beings.This paper aims to reveal the nature of the Lotus Lantern Festival, which has been designated by UNESCO as a representative festival of Korea beyond simple Buddhist rituals. First, we examine the origins and history of Lotus Deunghoe from the perspective of finding the source of its festive nature. And the characteristics and characteristics of Yeondeunghoe as defined by UNESCO are analyzed. In addition, we will discuss the tasks for the discovery and systematization of Buddhist intangible cultural assets, including Lotus Deunghoe.First, “The origin and history of Yeondeunghoe was examined in the festive nature”. Second, the “characteristics and characteristics of Yeondeunghoe” introduced by UNESCO was reviewed. Third, lastly, “the task for the discovery and systematization of Buddhist intangible cultural assets including Lotus Deunghoe” was discussed.

articles.title_kr: 대승불교의 형성과 ‘페르시아-베딕(Vedic)’ 종교의 융합 - 아미타불과 서방정토 신앙의 형성을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: The Formation of Mahayana Buddhism and the Convergence of ‘Persian-Vedic’ Religion: Based on the formation of Amitabha Buddha and Western Pure Land beliefs
articles.abstract_kr: The research on the origins of Mahayana Buddhism, which leads the field of Buddhist studies in Japan, has been relatively lacking in the study of the interaction between Buddhism and Persian cultural spheres.In particular, the new paradigm shift of Buddhism in the Persian cultural sphere does not mean a distortion of Buddhism or that it was absorbed by Persian religions, as suggested by theories such as the Mahayana non-Buddhism(大乘非佛論).On the contrary, through the process of reinterpreting and integrating the deities of Persian traditional religions into Buddhist doctrine and thought, it also means that Buddhism’s scope could be expanded even further.In fact, scholars like Maeda Eun (前田慧雲), who analyze Mahayana Buddhism as inheriting the philosophical traditions of traditional Indian Buddhism, point out that Mahayana Buddhism’s core doctrines―such as the concepts of emptiness (空, sunyata) and non-self (法無我論, anatman)―which are largely absent in Persian traditional religions, became central to Mahayana thought.This shows that Mahayana Buddhism, within the paradigm of a new cultural sphere, actively integrated and harmonized Persian traditional religious elements.In this sense, A. L. Basham's analysis, which suggests that the faith in Amitabha Buddha and the belief in Bodhisattvas within Mahayana Buddhism were formed through a process of mutual integration and fusion with Zoroastrianism, implies that Buddhism’s spread into the Persian cultural sphere marked a paradigm shift where it fused with the traditional Persian religion of Zoroastrianism.Thus, it can be hypothesized that as Indian Buddhism evolved and developed historically, doctrines such as the concept of emptiness (空) and non-self (法無我論) emerged, leading to the completion of Buddhist doctrine. From there, as Buddhism spread into new cultural spheres, it merged with Persian religions such as Zoroastrianism, which led to the emergence of the Amitabha doctrine and Bodhisattva beliefs. Religious elements such as stupa worship also infiltrated, and Mahayana Buddhism was constructed and established in this new paradigm.

articles.title_kr: 어린이 포교의 구조적 개선 방안- (사) 동련을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: The Structural Improvement Direction of Buddhism Children Propogation: Centering on the Dongryun Corporation
articles.abstract_kr: The purpose of this paper is to examine the current status of improvement of Buddhism child propagation, focusing on the Korean Federation of Buddhist Children's Leaders (hereinafter referred to as Dongrryun).In general, the class-specific Dharma meeting implemented by the temple can be divided into children (infant), teenager, college students (youth man), and general departments. In the process of starting one's first impression of Buddhism and religious activities, children are in the most important position. In other words, the Children's Law Society, the cornerstone of Buddhism and the first step, is the beginning of a step toward new deeds. Therefore, the Children's Dharma meeting Society should promote the growth of a wise person through new activities and various programs that convey the teachings of the Buddha.Currently, MindFlower and Lotus Paper are representative places that issue monthly textbooks for children's Dharma meeting that can be used a lot in temples. Mind Flower can also be accessed online through Naver Blog, YouTube, and Instagram, and every Month Lotus can be viewed as an e-book on the website.To suggest an improvement plan to supplement the children's Dharma meeting program in a long-term and systematic manner, first, it is a long-term interest in the guidance of the children's Dharma meeting to cultivate talent. Second, there is a need for a change in the online perception of lotus flowers. Third, an online upgrade of Dongryeon is needed. Fourth, it is necessary to subdivide lotus textbooks. Overall, it is necessary to actively promote it so that it can be easily accessed by using online propagation.In order to communicate and understand Buddhist teachings to children, the leader and the participant, should be satisfied with the Dharma meeting program and aim to expand the body and mind along with physical growth. Therefore, in-depth discussions on what to prepare for future generations and how to lead them are needed.

articles.title_kr: 신라의 제석천 신앙과 신라 왕실과의 관계
articles.title_en: Silla's Belief in Śakkra Devānāmindra and Its Relationship with the Silla Royal Family
articles.abstract_kr: 제석 신앙은 신라 진평왕 대가 되면서 강력한 모습을 나타낸다. 이는 법흥왕과 진흥왕에 의한 불교의 공인과 발전이 진평왕 대에 와서 전통적인 천신 숭배를 포괄하기 때문이다. 또 진평왕은 제석 신앙 속에서 동륜계銅輪系를 특수화하는 것으로 보이는데, 이는 이후의 진골인 무열왕계武烈王系와는 다른 특징이다. 이런 점에서 진평왕 대부터 강력하게 대두하는 제석 신앙은 성골의 확립과도 관련된다는 판단도 가능하다.진평왕이 확립하는 ‘제석帝釋 신앙-천사옥대天賜玉帶’의 구조는 삼국 통일 후에는 ‘용龍 신앙-흑옥대黑玉帶’로 대체된다. 이는 신라 왕실의 신앙 변화를 알 수 있는 부분이다. 그러다가 중대 신라 말에 이르면 제석 신앙이 왕실과 밀접한 연결을 보이는 모습이 확인되며, 이후 제석에 의한 왕실과의 단절이 살펴진다. 이는 무열왕계의 종언과 하대 신라로의 변화를 상징한다는 점에서 주목된다. 즉 신라 왕실의 당위성 강조와 관련해서 제석 신앙이 강력하게 작용하고 있는 것이다. 이는 지배 이데올로기로서의 불교가 주도하는 사상 배경 속에서, 전통적인 천신 숭배를 넘어서는 요청구조가 작동한 결과라고 하겠다.
articles.abstract_en: The belief in Śakkra became strong during the reign of King Jinpyeong of Silla. This is because the recognition and development of Buddhism by King Beopheung and King Jinheung came to include the traditional worship of heavenly gods during the reign of King Jinpyeong. In addition, King Jinpyeong seemed to have specialized the Dongryun(銅輪)’s lineage in the belief in Śakkra, which was a different characteristic from the King Muyeol's lineage or Jingol lineage in later days. In this respect, it may also be concluded that the belief in Śakkra, which became strong during the reign of King Jinpyeong, was related to the establishment of the Seonggol (sacred lineage).The structure of ‘belief in Śakkra - Cheonsaokdae(jade belt bestowed from heaven)’ established by King Jinpyeong was replaced with the structure of ‘Yong(dragon) belief - Heukokdae(black jade belt)’ after the unification of the Three Kingdoms. This shows how the Silla royal family’s beliefs changed in those days. Then, during the end of the Middle Silla period, the belief in Śakkra was closely connected with the royal family, and thereafter the severance of the royal family by Śakkrais became clear. This is noteworthy in that it symbolizes the end of King Muyeol’s lineage and the shift to latter period of Silla. In other words, the Śakkra belief was strongly influential in relation to emphasizing the legitimacy of the Silla royal family. This might have been the result of a structure request that went beyond the traditional worship of heavenly gods operating within the ideological background dominated by Buddhism as the ruling ideology.

articles.title_kr: 인공지능기반 디지털전환시대, 지속가능발전을 위한 불교종립대학의 불교관련 교양교과의 운영방향- 동국대학교의 불교교양교육을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: Direction of Sustainable Development for Buddhist Liberal Arts Education Curriculum in the AI-driven Digital Transformation Era: A Focus on the Buddhist Liberal Arts Curriculum at Dongguk University
articles.abstract_kr: The advancement of cutting-edge technology has ushered in the era of generative artificial intelligence and digital transformation. In response, university education is undergoing innovative changes to break away from the traditional educational framework, aiming to cultivate creatively integrated talents. Reflecting on the current state of Buddhist-related general education at Buddhist Missionary University, I conducted a contemplation on the direction toward sustainable development. As a result, Buddhist-related general education courses accounted for approximately 9% of the total general education courses in terms of both numbers and credits. The predominant teaching method was lecture-based, with some courses incorporating innovative approaches such as team-based presentations, discussions, and cyber methods. The primary evaluation criterion was examinations, and the impact of assessment criteria based on lecture ratio was minimal. Most general education curriculums related to Buddhism were offered by the Department of Buddhist Studies, primarily falling within the humanities field. Based on these findings, recommendations for sustainable development include a shift towards learner-centered education in Buddhist-related general education, adoption of innovative teaching methods that move away from lecture-centric approaches, exploration of process-oriented assessment methods rather than result-centered exam evaluations, fostering interest in interdisciplinary education, development of Buddhism-based interdisciplinary courses, and enhancement of instructor capabilities.

articles.title_kr: 관세음보살 서원을 적용한 관세음보살 명상 프로그램
articles.title_en: The Avalokiteshvara Meditation Program Applying the Vows of Avalokiteshvara
articles.abstract_kr: This study aims to explore the vows of Avalokitesvara (觀世音菩薩), reframing Avalokitesvara's vow of saving all sentient beings to provide practical solace to modern individuals through an Avalokitesvara meditation program. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva’s vows symbolize the pinnacle of compassionate aid, addressing the suffering and anxieties of all sentient beings. To achieve this reconstruction, this study compares Avalokiteśvara’s vows with those of other bodhisattvas, analyzing and revisiting “The Universal Gate of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva” (觀世音菩薩普門品) in Lotus Sutra (妙法蓮華經), especially the Sutra on the Causes of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva’s Birth in the Pure Land (觀世音菩薩往生淨土本緣經). This study particularly confirmed that Avalokiteśvara’s vows are distinct from those of the other Mahayana bodhisattvas, which typically focus on enlightenment, in that the former is more concrete and actionable, centering on the perspective of sentient beings. This actionability makes Avalokiteśvara’s established vows worthy of reconstruction for contemporary society. These practical vows lead to the salvation of all beings and, for this reason, may provide valuable assistance in people’s lives. Consequently, this study argues for the necessity of expanding the theoretical foundation and background research on Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva’s previous lives, vows, and the “Hundred Great Vows” (百大願), focusing on the salvation for all beings in the present world. Such perfective will provide an intellectual approach to understanding the social context surrounding Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. To this end, this study proposes that by applying this understanding to modern contexts, these elements can serve as a source of concrete existential security and hope in contemporary life. To widely and directly disseminate the compassionate vow of Avalokiteshvara, an Avalokiteshvara meditation program has been developed, with the hope that this small initiative will lead to active research in implementing Avalokiteshvara's spirit in practical programs.

articles.title_kr: <연화장세계도>의 구조와 표현 방식 고찰
articles.title_en: A Study on the Structure and Expression Method of the Lotus Pedestal System
articles.abstract_kr: The purpose of this paper is to compare and analyze “The Lotus Pedestal System Paints of Dharmadhata”, produced by Late Joseon Period, with Avatam-Sakas̄tra and Commentary of Avatam-Saka. “The Lotus Pedesstal System Paints of Dharmadhata” is the Illustration of the Avatamsaka Sutra, which was intensively produced in the late Jose on Dynasty based “Lotus Pedestal System” on the 80-volume Avatam-Sakas̄tra. “The Illustration” is a picture drawn by literally changing the contents of a scripture into a “shape,” so it must be studied together with the scriptures to understand it. However, most of the studies conducted to date have focused on the perspective of art studies. Although the study was compared with the scriptures, only the name of “World Species” was compared and could not be reviewed with the meaning of the iconography or along with the commentary. Therefore, in this paper, the iconography was analyzed by comparing it with “Avatam-Sakas̄tra” and “Commentary Paper of Avatam ̣ Saka” by referring to previous studies. As a result of the study, “The Lotus World Paints of Dharmadhata” can be classified into three main types. It can be seen that it expresses the direction of rotation of the lotus pedestal system or the 20-story world surrounding the ‘world species’ based on the scriptures. In the meaning of the study, it is intended to inform that the true value of the Illustration Sutra, produced based on the scriptures, lies in the completion of the Illustration of the Sutra along with the pictorial completion, and to present the basis for more active research from this perspective in the future.
keywords_en: The Lotus World Paintings of Dharmadhata
The Illustration of the Avatamsaka Sutra

articles.title_kr: 신라시대 음악 문화에 대한 새로운 이해- 689년(신문왕 9) 신촌(新村)공연의 음악적 특징과 역사적 배경 -
articles.title_en: New Understanding on Music Culture in the Silla Period: Musical Characteristics and Historical Background of Sinchon Performance in 689(King Shinmun-wang 9)
articles.abstract_kr: 신문왕은 689년(신문왕 9) 신촌에 순행해 잔치를 베풀고 음악을 연주하였다. ‘689년 신촌공연’, 연주된 악곡은 ‘신촌 7곡’이라 할 수 있다. 음악적 측면에서 분석하고, 그 역사적 배경을 살펴보았다. 신라시대 음악 문화를 새로운 시각에서 이해하려는 시도이다.먼저, 신촌공연의 음악적 형식구성과 특징은 다음과 같다. 첫째, 개최시기는 689년, 주최는 국왕(신문왕), 장소는 신촌, 성격은 왕의 순행에 따른 특별행사에서 연주된 연회음악이었다. 둘째, 연주된 악곡은 모두 일곱 곡이었다. 악곡의 배열은 공연순서이며, 7곡이 하나의 공연을 구성하는 통합적인 체제였다. 셋째, 공연단은 총 56명으로 구성된 대규모 공연이었다. 넷째, 공연은 7개의 악곡으로 구성된 모음곡 형식의 종합적인 무악(舞樂)이었다. 도입부의 전주곡(서곡)인 가무(笳舞), 제1막인 하신열무·사내무·한기무, 제2막인 상신열무·소경무·미지무 등으로 편성되었다. 다섯째, 신촌 7곡의 악곡편성은 대가야의 우륵 12곡과 유사성이 발견된다. 형식적인 측면에서 대가야음악이 신라음악으로 계승·발전됐음을 보여준다.다음, 신촌공연의 역사적 배경을 정리한다. 첫째, 689년 9월 신문왕의 장산성 순행은 달구벌 천도시도와 밀접했다. 천도를 위한 공식 행사에서 연행된 특별공연일 가능성이 높다. 둘째, 제1막인 하·상신열은 치성화현, 사내는 경주의 왕경, 한기는 신라 6부인 한기부의 음악으로 생각된다. 제2막인 상신열은 치성화현, 소경은 서원경(청주), 미지는 미질부(포항 흥해)로 보인다. 셋째, 제1막 지역은 중앙(왕도: 왕경→6부), 제2막은 지방(소경→군현)으로 서로 대응된다. 넷째, 연행된 악곡은 천도예정지의 공역과 밀접성을 가진 지역의 음악일 가능성도 검토해 볼 만하다.
articles.abstract_en: King Sinmun-wang took a tour to Sincheon in 689 to hold a banquet and performed music. The song performed in ‘689 Sinchon musical Performance’ could be stated as the ‘Sincheon 7 Songs’. This article analyzes its musical aspect and takes a look at its historical background.The musical style composition and characteristics of Sinchon performance are shown as follows. First, the period of it was 689 and hosted by the king, with the venue of Sinchon, and its characteristics was the banquet music performed in a special event following the royal tour. Second, there were a total of seven songs performed for this occasion. The arrange sequence of the music was shown in the performance sequence with all seven songs consisting in a performance. Third, the performance company was in a large-scale performance comprised with the total of 56 musicians. Fourth, the performance was a comprehensive dance music in a form of suite-style comprised with the seven songs. It is composed with its introductory part, the prelude(overture) for singing and dancing, with first stage of Hasinyeol-mu, Sanae-mu, Hangi-mu and the second stage of Sangsinyeol-mu, Sogyeong-mu, Miji-mu. And fifth, the musical composition for Sinchon 7 Songs had the similarity with the Wooreuk 12 Songs. In the stylistic aspect, the Dagaya music is shown as succeeding and advancing into the Silla music.Next, the historic background of Sinchon performance is arranged. First, in September 689, the Jangsan-seong touri of King Sinmun-wang has close relations to the Dalgubeol cheondo attempt. It is highly likely to be a special performance carried out in the ceremonial event for cheondo. Second, it is considered that the stage 1, Ha and Sangsinyeol is Chiseonghwa-province, Sanae for royal capital of Gyeongju, and Hangi as the music of Hangibu as the Silla 6-bu. The second stage of Sangsinyeol is shown to be Chiseonghwa-province, Sogyeong for Seowongyeong(Cheongju), and Miji for Mijil-bu(Pohang Heunghae). Third, the stage 1 region is central(royal capital → 6-bu) and the stage 2 is regional(small capital→province) to corresponding to each other. And fourth, the performed music could be considered with the possibility with the regional music having the closeness with the construction of cheondo scheduled site.

articles.title_kr: 불교 ‘無心’의 검도적 변용 -『不動智神妙錄』을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: A kendo transformation of Buddhism's ‘No-Mind’: Focused on 『Fudochishinmyoroku』
articles.abstract_kr: The purpose of this paper is to explore the Buddhist ‘No-Mind(無心)’ and its kendo transformation, which form the ideological basis of Japanese kendo. ‘Zen Buddhism(禪宗) suggested a method of performing ‘No-Mind(無心)’ and Ordinary-Life-Mind(平常心)’ to maintain an ideal state of mind for warriors to handle swords even in front of the enemy. This ‘No-Mind(無心)’ was melted into kendo and transformed to fit the kendo. In the 『Fudochishinmyoroku(不動智神妙錄)』 Takuang emphasized the mental state of samurai rather than the technical aspect of kendo. In particular, it was said that the highest level of kendo was the same as that of Buddhism's ‘No-Mind(無心)’. Dakuang regarded the ‘No-Mind(無心)’ that moved in all directions and never stopped, and the mind that stopped was a mystery. The technique expressed in the state of ‘No-Mind(無心)’ is ‘No-Sword(無刀)’, and the specific state of mind is explained by ‘without a gap in one's hair(間不容髮)’ and ‘a flash of lightning(石火之機).’ In the end, it refers to ‘Sameness of Sword and Zen(劍禪一如)’ that the state of Zen Buddhism and the state of kendo are not different. This idea has continued to this day, and many kendo masters emphasize the necessity of Zen meditation along with kendo.

articles.title_kr: 영산재의 종교성과 공연예술성 - 신촌 奉元寺를 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: The Religiosity and Performing Arts of Yeongsanjae: Centered on Important Intangible Cultural Heritage No. 50
articles.abstract_kr: This paper explores the distinction between the religious and performative artistic aspects of Korean Buddhist rituals within the context of the ritual enactment at Bongwonsa Temple's Yeongsanjae in Sinchon. Additionally, it focuses on understanding the characteristics of the participants and objects of participation in the performances through types of Yeongsanjae such as recommendations and initiations, which are intangible cultural heritage of the ritual. By combining the structural forms of Buddhist rituals with those of traditional performing arts, the study examines ways to facilitate the public's easier comprehension and sharing of Buddhist values. It suggests methods for adapting Buddhist ritual practices such as ritual procedures, chanting, and prostrations into contemporary performing arts to make them more accessible to the public. Emphasizing the importance of traditional intangible cultural heritage of Buddhism, the paper advocates for widening the recognition of its significance and promoting opportunities for experiencing, sharing, and adapting traditional values and meanings of Buddhism in new ways.

articles.title_kr: 근대 일본에서의 승병 인식과 조선불교 부정론
articles.title_en: Awareness of Seungbyeong and Denial of Joseon Buddhism in Modern Japan
articles.abstract_kr: In Japanese and Korean Buddhism, seungbyeong(僧兵) actually existed in the past history, and from the early days, it attracted attention as a heterogeneous being who served as a monk and a soldier. This article paid attention to the discourse of seungbyeong left by the Japanese at the end of the 19th century and examined how it influenced the view of denying Joseon Buddhism. The Japanese who entered Joseon at the end of the 19th century negatively evaluated the seungbyeong as inappropriate for the times. This inherited Japan's negative evaluation and perception of Japanese seungbyeong. This is because, according to the writings left by the Japanese, the existence of ‘seungbyeong’ regardless of Japan and Joseon was recognized as inappropriate for the present era and unacceptable in Buddhism.A new interpretation is emerging to overcome the negative view that seungbyeong is a monk who deviated from teaching in recent Japanese seungbyeong studies. The Joseon seungbyeong also needs a different perspective from the evaluation that the Japanese identified as a symbol of the decline of Joseon Buddhism at the end of the 19th century. This is because different temples also had different trends. Therefore, since the Japanese discourse on Joseon Buddhism, including seungbyeong, projected a comparison with Japanese Buddhism, it insisted that the Joseon seungbyeong should be reviewed in accordance with the background of Joseon society and the times at the time.

articles.title_kr: 조선시대 여성의 출가(出家) 양상 고찰- 국가권력과의 관계를 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: A Study on the Aspects of Women's Renunciation in the Joseon Dynasty
articles.abstract_kr: 이 글은 조선시대 여성의 출가 양상을 분석하여 강력한 배불정책과 금령에도 불구하고 그 출가가 계속된 요인을 살펴보는 데 있다. 일반적으로 조선시대를 ‘숭유억불(崇儒抑佛)’과 ‘남존여비(男尊女卑)’라는 말로서 특징짓지만, 그럼에도 불교는 전 시기를 관통하며 존속했고, 특히 유교의 순종적인 여성관에 반하는 여성의 출가도 끊임없이 이어졌다.여기서 필자는 조선시대 여성의 출가를 단순히 종교적인 열망으로만 설명하는 데 한계가 있다고 보고, 시대적 상황상 조선의 지배권력이 그 출가를 막을 수 없었다는 점에 주목하였다. 그리고 본 논의의 전제로서 먼저 여성의 출가와 무관할 수 없는 조선시대 배불정책의 특성을 살폈는데, 이것을 통해 필자는 문화나 종교적 전통이 쉽게 바뀌지도 않고, 바꿀 수도 없다는 데서 그 일차적인 이유를 찾았다. 즉 민심에 토대를 두고 있는 유교적 이념상 극단적인 폐불로 인한 민심의 반발과 이탈을 우려하여 불교의 종교적 기능을 인정하면서 국가적으로 통제하고자 했다는 것이다.다음으로 주목한 것은 불교에 대한 국왕의 의지이다. 조선시대는 왕권 중심의 중앙집권체제였던 만큼 국왕의 의지와 불교 신앙으로 인해 그 시행상에도 한계가 있었다는 것이다. 이와 더불어 지배권력의 한 축을 이루던 양반층의 출가도 무시할 수 없었다고 보는데, 이른바 강력한 조치로 인한 유력가문과의 마찰이 부담스러울 수 있었다는 것이다. 이외 국왕도 왕실의 일원으로서 효행을 강조하는 유교적 이념상 왕실의 불교 신행을 완강하게 거부하기 어려웠다는 점도 한몫했을 것으로 보았다.필자는 이러한 추론을 전제로 󰡔조선왕조실록󰡕에 나타난 여성의 출가와 관련한 기록을 검토하였는데, 수많은 조치에도 여성의 출가가 끊임없이 이어지고, 심지어 국가적으로 그것을 인정하는 사례도 적지 않음을 확인하였다. 이와 관련하여 필자는 앞서 조선시대가 배불의 기조를 유지하면서도 극단적인 폐불을 강행하지 못한 것과 같은 사정이 있었을 것으로 보았다. 즉 조선의 지배권력은 문화나 종교적 전통이 쉽게 바뀌지도 않고, 바꿀 수도 없다는 것을 인정할 수밖에 없었고, 이에 여성의 종교활동을 어느 정도 보장하면서 통제하고자 했다는 것이다.다음으로 여성 출가에 대한 국왕의 태도나 왕실 여성의 불교 신행으로 인한 시행상의 한계가 있었다고 보았는데, 조선의 권력 구조상 국왕의 의지를 부정하기는 어려웠고, 또한 국왕도 왕실의 일원으로서 효행을 강조하는 유교적 이념상 그 신행을 거부하기가 쉽지 않았다는 것이다. 나아가 상류층 여성의 출가가 적지 않았다는 점도 적지 않게 작용했을 것으로 보았는데, 이른바 강력한 조치로 인한 유력가문과의 불필요한 마찰을 피하려는 정치적인 속셈도 있었다는 것이다. 다만 그 이념상 성평등적인 불교를 그대로 수용할 수는 없었고, 또한 사회 구조상 약자일 수밖에 없는 여성의 현실을 외면할 수도 없었기 때문에 일종의 편법으로서 유교적 여성관을 접목한 수절 형식의 출가를 용인한 것이라고 보았다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the pattern of Women's Renunciation in the Joseon Dynasty and examines the reasons why this renunciation continued despite the strong anti-Buddhist policy. The Joseon Dynasty is generally characterized by the phrases ‘promoting Confucianism and suppressing Buddhism’ and ‘respecting men and belittling women’, but Buddhism persisted throughout the era, and women's renunciation who deviated from the obedient Confucian view of women went on constantly Here, the author believes that it is difficult to explain women's renunciation in the Joseon Dynasty simply as religious aspiration, and focuses on the fact that the ruling power of Joseon could not prevent them from doing so, considering the circumstances of the time. As a premise for this discussion, the author first examines the Buddhist policy of the Joseon Dynasty, which was deeply related to women's renunciation. Through this, the author inferred that the fact that cultural and religious traditions do not and cannot be easily changed. The renunciation of the yangban class which was the center of the ruling power and the Confucian ideology emphasizing filial piety made it difficult for the king to strongly reject the royal family's Buddhist faith, and made it impossible to implement an extreme policy of abolishing Buddhism.Based on this reasoning, the author examined the records related to women's renunciation in the Annals of the Joseon Dynasty and confirmed that despite numerous prohibition policies, women's renunciation continued throughout the era and there were even many cases where it was recognized by the state. In relation to this, the author believed that there was probably a similar reason why the Joseon Dynasty maintained an anti-Buddhist policy but was unable to enforce an extreme policy of abolishing Buddhism. In other words, the ruling power of Joseon had no choice but to acknowledge that culture and religious traditions did not and could not be easily changed, and so they attempted to control women's religious activities to a certain extent while guaranteeing them.Next, it was seen that there were limitations in implementation due to the king's attitude toward women's renunciation or the Buddhist beliefs of royal women. Given the power structure of Joseon, it was difficult to deny the king's will, and it was also not easy for the king, as a member of the royal family, to ban the belief based on Confucian ideology that emphasized filial piety. Furthermore, the fact that there were quite a few women's renunciation in the ruling class was thought to have played a role, and there was also a political intention to avoid unnecessary friction with the ruling class due to so-called strong measures. However, since Buddhism, which pursues gender equality, could not be accepted as it is from a Confucian ideological perspective, and the reality of women as weaker social groups could not be also ignored, it was judged that the form of monasticism, which incorporated the Confucian view of women, was tolerated as a sort of expedient measure.
keywords_en: The Annals of the Joseon Dynasty

articles.title_kr: 발타라(跋陀羅)의 어원과 탐몰라주(耽沒羅洲)의위치 추정 -『법주기』에 언급된 16나한과 그들의 거주지에서 -
articles.title_en: An Etymology of “Bhadra” and the Location Estimation of “Danmoluo zhou/Tammolaju”: Based on the Fazhu ji’s References to the Sixteen Great Arhats and Their Residences
articles.abstract_kr: In 654 Xuanzang translated the Nandimitrāvadāna, a second-century collection of Nandimitra’s sayings. This Chinese translation, entitled Da aluohan Nantimiduo luo suoshuo fazhu ji (大阿羅漢難提蜜多羅所說法住記), has a reference to the personal name “Batuoluo” (跋陀羅). If we are justified in identifying “Batuolou” as “Bhadra,” the name in question seems to be used as a common noun meaning “a wise person” (賢人). Otherwise, the original word for “Batoulou” may refer to Bhadrika, who is known to have abandoned the throne to become a monk when the Buddha returned to his home.As for this person Batuoluo, in the Joseon Bulgyo tongsa (朝鮮佛敎通史) Yi Neunghwa quotes from the Fazhu ji a phrase that Batuoluo lived in Tāmradvīpa (Danmoluo zhou/Tammolaju), and adds that Tammolaju is Tamna, which is present day Jeju Island. However, one Khotanese text of the Nandimitrāvadāna refers to the sixth arhat’s residence as Siṁhaladvīpa (師子胤), and the Fahua jing wenju fezheng ji (法華經文句輔正記) also states that Tāmradvīpa is Shiziguo (師子國). This textual evidence thus shows that “Danmoluo zhou” refers to present-day Sri Lanka.Moreover, there exist differences in the names of the sixteen arhats, the numbers of their retinues, the names of their residences, and the order in which they are enumerated according to the versions of the Nandimitrāvadāna. This paper thus explores the ways in which these differences are brought about by the scribes or translators of this text. It also examines different ways in which the identity of the sixth arhat and the location of Tāmradvīpa have been interpreted according to the readers of the same text.

articles.title_kr: 해인사·통도사의 단옷날 소금 관련 의례의연유(緣由)와 차이에 관한 고찰
articles.title_en: A Study on the Reason and Difference of Dano(端午)’s Salt-related Rituals of Haeinsa(海印寺) and Tongdosa(通度寺)
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 합천 해인사와 양산 통도사에서 행해지는 단옷날 소금 의례에서, 두 의례가 절차상 차이를 보이는 연유를 살피는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 세시로서의 단오와 소금의 의미에 대해 우선 살펴보았다. 민간에서 단오는 여러 가지 의미를 내포하고 있지만, ‘5월 5일’은 홀수 즉 양수(陽數) 두 개가 겹치는 중양절(重陽節) 중에서도 가운데에 위치하여 양기(陽氣)가 가장 치성한 날로 여겨진다. 이에 반해 소금은 바닷물의 정수로써 음기(陰氣)를 지닌 것으로 여겨진다. 즉 단옷날의 소금 의례는 음·양 오행설을 바탕으로 하여, 양기가 가득한 중양절에 음기를 상징하는 소금을 통해 음·양의 조화를 추구하는 것이라 볼 수도 있으며, 수극화(水剋火) 즉 ‘물’로 ‘불’을 억제한다는 의미를 담고 있는 것으로도 볼 수 있다.이런 점을 바탕에 두고 본고에서는 두 가지 점에 주목하였다. 첫째는 민간에서 행해지던 의례를 사찰에서 적극적으로 수용했다는 점이며, 둘째는 소금을 활용하는 방식이 사찰마다 조금씩 차이를 보인다는 점이다. 사찰은 그 건물들이 대부분 목조이기에 화재에 취약하여, 화재 예방의 의미를 담고 있는 소금 의례가 적극적으로 행해진다는 사실을 알 수 있었다. 그리고 해인사에서는 사찰 주위와 해인사의 남쪽에 위치한 가야산 남산제일봉에 소금단지를 묻는 방식으로 의례가 진행되며, 통도사에서는 건물의 들보 위로 소금단지를 올리는 방식으로 의례가 진행된다. 가야산은 풍수지리에서 말하는 화성(火星) 즉 바위로 이루어진 석산(石山)이기 때문에, 남산제일봉에 날려오는 화기를 억제하기 위하여 남산제일봉을 포함한 사찰 주위에 소금을 묻는 방식으로 의례가 진행된다. 반면 통도사는 그 창건 설화부터 수호룡 사상과 밀접한 관련을 맺고 있어, 수호룡의 가피로 바닷물의 기운이 사찰을 감싸게 하여 화재를 예방하려는 의도를 지니고 있다. 그리고 이를 위해 들보 위로 소금단지를 들보 위로 올리는 형태로 의례가 진행되었다.
articles.abstract_en: The The purpose of this paper is to examine the meaning of the difference between the two temples' rituals, which are formally performed in Haeinsa and Tongdosa on Dano Day. Dano, located in the middle of Jungyangjeol, was considered to be the day of the most full of energy. And it was found that it has the meaning of using seawater, that is, salt, the essence of yin(陰氣), to press this yang(陽氣).Since the majority of the buildings are wooden structures, temples are highly vulnerable to fire. In addition, the two temples differ in the procedure in which the ritual is carried out, and in the case of Haeinsa, since Gayasan Mountain is a stone mountain, in terms of feng shui geographyIn it is called ‘Hwaseong(火星)’, the ritual was performed by burying salt in the sense of “pressing the energy of fire ”. On the other hand, since Tongdosa is closely related to the ideology of a guardian dragon from its founding story, in the form of raising a salt on a beam to mean “soaking the temple” in the energy of the sea with the help of a guardian dragon.

articles.title_kr: 불교전래 이후 중국인의 죽음에 대한 발상전환에 대한 연구
articles.title_en: Conversion of Idea about the Death of Chinese after the Introduction of Buddhism
articles.abstract_kr: The idea of the death has been inevitable pain and fear for human beings. It is possible to say that religions had aroused from the fear for the end of one’s life and the unknown beyond of it.The fear had lead ancient East Asians to worship objects as hylozoism. Later the hylozoism had created gods. Each god had its own roles participating in human’s life and death. They had separated the quick and the dead very strictly.After Buddhism was spread to East Asia, the viewpoint on the dead has been changed to an object be prayed for from the one to be fearful of.As an example, the graves outside of the royal castle moved into the castle after Buddhism had accepted. People also built temples near the graves for memorial service.East Asians had embraced the Buddhist idea that life and death are not separated naturally. The acculturation of Buddhism and East Asian original cultures also changed the culture of funeral service.Buddhism had changed the idea of death to be a part of life in East Asia since it came into the region.

articles.title_kr: 내포지역(예산군·서산시·당진시) 문화유산의 특성과 연계 활용을 통한 가치 증진
articles.title_en: Characteristics of Cultural Heritages in Naepo(Yesan, Seosan, and Dangjin) and Value Enhancement through Linkage Utilization
articles.abstract_kr: Over the past 10 years, the use of cultural heritage has grown rapidly thanks to projects to utilize local cultural heritage. Opportunities to enjoy the value of cultural heritage have increased, and cultural heritage is also contributing to regional revitalization. On the other hand, the limitations of the use of cultural heritage are also clear: there are many cases where the essential meaning and value of cultural heritage cannot be approached, and there are many cultural heritage sites that do not receive attention even though they are of great historical and cultural value.In this study, I sought ways to utilize cultural heritage in three cities and counties in Naepo, including Yesan-gun, Seosan-si, and Dangjin-si. The purpose of this study is to examine the characteristics and the status of cultural heritage utilization of local cultural heritage, and to find a way to overcome the limitations that appear in the use of cultural heritage so far.
