articles.abstract_kr: 혜목산에서 시작된 현욱의 가풍(家風)이 왜 혜목산문으로 불리지 않고 봉림산문으로 불리게 되었을까? 이 ‘봉림’이라는 명칭에는 혜목의 가풍을 선양하고자 했던 심희의 의지가 깃들어 있다.신라하대에서 고려로 넘어가는 과도기의 세상에서 안정적으로 수행과 교화의 가풍을 펼칠 수 있는 입지는 흔하지 않았다. 단순한 지리적 입지의 선택이 아니라, 신라하대의 혼란기에서 재지(在地)세력과 왕실의 지원을 동시에 받을 수 있는 조건을 충족해야 했다. 신라하대부터 새롭게 등장한 선문(禪門) 대부분은 신라의 입지 혹은 고려의 입지 중 하나에만 부응하였다. 반면 현욱과 달리 왕조 교체 시기에 활동했던 제자 심희는 신라와 고려 두 왕조를 만족시킬 수 있는 입지 선정이 필요했다. 그런 점에서 창원 봉림사의 입지는 성공적이었다. 상족(上足)인 경질(景質)이 봉림산문을 지키는 가운데 심희의 다른 제자들이 고려에 귀부하였다. 심희는 말년에 가까운 시기에 제자들이 고려로 귀부하는 것에 대해 망설이지 않았던 것으로 보인다. 아니 처음부터 봉림사에 터전을 일군 까닭이 거기에 있었는지도 모른다. 심희는 흑암선원에 주석할 때부터 혜목의 가풍을 계승하는 문도들을 봉림(鳳林)이라 명명하고 있고, 창원에 터전을 일군 후에는 그 봉림을 산문의 이름으로 사용하고 있다. 혜목산문이 아니라 봉림산문으로 더 많이 불리게 된 이유가 여기에 있을 것이다.
articles.abstract_en: Why has the lineage tradition (gafeng 家風) that began with Hyeonuk on the Hyemok Mountain not come to be called the “Hyemok Mountain Lineage” (Hyemok Sanmun) but instead come to be known as the “Bongrim Mountain Lineage” (Bongrim Sanmun 鳳林山門)? The name “Bongrim” carries the strong intention of Simheui who wished to propagate and honor his teacher Hyemok’s tradition. In the turbulent transitional period from the late Silla to the early Goryeo dynasty, it was rare to find a location where a lineage of practice and teaching could be stably maintained. The choice was not merely geographical; in the chaotic final years of Silla, the place had to satisfy the conditions for receiving support simultaneously from both local powerful families and the royal house. Most of the new Seon lineages (seonmun 禪門) that emerged from the late Silla onward aligned with either the Silla dynasty or the Goryeo dynasty, but rarely both. In contrast, the disciple Simheui — who, unlike his teacher Hyeonuk, was active precisely during the dynastic transition — needed to select a location that could satisfy both the Silla and Goryeo courts. In this regard, the site of Bongrim-sa in Changwon proved remarkably appropriate. While his chief disciple Gyeongjil (景質) remained to guard the Bongrim lineage at the temple, Simheui’s other disciples submitted to the new Goryeo regime. It appears that Simheui, even late in life, did not hesitate when his disciples chose to join Goryeo. Or perhaps that very possibility was the reason he established a base at Bongrim-sa from the very beginning. Already while residing at Heuk’am Seonwon (Heuk’am Seon Center), Simheui had begun calling the disciples who inherited Hyemok’s tradition “Bongrim” disciples. After establishing his new center in Changwon, he came to use “Bongrim” as the official name of the mountain lineage. This, I believe, is the reason it became far more commonly known as the Bongnim Mountain Lineage rather than the Hyemok Mountain Lineage.

articles.title_kr: 주어사와 천진암에 대한 실체적 접근 - 조선 후기 지방 사찰의 존재 양태와 관련하여 -
articles.title_en: A Substantive Study of Jueosa and Cheonjinam:The Modes of Existence of Local Temples in Late Joseon
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 경기도 여주와 광주의 경계에 위치한 주어사와 천진암의 역사적 실체를 규명하고, 두 사찰이 조선 후기 지방 사찰의 존재 양태 속에서 어떤 의미를 지니는지 살피는 데 목적이 있다. 두 사찰은 18~19세기 고지도와 지방지에 서로 다른 방식으로 등장한다. 고지도와 『여지도서』에서는 천진암이 광주목의 사찰로 분명하게 표기되지만, 주어사는 사찰명으로는 보이지 않고 ‘주어산’이라는 산명으로만 나타난다. 이러한 차이는 천진암이 중앙정부의 행정 수요와 연결된 기능사찰이었음을 보여준다.실제로 『중정남한지』(1847)는 천진암이 사옹원에 종이를 납품하던 조지사(造紙寺)였음을 기록하며, 이는 천진암이 공적 업무를 수행한 사찰이었음을 입증하는 중요한 자료다. 반면 주어사는 중앙의 관찬 사료에서 거의 언급되지 않지만, 2022~2023년 발굴조사를 통해 17~18세기 건물지·기와·백자·숯가마 등 대규모 유구가 확인됨으로써, 상당한 사세를 갖춘 지역 중심 사찰이었음이 드러났다. 범자문 막새편과 ‘造瓦以主信’ 명문기와 등은 주어사가 지역 신도들의 시주를 받을 정도의 위신을 갖고 있음을 보여준다.한편 주어사는 1779년 권철신이 주도한 강학회의 장소로 기능하였다. 정약용의 묘비명 기록에 따르면 강학은 ‘천진암 주어사’에서 이루어졌으며 두 사찰이 하나의 생활권 내에서 상호 연계되어 있었다는 점을 시사하지만, 달레의 『한국천주교회사』가 전하는 이벽의 방문 기록과 정약옹이 천진암에 대하여 기술하는 분위기로 보아 강학회가 이루어진 거점 사찰은 주어사였던 것으로 드러난다. 주어사는 깊숙한 산중에 위치해 있어 조용한 독서와 강학에 적합했으며, 이는 조선 후기 문인들이 사찰에서 학문적 휴가를 보내던 상사독서(上寺讀書)의 전통과도 연결된다.종합하면, 천진암은 행정 기능을 담당한 관급 사찰로서 국가적 중요성을 지닌 반면, 주어사는 문헌에는 잘 드러나지 않지만 발굴 유물과 강학 활동 기록을 통해 지방 불교문화의 구심 역할을 담당했던 사찰로 평가된다. 두 사찰의 상반된 존재 양상은 조선 후기 지방 사찰이 한편으로는 국가 행정 체계 속 기능 사찰로, 다른 한편으로는 지역 문화 및 학문 활동의 중심 공간으로 자리하였음을 잘 보여준다. 본 연구는 이들 사찰의 실체를 지도·지방지·유물·문헌 등 다양한 자료를 종합하여 추적함으로써, 조선 후기 지방 불교사의 미시적 양상을 복원하는 데 기여하고자 한다.
articles.abstract_en: This study aims to clarify the historical substance of Jueosa and Cheonjinam, two temples located on the border between Yeoju and Gwangju in Gyeonggi-do, and to examine their significance within the modes of existence of local temples in late Joseon. The two temples appear differently in eighteenth and nineteenth century maps and local gazetteers: while Cheonjinam is consistently recorded as a temple under Gwangju in both old maps and the Yeojidoseo, Jueosa does not appear by its temple name but only as “Jueosan,” a mountain toponym. This discrepancy indicates that Cheonjinam functioned as a state-serving temple connected to administrative needs. In fact, Jungjeong Namhanji (1847) records that Cheonjinam was a papermaking temple (jojisa) supplying paper to the Royal Provisioning Office (Saongwon), thereby confirming its role as a temple performing public duties.In contrast, Jueosa is scarcely mentioned in central governmental sources, yet archaeological excavations conducted from 2022 to 2023 revealed extensive remains—building foundations, roof tiles, white porcelain shards, and charcoal kilns— dating to the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. These findings indicate that Jueosa was a sizable regional temple with considerable local support, further evidenced by artifacts such as beomja(Hindi letters)-decorated tiles and inscribed roof tiles reading “Made by Jusin”. (造瓦以主信, Jusin 主信 means a person who possesses faith.) Jueosa also served as the venue for the 1779 scholarly gathering led by Gwon Cheol-sin. Although Jeong Yak-yong’s epitaph states that the study sessions took place at “Cheonjinam and Jueosa,” suggesting close interaction within a shared local sphere, Dallet’s History of the Korean Catholic Church (Histoire de l’Église de Corée) and Jeong Yak-yong’s descriptions regarding Cheonjinam imply that the primary site of the gathering was in fact Jueosa. Its deep mountain location made it suitable for quiet study and scholarly retreat, aligning with the Joseon’s time-honored tradition of sangsa dokseo (上寺讀書), in which literati sought secluded temples for concentrated study.In sum, Cheonjinam functioned as a state-affiliated institutional temple of administrative importance, whereas Jueosa —though scarcely visible in written records— served as a cultural and intellectual center of the local Buddhist community, as demonstrated by archaeological findings and the 1779 scholarly activities. The contrasting modes of existence of these two temples reveal that local temples in late Joseon could operate either as functional organs of the state or as regional cultural and academic hubs. By synthesizing maps, gazetteers, archaeological data, and textual sources, this study contributes to reconstructing the micro-historical landscape of local Buddhist communities in late Joseon.

articles.title_kr: 봉림사 창건의 지리·교류사적 배경에 대한 고찰
articles.title_en: A Study on the Geographical and Cultural Exchanging Background of the Founding of Bongnim Temple
articles.abstract_kr: 신라의 구산선문 가운데 봉림산문은 그 개산의 위치와 개산조에 대한 논의가 계속 진행되고 있는 유일한 선문이라 할 수 있다. 본 논문에서는 이에 대한 논의를 다른 각도에서 접근하여 규명하였다. 첫째는 신라 하대 봉림사가 개창된 배경에 중국 남종선 가운데서도 특히 장경회휘 계통이 갖는 특수성의 측면을 부각하여 개산조에 대한 논의를 진행한다. 둘째는 봉림사의 위치가 당시 지리적·교류사적 측면에서 어떤 의미를 갖고 있는가에 대한 접근을 통해 봉림산문 개산의 위치를 규명하였다. 특히 신라의 왕경 위치와 왕경에서 9주로 뻗어나가는 당시의 주요도로였던 오통(五通)의 각 도로가 갖는 주요 의미를 분석하여 봉림사의 위치가 갖는 의미에 접근하였다.또한 그 과정에서 9세기 말엽 일정하게 형성되어 왕경의 불교문화로 정착되는 문화적 형상화의 변화양상을 반영하여 봉선산문이 당시 어떠한 부분까지 염두에 둔 개산을 하였는가도 살펴보았다. 그리고 이에 따라 신라 하대 구산선문이 갖는 의미에 대한 기존의 일반화된 시각, 즉 호족과 밀접한 관계성을 강조하는 선종이라는 시각과 차별화된 다른 시각을 제안함으로써 구산선문에 대한 다양한 접근의 가능성을 제안하였다.
articles.abstract_en: Among the Nine Mountains Seon Schools(Gusan Seonmun) of Silla, the Bongnim School(Bongnim Sanmun) is the only one that discussion about is founding location and founding master is still ongoing.This paper approaches this discussion from different perspectives.First, the discussion on the the founding master is proceed by focusing on the unique characteristic of the lineage of Zhangjing Huizhao as the background for the foundation of Bongnim Temple in the late Silla peroid.Second, the location of the founding Bongnim School is analyzed by approaching the geographical and exchange-historical signification of the location of Bongnim Temple. Specifically, the significance of Bongnim Temple's location is studied focusing on the major meanings of the capital city's (Wanggyeong) position and the Five Main Routes(O-tong) that were extending from the capital to the Nine Provinces (9-ju) at the time of Silla.Furthermore, the study examined how far the Bongnim School considered at the time of foundation based on the change of the cultural configuration when the Seon Schools were established and settled as the Buddhist culture of Wanggyeong at the end of the 9th century.This paper suggests the possibility of diverse approaches to the meaning of the Nine Mountains Seon Schools in the late Silla period by proposing a different viewpoint from the existing generalized perspective which has emphasized the close bonding with the local gentry called Hojok.

articles.title_kr: ‘지혜 기반 경제학’의 가능성 - 불교경제학의 정체성과 대안경제학으로의 가능성 -
articles.title_en: A Study on the Possibility of ‘Wisdom-Based Economics’: The Identity of Buddhist Economics and Its Potential as an Alternative Economics
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 불교의 가르침을 경제학에 접목한 불교경제학의 정체성과 대안경제학의 가능성을 살펴본다. 이를 슈마허 이후의 현대 불교경제학을 사례로 분석한다. 연구의 첫 번째 목적은 불교가 경제와 무관하다는 편견을 없애는 것이다. 두 번째 목적은 불교경제학이 복합위기의 대안이 될 수 있을지를 확인하는 것이다. 연구 방법은 불교경제학 선행연구에 관한 문헌 연구를 중심으로 한다. 연구의 순서는 다음과 같다. 먼저 불교와 경제, 불교 자본주의의 관계를 살펴본다. 다음으로 불교경제학의 정체성과 불교경제학과 기존의 주류경제학을 비교한다. 그리고 불교경제학의 전개과정을 살펴본다. 마지막으로 불교경제학의 기여와 과제를 살펴보면서 지혜 기반 경제학의 가능성을 알아본다. 연구 결과 불교에는 현대사회가 직면한 복합위기에서 벗어날 가능성이 있고, 불교의 가르침을 기반으로 한 불교경제학은 지혜 기반 경제학의 가능성이 있다는 점을 확인했다.
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the identity of Buddhist economics, which integrates Buddhist teachings into economics, and the potential of alternative economics. This is examined through the case of modern Buddhist economics after Schumacher. The first objective of this study is to dispel the prejudice that Buddhism is unrelated to economy. The second objective is to examine whether Buddhist economics can serve as an alternative to complex crises. The research method is centered on a literature review of prior research on Buddhist economics. The research is structured as follows: first, we examine the relationship between Buddhism, the economy, and Buddhist capitalism. Next, we examine the identity of Buddhist economics and compare it with mainstream economics. Next, we examine the development of Buddhist economics. Finally, we examine the contributions and challenges of Buddhist economics and explore the potential of wisdom-based economics. The research results confirmed that Buddhism holds the potential to overcome the complex crises facing modern society, and that Buddhist economics, based on Buddhist teachings, holds the potential for wisdom-based economics.

articles.title_kr: 사회적 고통의 진단틀로서 연기 - 초기불교 사회화 이론의 시론 -
articles.title_en: Conditioned Co-arising as a Diagnostic Framework for Social Suffering: A Preliminary Theory of Socialization in Early Buddhism
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구의 목표는 사회적 고통의 진단틀로서 연기(緣起, paṭiccasamuppāda)를 재조명하는 것이다. 초기불교 사회성 논의에서 비-사회적 해석과 사회적 해석의 분기점은 연기에 대한 서로 다른 이해에서 비롯된 것으로 파악된다. 비-사회적 해석은 실재론적 관점에서 연기의 윤회를 강조하고, 사회적 해석은 상호의존 연기 해석에 그 기반을 두고 있기 때문이다. 그러나 초기불교에서 연기는 조건들로부터 고통(苦, dukkha)의 발생을 설명한 것이다. 본 연구는 고통의 진단틀로서 연기를 재조명함으로써, 개인과 사회를 아우르는 고통의 구조에 적용이 가능한 연기의 법 체계를 드러내고자 한다. 연기의 법 체계는 다음과 같이 4중 중첩 구조로 분석된다. 첫째, ‘식·명색(識·名色)과 12입처(入處)·6식(識)’의 중첩이다. 이는 범부의 인식론적 구조를 드러낸다. 둘째, ‘무명(無明)부터 촉(觸)’까지의 ‘오온(五蘊)과 오취온(五取蘊)’의 중첩이다. 이는 범부의 존재론을 해명한다. 셋째, ‘연기와 연이생(緣已生)’의 중첩이다. 이는 과거·현재의 중첩으로서 존재 추구의 구조를 드러낸다. 넷째, ‘유위(有爲)와 행(行)’의 중첩이다. 이는 경험의 자기-구성과 개인과 사회의 중첩을 드러낸다. 4중 중첩은 범부가 지닌 인식, 습성, 욕망, 취착 등의 법칙들로부터 고통이 어떻게 발생하는지를 메타적으로 설명한다. 특히 행은 삼계(三界)의 세계관에서 개인과 사회의 프랙탈적 구조를 보인다. 왜냐하면 삼천대천세계(三千大千世界)는 각각 모든 중생들의 수없이 많은 세계를 나타내면서도 다시 하나의 삼계로 포섭되는 특성을 보이기 때문이다. 또한 Mahānidāna경에서는 개인의 생·노사의 고통 뿐만 아니라 사회적 다툼과 분쟁이 모두 연기의 갈애에 기반을 둔 것이라고 설명하는데, 이는 연기에 대한 이해로부터 공동체적 가치를 지향해야 함을 밝힌 것이다. 따라서 초기불교에서 연기는 개인적·사회적 고통의 진단틀로 이해할 수 있고, 이러한 이해는 초기불교 사회화 이론을 구성하는 시론적 기초가 된다.
articles.abstract_en: The primary objective of this study is to re-examine conditioned 'co-arising' (緣起, paṭiccasamuppāda) as a diagnostic framework for social suffering. In the discussion regarding the social nature of Early Buddhism, the divergence between non-social and social interpretations is understood to stem from differing perspectives on paṭiccasamuppāda. This is because the non-social interpretation emphasizes the cycle of Saṃsāra from a realistic standpoint, whereas the social interpretation is grounded in the understanding of paṭiccasamuppāda as mutual interdependence. However, in early Buddhism, paṭiccasamuppāda explains the arising of suffering (苦, dukkha) from conditions. By re-examining paṭiccasamuppāda as a diagnostic framework for suffering, this study aims to reveal its systematic legal structure, applicable to the architecture of suffering encompassing both the individual and society. The framework of paṭiccasamuppāda can be analyzed as the following fourfold overlapping structure. First, the overlap between ‘consciousness-name·form’ (viññāṇa-nāmarūpa) and ‘the twelve sense bases-six consciousnesses.’ (12 āyatana-6 viññāṇa) This reveals the epistemological structure of the ordinary person. Second, the overlap of ‘the five aggregates and the five aggregates subject to clinging’ (pañcakkhandha- pañcupādānakkhandhā) from ‘ignorance’ to ‘contact’. This elucidates the ontology of the ordinary person. Third, the overlap of ‘paṭiccasamuppāda and conditionally co-arisen.’ (paṭiccasamuppāda-paṭiccasamuppanna). This reveals the structure of existence-seeking as an overlap of past and present. Fourth, the overlap of 'the conditioned (saṅkhata) and formations (saṅkhāra).' This reveals the self-construction of experience and the overlap of the individual and society. The fourfold overlap meta-explicates how suffering arises from the ordinary person's laws of cognition, habits, desires, and clinging. Furthermore, formations (saṅkhāra) reveal the fractal structure of the individual and society within the worldview of the three realms (ti-dhātu). This is because the three-thousand-fold great thousand world-system (trisāhasramahāsāhasralokadhātu) represents the innumerable worlds of all sentient beings while simultaneously being subsumed within a single threefold realm. Additionally, in the Mahānidāna Sutta, it is explained that not only the individual suffering of birth and aging-and-death but also social quarrels and conflicts are all based on craving (taṅhā) within paṭiccasamuppāda. This illustrates that an understanding of paṭiccasamuppāda should orient us toward communal values. Therefore, in early Buddhism, dependent origination can be understood as a diagnostic framework for individual and social suffering, and this understanding forms the prototypical foundation for a theory of socialization in early Buddhism.
keywords_en: Theory of Socialisation in Early Buddhism

articles.title_kr: 『유가사지론』의 아뢰야식 존재논증에 대하여 - 안위동일(Ekayogakṣema)을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: A Study on the Proof of Ālayavijñāna in the Yogācārabhūmi: Focus on the Issue of Ekayogakṣema
articles.abstract_kr: 『유가사지론』의 ｢섭결택분｣ 서두에는 여덟 가지 관점으로 아뢰야식의 존재를 논증하는 최초의 아뢰야식 존재논증이 기술되어 있다. 이 아뢰야식 존재논증에 관한 종래의 연구는 슈미트하우젠에 의한 아뢰야식 기원에 대한 연구가 이루어진 이후는 물론 이전의 연구에서도 아뢰야식의 가장 중요한 기능으로 생물학적 집수작용을 꼽는다.이러한 연구성과는 유가행파가 도입한 새로운 식에 관한 존재논증에서 여러 이명 가운데 ｢아다나식｣이 아닌 ｢아뢰야식｣이라는 식명을 사용한 데 대한 의문이 들게 함은 물론, 타부파 사상과의 비교·분석 연구를 통한 차별성 및 우수성을 찾아보기 어렵다. 즉, 각 논증에 명시된 기능 분석 위주로 평가된 종래의 연구로는 아뢰야식을 도입하게 된 배경 혹은 ｢아뢰야식｣이라는 식명을 사용하게 된 이유를 가늠할 수가 없다.따라서, 본 연구에서는 먼저 기존의 아뢰야식 원의 및 정의와 관련한 연구를 살펴봄으로써, 아뢰야식의 상징성이 명상 수행으로 얻어지는 심의 변화를 가져오는, 심신 간의 메커니즘에 있음을 추론하였다. 그리고, 다음으로 타부파 가운데서도, 특히 설일체유부의 유집수, 명근, 중유, 그리고 출정 시 즉시 얻게 되는 공덕 등을 아뢰야식 존재논증에서 보여주는 여덟 가지 식의 존재 관점에서 비교·분석하였다.그 결과, 아뢰야식 존재논증에서 보여주는 아뢰야식의 가장 중요한 기능적 측면이 명상 수행 시 신체와의 안위동일한 관계를 통해 심을 경안, 궁극적으로 열반으로 이끄는 데에 있음을 명백히 하였다. 아뢰야식의 여러 기능 중 결생상속, 생리적 유지, 이숙 등은 타부파에서도 이와 관련한 유사 사상이 존재하지만, 명상 수행으로 즉시 얻게 되는 심의 변화 즉 공덕의 측면에서는 타부파는 한계성을 지니고 있는 부분이었다. 요컨대, 안위동일한 심신 간의 관계가 지니는 프로세스는 현재유체 과미무체설에 따른 것으로 현생에서 수행으로 얻을 수 있는 공덕에 대한 이론적 근거를 마련한 것이었다.
articles.abstract_en: At the beginning of the Viniścayasaṃgrahanī as a part of the Yogācārabhūmi, the ontological evidence for ālayavijñāna, namly, Proof Portion, which demonstrates the existence of ālayavijñāna from eight perspectives, is described. This conventional study on the Proof Portion has selected its function of biological appropriation(i.e. upādāna) as the most important function of ālayavijñāna not only after Schmithausen's study of the origin of ālayavijñāna was conducted, but also in previous studies.These research results not only raise questions about the use of the name ‘ālayavijñāna’ rather than ‘ādānavijñāna’ among various names in the ontological evidence for a new vijñāna introduced by Yogācāra, but also make it difficult to find the differentiation and superiority of ālayavijñāna through comparative and analysis studies with other traditional schools’ thought. In other words, it is impossible to determine the background of the introduction of ādānavijñāna or the reason for using the name ‘ādānavijñāna’ with conventional studies evaluated mainly on functional analsys specified in each proof.Therefore, in this study, first of all through meditation training by examining the original meaning and definition of ālayavijñāna, we deduced that the symbolism of ālayavijñāna is the mechanism between mind and body, resulting from the change in mind. Next, among other traditonal schools, in particular, upātta, jīvitindriya, antarābhava, merits obtained immediately after meditation, etc of the Sarvāstivādins were compared and analyzed from the perspective of the eight existence of ālayavijñāna, which is shown in the Proof Portion.As a result, it was made clear that the most important functional aspect of ālayavijñāna shown in the Proof Portion lies in leading the citta to praśrabdhi and ultimately leading to nirvāṇa through an ekayogakṣema relationship with the body during meditation. Among the various functions of ālayavijñāna, similar ideas related to pratisandhi, physiological manintenance, vipāka, etc, could be found in other traditional schools, but there were limitations in other traditional schools in the case of a change of mind immediately gained through meditation, a kind of merit. In short, the process shown by the same relationship between the mind and body was based on the theory that present is real, past and future are unreal, and provided a theoretical basis for the merit that can be obtained from meditation training in the present life.

articles.title_kr: 백일 법문에 나타난 퇴옹 성철의 중도(中道) 해석 연구
articles.title_en: A Study on Toe-ong Seong-cheol’s Interpretation of the Middle Path In Baegil Beomun
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 퇴옹 성철의 백일 법문에 나타난 중도 해석을 중심으로, 성철이 불교 교설 전반을 어떠한 관점에서 체계적으로 이해하고 제시하였는지를 고찰한다. 백일 법문은 초기 불교에서부터 천태·화엄·선종에 이르는 방대한 전통을 포괄하면서도, 중도(中道)를 하나의 핵심 범주로 삼아 불교 사상 전체를 회통하려는 시도가 집약된 법문으로 평가된다. 이러한 특징에 주목하여, 성철의 중도 이해가 특정 종파나 교설에 국한되지 않고 불교 전통 전반을 관통하는 근본 인식 구조로 제시되고 있다는 점을 분석하고자 한다. 먼저 초기 불교 부분에서는 성철이 초전법륜에서 설해진 중도를 불교의 핵심 교설로 파악하고, 이를 욕락과 고행이라는 두 극단을 떠난 가르침으로 설명하는 동시에 연기(緣起)를 중도의 핵심적 표현으로 이해한다는 데 초점을 두고 고찰하였다. 성철은 연기의 순관(順觀)과 역관(逆觀)을 통해 유(有)와 무(無)의 양변을 동시에 여의는 인식이 곧 중도이며, 이는 정견(正見)의 확립을 통해 가능하다고 본다. 이러한 해석은 중도를 단지 수행 방법이나 실천 항목에 한정하는 이해가 아니라, 세계를 여실하게 인식하는 근본 관점으로 재정립하려는 시도로 이해될 수 있다. 이어 천태와 화엄 부분에서는 성철이 각각 천태의 공(空)·가(假)·중(中) 삼제원융(三諦圓融)과 화엄의 사사무애(事事無礙) 법계를 중도 원리의 교학적 전개로 해석하고 있다는 점을 검토하였다. 성철에게 천태와 화엄의 교설은 표현과 체계는 다르지만, 연기에 대한 올바른 통찰이라는 공통의 중도 원리를 공유하며, 중도를 절충이나 타협의 개념으로 이해하는 해석을 비판하며, 양변을 동시에 차단하고 동시에 포섭하는 지혜의 구조로 설명한다. 마지막으로, 선종 부분에서는 성철이 선종을 교학과 단절된 수행 전통으로 보지 않고, 붓다가 설한 중도의 심인(心印)을 수행의 현장에서 직접 증득해 온 전통으로 파악하고 있다는 것을 논의하였다. 『육조단경』과 마조의 평상심(平常心), 조사선의 어록 전통에 대한 해석을 통해, 성철은 선종의 핵심 역시 유(有)·무(無), 범(凡)·성(聖) 등의 분별을 여의는 중도 정견의 확립에 있다는 것을 강조한다. 이상과 같이 본 논문은 성철의 백일 법문에 나타난 중도 해석이 초기 불교를 출발점으로 하여 천태·화엄·선종에 이르기까지 일관되게 전개되고 있음을 밝힘으로써, 중도가 불교 교학과 수행을 관통하는 보편 원리로 제시되고 있음을 확인한다. 이는 근·현대 한국 불교 사상사에서 성철의 백일 법문이 지니는 이론적 의의를 재조명하는 데 기여할 것이다.
articles.abstract_en: This article examines Toe-ong Seong-cheol’s interpretation of the Middle Path as presented in his Baegil Beomun (Sermon of One Hundred Days), with particular attention to how he systematically understands and articulates Buddhist teachings as a whole from this perspective. The Baegil Beomun encompasses a wide range of traditions—from Early Buddhism to Cheontae (Tiantai), Hwaeom (Huayan), and Seon (Chan, Zen)—while consistently organizing them around the category of the Middle Path. Taking this characteristic as its point of departure, the present study analyzes how Seong-cheol presents the Middle Path not as a doctrine confined to a particular school, but as a fundamental cognitive structure that informs the entirety of the Buddhist tradition.In the section on Early Buddhism, this paper examines Seong-cheol’s interpretation of the Middle Path taught in the First Turning of the Wheel of Dharma. He understands it as a teaching that departs from the two extremes of sensual indulgence and ascetic self-mortification, while further presenting dependent origination as a central expression of the Middle Path. For Seong-cheol, the Middle Path consists in a mode of cognition that relinquishes attachment to both existence and non-existence, made possible through the establishment of Right View. In this sense, the Middle Path is understood not as an understanding confined to methods of practice or practical disciplines, but as a fundamental perspective for perceiving reality as it truly is.The sections on Cheontae and Hwaeom examine Seong-cheol’s interpretation of  Cheontae's doctrine of the perfect interfusion of the Three Truths(emptiness, provisional existence, and the middle) and Hwaeom’s teaching of the realm of mutual non-obstruction as doctrinal articulations of the Middle Path principle. Although differing in expression and systematic formulation, these traditions are understood to share a common orientation grounded in insight into dependent origination. Seong-cheol explicitly rejects interpretations of the Middle Path as compromise or moderation, instead describing it as a form of wisdom that simultaneously negates and encompasses both extremes.The discussion of Seon examines how Seong-cheol understands it not as a practice tradition separate from doctrinal Buddhism, but as a lineage that seeks to realize the mind-seal of the Middle Path taught by the Buddha. Through his interpretations of the Platform Sūtra, Mazu’s teaching of “ordinary mind” (pingchang xin), and the discourse records of the patriarchal Seon tradition, he emphasizes that the core of Seon lies in the establishment of Right View grounded in the Middle Path transcending dualistic distinctions such as existence and non-existence or the mundane and the sacred.In conclusion, this study demonstrates that in Seong-cheol’s Baegil Beomun, the Middle Path is consistently articulated from Early Buddhism through Cheontae, Hwaeom, and Seon, thereby presenting it as a universal principle that informs both Buddhist doctrine and practice. In doing so, the article contributes to a renewed understanding of the theoretical significance of Seong-cheol’s Baegil Beomun within the broader context of modern Korean Buddhist thought.

articles.title_kr: 조선시대 사찰계의 고려 결사 전통 계승과 변용- 수행 토대의 지속과 변형을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: Joseon Temple Associations (Sachal-gye) and the Reconfiguration of Goryeo Buddhist Associational Traditions: Jeonghye and Baengnyeon Legacies in Continuity and Change
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 조선시대 불교 결사체의 존속 양상을 사찰계(契)·회(會)를 중심으로 고찰하고, 고려시대 결사 전통과의 계승 및 변용 관계의 분석이다. 한국불교의 결사는 삼국시대 이래 공동체적 신행의 흐름 속에서 전개되었으며, 고려 후기에는 지눌의 정혜결사와 요세의 백련결사가 수행 중심의 대표적 결사로 체계화되었다. 그러나 조선시대에는 억불정책과 전란의 반복으로 교단 기반이 급격히 약화되면서, 고려와 같은 수행 결사 형태가 지속되기 어려운 조건이 형성되었다. 이에 조선불교의 계·회는 사찰의 중창과 보수, 불구 마련, 경전 간행, 의례 운영 등 사찰 존립을 위한 경제 및 조직적 기반을 우선하여 확보하는 방식으로 변용된 결사체였다.본 연구는 조선시대 사찰계·회의 운영 사례를 통해 기반의 조성을 필두로 수행과 교화라는 본래 목적 달성에서 나아가, 재정의 보충과 재투자로 이어지는 선순환 구조를 도출하고, 이것이 단순한 재화 축적 조직을 넘어 수행과 포교라는 불교 교단의 주요 기능을 유지하기 위한 실천 원칙 아래 작동하였음을 논증한다. 결론적으로 조선시대 사찰계는 고려 결사 전통의 수행 정신을 제한된 조건 속에서 지속시키면서도, 시대적 요구에 따라 조직 운영의 초점을 재정 및 제도적 기반으로 이동시킨 변용의 결과였으며, 이는 근현대 사찰 운영 체계의 이해에도 유효한 역사적 시사점을 제공한다.
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the continuity and transformation of Buddhist associative organizations in the Joseon dynasty, with particular attention to the emergence and development of temple-based associations (sachal-gye, 寺刹契) as a pragmatic mode of sustaining the Buddhist community under adverse political and social conditions. While the concept of gye (契) is widely discussed in studies of late Joseon local society and economic history, its Buddhist forms have often been treated as peripheral or reduced to informal financial groups. This paper argues that temple-based gye should be understood not merely as economic cooperatives but as institutional mechanisms that enabled the restoration and maintenance of Buddhist monastic infrastructure and the continuation of religious functions.By analyzing a broad range of epigraphic and documentary sources—including temple association registers, dedicatory inscriptions, and compilations preserved in digital archives—this study reconstructs the organizational purposes and operational logic of Joseon temple associations. The findings demonstrate that many temple-based gye were established to secure material foundations necessary for monastic survival: rebuilding halls, repairing temple facilities, acquiring ritual implements, and financing printed scriptures or devotional icons. These activities, however, were not ends in themselves; rather, they created the conditions for sustaining Buddhist practice and propagation amid prolonged institutional suppression and the aftermath of repeated warfare.Furthermore, this paper situates Joseon temple associations within a longer tradition of Korean Buddhist reform movements by briefly revisiting the two influential Goryeo-period precedents—Jinul’s Samādhi and Prajñā Community (Jeonghye-gyeolsa, 定慧結社) and Yose’s White Lotus Society (Baengnyeon-gyeolsa, 白蓮結社). Although Joseon associations differed in form and historical motivation, they retained key elements of earlier communal religious efforts: the prioritization of practice-oriented discipline, the integration of devotional traditions, and the pursuit of communal stability through organized participation of both monastic and lay members. Ultimately, this study proposes that the transformation from the explicit “sangha reform movement” of the Goryeo period to the infrastructural and organizational strategies of Joseon temple associations reflects not decline, but adaptive continuity, revealing how Korean Buddhism reconfigured its institutional resilience under state-imposed constraints.

articles.title_kr: 인도불교 성지의 개념 정립과 성지순례의 의미 - 성지의 정립에서부터 상월결사 순례까지 -
articles.title_en: The Formation of the Concept of Sacred Sites in Indian Buddhism and the Meaning of Pilgrimage : From the Establishment of Sacred Sites to the Sangwol Association(霜月結社) Pilgrimage
articles.abstract_kr: 불교 성지의 시작은 붓다의 열반을 기록하고 있는 초기의 열반 문헌에서부터 확인된다. 그러나 여기에는 붓다의 열반지인 쿠시나가르가 등장하는 등 후대에 재편된 양상이 존재한다.본 고에서는 인도불교의 8대 성지가 어떠한 관점에서 성립되어, 초기의 4가지가 어떻게 8가지로 확대된 것인지를 정리했다. 또 불교 성지의 확립 과정에서 전 인도를 최초로 통일한 군주이자, 불교의 최고 후원자였던 아소카왕의 역할이 존재한다는 점도 분명히 했다. 아소카왕은 당시 고승인 우바국다의 인도하에 성지순례를 직접 감행했고, 이 과정에 성지의 표지석으로 아소카 석주를 건립하게 된다. 이는 후일 발굴 과정에서 불교 성지가 확정되는 중요한 증거가 된다.인도 성지 및 성지순례와 관련해 또 한 명의 중요한 인물은 중국 승려인 현장이다. 현장은 출발 전인 당나라에서부터 붓다의 유적지 중 ‘상카시아의 하늘 계단’과 ‘부다가야의 보리수’를 친견하기 발원한 고승이다. 특히 그가 남긴 기행문인 『대당서역기大唐西域記』와 『자은전慈恩傳』은 기록이 부족한 인도불교 유적의 의미와 위치를 알게 해주는 중요한 자료가 된다. 이는 1896년부터 인도불교의 유적들이 새롭게 재발견되는 과정에서 막대한 역할을 한다.인도불교의 성지순례는 유적들의 발굴 성과와 더불어 불교가 강한 동아시아와 동남아시아 불교도들에 의해 지속적으로 진행되었다. 이 중에서 한국불교와 관련해서는 2023년 상월결사의 인도순례가 주목된다. 이 순례는 108명이 참여해 총 43일에 걸쳐 1,167㎞를 걸은 인도 성지순례의 대장정이기 때문이다.
articles.abstract_en: The origins of Buddhist sacred sites can be traced back to early nirvāṇa (涅槃) texts that recorded the Buddha’s passing away. However, these texts seem to have later rearrangements, such as the appearance of Kuśinagara, where the Buddha got his nirvāṇa.This paper examines from what perspectives the Eight Great Sacred Sites of Indian Buddhism were established and how the original 4 sites were expanded into 8. It also clarifies the crucial role of King Aśoka, the first ruler to unify all of India and the foremost patron of Buddhism, in the process of establishing Buddhist sacred sites. Guided by the eminent monk Upagupta, Aśoka personally undertook pilgrimages to these sites and erected Aśokan pillars as markers of the sacred places. Later, these pillars became key evidence in identifying Buddhist sacred sites during modern archaeological excavations.Another important figure in relation to Indian Buddhist sacred sites and pilgrimage is the Chinese monk Xuanzang(玄奘). Even before departing from Tang China, Xuanzang vowed to personally visit the Buddha’s relic sites, including the “Heavenly Stairway of Sāṃkāśya” and the “Bodhi Tree(菩提樹) of Buddhagayā.” In particular, his travelogue Great Tang Records on the Western Regions(大唐西域記) and Biography of the Monk Xuanzang(慈恩傳) are invaluable sources for understanding the locations and significance of Indian Buddhist sites, which otherwise had lacked sufficient records. These works played a major role in the rediscovery of Indian Buddhist remains that started in 1896.Pilgrimage to Indian Buddhist sacred sites has continued alongside archaeological discoveries, carried out by Buddhists from East and Southeast Asia, where Buddhism remains prevalent. In relation to Korean Buddhism, the 2023 Indian pilgrimage of the Sangwol Association(霜月結社) deserves special attention. This was a monumental pilgrimage in which 108 participants walked a total of 1,167 kilometers over 43 days through India’s Buddhist sacred sites.

articles.title_kr: 임제선 명상- 수행사상에 기반한 체험형 명상 프로그램의 이론적 연구 -
articles.title_en: Imje Seon Meditation: A Theoretical Study on an Experiential Meditation Program Based on Practice Philosophy
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구의 목적은 현대 명상 프로그램이 임상 및 교육 현장에서 심리치료적 유용성을 확보해 온 과정에서, 상대적으로 간과되어 온 심리주의적 환원의 한계를 비판적으로 검토하고, 그 대안으로 임제선(臨濟禪) 수행 사상에 기반한 체험형 명상 프로그램의 이론적 타당성과 구성 가능성을 탐색하는 것이다. 이를 위해 문헌 분석을 중심으로 『진주임제혜조선사어록 鎭州臨濟慧照禪師語錄』 등 주요 원전을 검토하여, 임제선의 핵심 선리인 무위진인(無位眞人), 살불살조(殺佛殺祖), 수처작주(隨處作主), 입처개진(立處皆眞)이 지닌 수행론적 의미를 심층적으로 분석하였다.연구 결과, 임제선은 자아 해체를 통해 ‘참된 주체(眞人)’로의 급진적인 존재 전환을 지향한다. 이는 심리적 안정과 증상 완화에 초점을 맞춘 현대 명상 프로그램의 목표, 방법론, 실천 범위와 본질적으로 구분된다. 이에 본 연구는 무위진인과 살불살조를 ‘철학적 기반 원리’로, 수처작주와 입처개진을 ‘실천적 기반 원리’로 각각 조작적으로 정의하고, 이를 통해 임제선 수행 사상을 체험형 명상 프로그램으로 재구성하기 위한 구조적 원리를 체계화하였다. 그리고 이러한 원리를 바탕으로 총 6회기 프로그램(요약표 및 대표 회기)을 탐색적으로 제시하였다.본 연구는 임제선 수행의 존재론적 깊이가 현대 명상 담론의 철학적, 실천적 지평을 개념 수준에서 확장할 수 있음을 이론적으로 제시했다는 점에서 학술적 의의를 가진다. 그러나 본 연구는 탐색적 프로그램 설계에 한정되며, 제안된 프로그램의 효과성에 대한 실증적 검증을 포함하지는 않는다. 향후 연구에서는 통제 집단 비교 연구와 심층 면담 분석을 통해 임제선 기반 프로그램의 고유한 효과성을 규명할 필요가 있다. 따라서 본 연구는 결과 중심의 중재 효과를 검증하는 연구가 아니라, 개념적 프로그램 설계를 제시한 이론적 탐색 연구로 이해되어야 한다.
articles.abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to critically examine the limitations of psychologistic reductionism that have been relatively overlooked in the process by which contemporary meditation programs have secured psychotherapeutic utility in clinical and educational settings, and to explore, as an alternative, the theoretical validity and structural feasibility of an experiential meditation program grounded in the practice philosophy of Imje Seon Meditation. To this end, the study employs a literature-based methodology, examining major primary sources such as The Record of Linji (鎭州臨濟慧照禪師語錄), and conducts an in-depth analysis of the soteriological and practical meanings of the core teachings of Imje Seon: Muwi Jin-in(無位眞人), Salbul Saljo(殺佛殺祖), Sucheo Jakju(隨處作主), and Ipcheo Gaejin(立處皆眞).The findings indicate that Imje Seon fundamentally aims at a radical ontological transformation toward the “true subject”(眞人) through the deconstruction of the ego. This orientation is essentially distinct from contemporary meditation programs that focus on psychological stability and symptom alleviation, in terms of their goals, methodologies, and scope of practice. Accordingly, this study operationally defines Muwi Jin-in and Salbul Saljo as “philosophical foundational principles,” and Sucheo Jakju and Ipcheo Gaejin as “practical foundational principles,” thereby systematizing the structural logic required to reconstruct Imje Seon practice philosophy as an experiential meditation program. Based on these principles, the study exploratorily proposes a six-session program, including a summary table and representative sessions.The academic significance of this study lies in its theoretical demonstration that the ontological depth of Imje Seon practice can conceptually expand the philosophical and practical horizons of contemporary meditation discourse. However, this study is limited to an exploratory program design and does not include empirical verification of the proposed program’s effectiveness. Future research should seek to identify the distinctive effects of Imje Seon–based programs through controlled comparative studies and in-depth qualitative interviews. Accordingly, this study should be understood not as an outcome-oriented intervention study, but as a theoretical and exploratory investigation that presents a conceptual framework for experiential meditation program design.

articles.title_kr: 소리명상과 茶音(차를 따를 때 나는 소리)을 활용한 이근원통 수행 연구
articles.title_en: A Study on the Practice of Ear-Organ Perfect Penetration (耳根圓通) through Sound Meditation and Tea Sound (茶音, the Sound Produced When Pouring Tea) in Modern Meditative Context
articles.abstract_kr: This study aims to explore the application of contemporary sound meditation and tea sound (茶音, the sound produced when pouring tea) as meditative mediums grounded in the principle of Ear-Organ Perfect Penetration (Igeunwontong, 耳根圓通). Sound meditation is a modern practice that cultivates inner tranquility through awareness of external sounds, while tea sound represents the experience of auditory concentration and oneness of mind that arises naturally from the act of pouring tea.Ear-Organ Perfect Penetration, as presented in the Śūraṅgama Sūtra, describes the Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara’s meditative practice focusing on the faculty of hearing (ear-organ) among the six faculties (ṣaḍāyatana), emphasizing the process of “turning the hearing inward to perceive one’s self-nature” (fanwen wensheng, 反聞聞性). In this way, sound meditation, tea sound, and Igeunwontong share a common foundation in “sound.” Through this connection, sound meditation cultivates concentration and emotional stability, tea sound unites action and mind, and Igeunwontong leads the practitioner toward enlightenment through listening to one’s self-nature via sound.This research anticipates that by integrating sound meditation and tea sound, the practice of Ear-Organ Perfect Penetration can become more accessible and practicable for modern individuals within daily life and contemporary meditation culture.
keywords_en: Tea Sound (茶音 the sound produced when pouring tea)
Fanwen Wensheng (反聞聞性 turning the hearing inward to perceive one’s self-nature)

articles.title_kr: 금강승 뚬모(Tummo)의 체온 조절과 신경인지 기제 - 나로육법 전통과 현대 뇌과학의 통합적 분석 -
articles.title_en: Thermoregulation and Neurocognitive Mechanisms in Vajrayāna Tummo: An Integrative Analysis of the Nāropa’s Six Yogas Tradition and Modern Neuroscience
articles.abstract_kr: This study aims to elucidate the mechanisms of thermoregulation and neurocognition in Tummo (Inner Heat Yoga), a meditative practice within the Vajrayāna tradition of Tibetan Buddhism, through an integrative analysis of traditional doctrinal sources and modern neuroscientific evidence. The theoretical component examines the position of Tummo within the Six Yogas of Nāropa, focusing on Tsongkhapa’s exposition of its core elements—subtle channel and chakra visualization, mantra syllable meditation, and vase breathing—as well as its soteriological aims, including the generation of the four forms of bliss and the circulation of the bodhicitta substance. The empirical analysis centers on the field study by Kozhevnikov(2013), which simultaneously measured axillary body temperature and EEG activity in ten experienced practitioners. The findings indicate that during Forceful Breath (FB) practice, core body temperature increased by up to 2.2°C, reaching 38.3°C, whereas Gentle Breath (GB) practice primarily served to maintain elevated temperature rather than induce further increases. EEG results revealed significant increases in alpha and beta power during FB practice, with a notable positive correlation between alpha power enhancement and core temperature elevation, suggesting that internal visualization and attentional modulation contribute to sustained thermoregulation. Overall, the results support a dual-factor model in which thermoregulatory effects arise from the interaction between (1) physical factors such as breath retention and isometric muscle contraction and (2) neurocognitive factors including visualization and attentional internalization. By systematically linking traditional practice theory with empirical data, this study provides a coherent explanatory framework for Tummo practice and underscores the need for future research employing larger samples and longitudinal designs.

articles.title_kr: 법화경의 일념삼천과 한의학의 천인상응에 대한 연구
articles.title_en: A Study of the Correspondence Between Mind and Cosmos
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는『법화경』의 일념삼천(一念三千) 사상과 『황제내경』의 천인상응(天人相應) 사상을 비교·분석하여 동아시아 사유 전통에서 인간과 우주, 마음과 생명이 어떠한 상응 구조 속에서 이해 되어왔는지를 존재론적 우주론의 관점에서 고찰하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 두 사상은 각각 불교와 한의학이라는 상이(相異)한 학문 체계에서 전개되었으나, 인간 내부와 우주 전체가 분리되지 않은 하나의 연속된 질서 속에서 성립한다는 전일적(全一的) 세계관을 공유한다. 이러한 공통 전제를 바탕으로 인간 내부와 우주가 공유하는 존재론적 전일성, 전체와 부분이 상호 내포하는 방식, 심(心)과 신(身)을 매개로 상응하는 방식을 살펴본다. 이를 통해 일념삼천은 십여시(十如是)와 십계호구(十界互具)의 구조를 통해 마음의 차원에서 세계 전체가 내포되고 관조(觀照)를 통해 그 질서가 자각되는 심법적(心法的) 우주론을 제시하는 반면, 천인상응은 장부·기혈·정서의 연동과 천지 운기의 상관성을 통해 생명 현상의 조절과 균형이라는 실천으로 귀결되는 생명 우주론을 제시함을 확인하였다. 이를 통해 본 연구는 두 사상이 공통의 전일적 인식을 공유하면서도 상응의 논리와 작동 방식에서 서로 다른 층위를 형성함을 밝히고, 서로 상응하는 방식이라는 관점에서 불교의 수행론과 한의학의 생리·병리 이론을 연결하는 후속 연구의 가능성을 제시한다
articles.abstract_en: This study compares the doctrine of Il-nyeom-samcheon (一念三千, “Three Thousand Realms in a Single Thought”) in the Lotus Sūtra and the principle of Cheon-in-sang-eung (天人相應, “Correspondence between Heaven and Humanity”) in the Huangdi Neijing in order to examine how human beings, the cosmos, mind, and life have been understood within a framework of correspondence in the East Asian intellectual tradition from an ontological cosmological perspective. Although the two doctrines developed within different academic systems—Buddhist philosophy and traditional medicine—they share a holistic worldview in which the inner human and the cosmos are not separate entities but constitute a continuous and unified order.Based on this common premise, the present study conducts a comparative analysis of ontological wholeness, the mutual inclusion of whole and part, and the modes of correspondence mediated by mind (sim, 心) and body (sin, 身). The analysis demonstrates that Il-nyeom-samcheon presents a mind-based cosmology in which the total structure of the world is encompassed within mind through the frameworks of the Ten Suchnesses and the mutual inclusion of the Ten Realms, and that this order is realized through contemplative insight. In contrast, Cheon-in-sang-eung articulates a life-based cosmology in which the interrelation of emotions, qi-blood, and the visceral system corresponds with the movements of cosmic qi, leading to practical principles of regulation and balance in life processes.Through this comparison, the study clarifies that while both doctrines share a holistic understanding of correspondence, they operate on different levels in terms of the logic and mode of correspondence. By highlighting these distinctions, this research proposes a framework for further interdisciplinary studies connecting Buddhist contemplative theory and traditional medical theories of physiological regulation.

articles.title_kr: 마곡사 대광보전(大光寶殿)의 벽화 장엄 사례를 통한 불교미술의 미술 교육적 활용 가치 탐구
articles.title_en: Exploring the Educational Value of Buddhist Art through the Case of Wall Painting Ornamentation in Daegwangbojeon Hall at Magoksa Temple
articles.abstract_kr: 이 연구는 충남 공주시 마곡사 대광보전의 벽화 장엄 사례를 통해 불교미술에서의 장엄을 이해하고, 미술 문화유산이자 공동체 미술 문화로서 불교미술이 지니는 교육적 가치를 탐색하는 데에 목적이 있다.이 연구는 기존 선행 연구와 조사보고서를 바탕으로 문헌 연구를 수행하였다. 특히 대광보전 벽화는 문화재청과 성보문화재연구원이 2007년에 발간한 ｢한국의 사찰벽화-사찰건축물 벽화조사보고서|충청남도·충청북도｣를 주요 자료로 삼았다. 또한 현장 방문을 통해 최근 벽화의 상태를 확인하고 이를 참고 자료로 활용하였다.연구는 먼저 불교와 불교미술에서의 장엄 개념을 고찰하는 것으로 시작하였다. 이어 대광보전 벽화의 내용과 위치를 중심으로 장엄의 특징을 분석하여, 대광보전에 구현된 장엄의 성격을 파악하였다. 나아가 이러한 특징을 바탕으로 미술 활동을 구상함으로써 불교미술의 교육적 활용 가능성과 가치를 탐색하였다.연구 결과, 마곡사 대광보전의 벽화 장엄은 개별 벽화의 감상보다 전체가 어우러져 표현하는 세계를 통해 공간 이해가 가능하다는 점에서 중요한 사례로 확인되었다. 또한 이를 토대로 공간 체험형 감상과 표현 활동을 결합한 교수·학습 방안을 마련할 경우, 학습자가 자기 주도적으로 불교미술의 특징을 이해하고 미술의 다양한 역할을 인식하는 계기가 될 수 있음을 시사하였다.마곡사 대광보전의 벽화 장엄은 전통 사찰이 지닌 대표적 미술문화유산으로, 불교미술의 풍부한 전통을 보여준다. 이러한 문화유산을 교육적 자원으로 활용하는 것은 과거로부터 계승된 정신적·물질적 가치에 새로운 생명력을 부여하는 방안이 될 수 있을 것이다.
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the concept of jang-eom (sacred adornment) in Buddhist art through the mural adornment of the Daegwangbojeon Hall at Magoksa Temple in Gongju, Chungcheongnam-do. Conducted as a literature-based inquiry, the research draws primarily on the 2007 survey report Korean Temple Murals – Survey Report on Temple Architecture Murals: Chungcheongnam-do and Chungcheongbuk-do published by the Cultural Heritage Administration and the Sungbo Cultural Heritage Research Institute, supplemented by on-site observations of the murals’ current condition. The analysis begins with an exploration of jang-eom in Buddhism and Buddhist art, followed by a review of mural content and spatial arrangement within Daegwangbojeon. Findings indicate that the murals function collectively as a unified ensemble, constructing an integrated sacred space rather than existing as isolated works. Building on this, the study proposes pedagogical approaches that combine spatial experiential appreciation with expressive activities, enabling learners to engage autonomously with Buddhist art and to recognize its broader cultural and educational roles. Ultimately, the mural adornment of Daegwangbojeon exemplifies how Buddhist artistic heritage can be revitalized as a living resource, transmitting both spiritual and material values across generations.

articles.title_kr: 불교윤리로 만나는 포스트휴먼 윤리 - 나가르주나의 ‘공의 윤리’와 브라이도티의 ‘관계적 윤리’를 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: The Point of Contact between Buddhist Ethics and Posthuman Ethics: Focusing on Nagarajuna’s ‘Ethics of Śūnyatā’ and Braidotti’s ‘Relational Ethics
articles.abstract_kr: 이 글은 ‘비/탈-이원론’ 및 ‘무아/관계적 주체’ 개념을 매개로 불교윤리와 포스트휴먼 윤리의 만남에 대해서 논의한다. 불교윤리는 대표적인 비-이원론의 전통에 위치하고 포스트휴먼 윤리는 서구의 이원론적인 전통의 전복을 통한 탈-이원론에 의거해서 전개된다. 불교윤리와 포스트휴먼 윤리는 연기나 신유물론과 같은 ‘비/탈-이원론의 세계관을 근간으로 할 뿐만 아니라 개체적이고 정태적인 주체가 아니라 유동적이고 상호적인 영향관계에 따라 끊임없이 형성되어가는 ‘무아/관계적 주체’ 개념에 의거한다는 점에서 겹치고 있다.‘비/탈-이원론’의 입장에서 세계 인식은 언어적 표현 너머 있는 그대로의 실제 세계를 향해 있고 따라서 인식 주체와 대상은 둘이 아니다. 인식과 존재의 경계가 사라지기 때문에 비/탈-이원론인 것이다. 비/탈-이원론은 ‘나’라는 주체를 인간과 비인간을 아우르는 타자들과 연결된 세계 속의 존재인 ‘관계적 주체’ 내지 ‘무아적 주체’로 이끈다. 그러나 불교의 무아는 오랜 비-이원론을 배경으로 하지만 포스트휴먼 주체는 이성 중심의 전통적인 주체관을 전복하고 삶과 경험, 그리고 오랜 기억이 통일되는 신체 중심의 새로운 유물론의 등장과 맥을 같이 한다. 이러한 간극은 불교윤리와 포스트휴먼 윤리와 같은 상황적인 특성이 강한 사유에서 차이는 복합적으로 작용할 수 있다.하지만 각 전통에 대한 이해와 통찰의 지평을 더하고 발전시키는 횡단적인 만남이 된다면 각자의 입장을 포기하지 않으면서도 지속 가능한 미래를 향한 응답 모색이라는 연대를 기대할 수 있을 것이다. 불교의 전통에서 포스트휴머니즘과의 만남은 세계를 바라보는 새로운 시각에 대한 통찰의 계기로서 시대적인 맥락에 상응하는 응답의 일환이 될 수 있고, 포스트휴머니즘의 입장에서는 탈-이원론에 대한 이해의 폭과 깊이를 더함으로써 전회의 의미를 더욱 확고히 새기는 새로운 계기가 될 수 있을 것이기 때문이다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper discusses the encounter between Buddhist ethics and posthuman ethics through the concepts of “Non/Post-dualism” and the “Anatta(Non-self)/Relational Subject.” While Buddhist ethics is situated within a representative tradition of non-dualism, posthuman ethics develops by overturning Western dualistic traditions and shifting toward post-dualism. Both Buddhist and Posthuman ethics share a foundational worldview rooted in “Non/Post-dualism”󰠏such as Pratityasamutpada and New Materialism. Furthermore, they both rely on the concept of a “Non-self/Relational Subject”󰠏a subject that is not individualistic or static, but fluid and constantly formed through reciprocal relationships. In this regard, we can expect a cross-cultural overlap that facilitates a meaningful dialogue between these two modes of thought.From the perspective of “Non/Post-dualism,” the perception of the world is directed toward the actual world as it is, beyond linguistic expression; thus, the perceiving subject and the object are not two separate entities. It is considered “Non/Post- dualistic” because the boundaries between perception and existence dissolve. This perspective leads the subject known as “I” toward a “Relational Subject” or a “Non- self Subject”󰠏an existence within a world connected to others, encompassing both human and non-human beings. However, while the Buddhist concept of Anatta (Non-self) is backed by a long history of non-dualism, the posthuman subject coincides with the emergence of a new materialism centered on the body󰠏where life, experience, and long-standing memories are unified󰠏overturning the traditional, reason-centered view of the subject. Even if these two traditions overlap in their worldviews󰠏concerning the subject that ensures ethical practice and the perception that guarantees a righteous way of life or direction of action󰠏it does not mean there are no differences. In systems of thought with strong situational characteristics, such as Buddhist and posthuman ethics, differences can operate in complex ways.However, if this becomes a transversal encounter that expands and evolves the horizons of understanding and insight within each tradition, we can anticipate a solidarity aimed at seeking responses toward a sustainable future without abandoning their respective positions. For the Buddhist tradition, an encounter with posthumanism can serve as an opportunity for insight into new perspectives on the world—a response corresponding to the contemporary context. Conversely, for posthumanism, it can provide a new impetus to firmly embed the meaning of its ‘turn’ by adding breadth and depth to the understanding of non-dualism.

1권 호.title_kr: The contemporary world and the Buddhism
1권 호.title_en: The contemporary world and the Buddhism

1권 호.title_kr: 특집 1 : 當代中國佛敎的現狀與使命
1권 호.title_en: The Status Quo and Mission of Chinese Buddhism
1권 호.abstract_kr: From 1980s, Chinese Buddhism has undergone rapid development in the numbers of monks and nuns, scale of organizations as well as temple economy. More and more academic institutes appear in the Buddhist field. Books and articles written and published by Buddhists increase with very large scopes. The research achievements concern with scriptures, history of Buddhist sects, Buddhist philosophy, literature, art and Buddhist ceremonies etc.. Apart from Chinese Buddhist College subordinated to Chinese Association of Buddhism, there exist several decades of Buddhist colleges with different scale in China. They foster a large number of Buddhist talents. Chinese Association of Buddhism advocates Chinese Buddhist field to develop the Buddhist education and promote the quality of believers. Temples in the whole country should also invest more capital in the Buddhist education and enhance the grade of temples. For more than ten years, the scale, scope and influence increasingly enlarge of benevolent activities that Chinese Buddhism participates. In maintaining and developing traditional friendly relationship with Asian countries such as South Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Mongolia, Thailand, Burma and Nepal, Chinese Buddhist circle gradually sets up and strengthens the friendly relationship with Buddhist organizations and believers in Europe, America and Oceania. Chinese Buddhism emphasizes, advocates excellent traditions and accordingly makes great efforts in these fields such as ardent love to motherland and Buddhism, care for Sattva, emphasis on ethics and morality, advocate for benevolence and public benefits, love for peace, emphasis on cultural construction as well as attention to international friendly exchanges. At present, Chinese Buddhism lies in an unprecedented good social environment. There is wider space for it to bring into play the social function of benefiting the world and people. Chinese Buddhism can play a particular role in constructing socialist harmonious society by expanding positive doctrines to purify the mind of oneself, by applying Buddhist ethics to promote the harmony between people and society, by putting effort into environment protection to promote the harmony between human being and nature. For Chinese Buddhism, to serve the construction of harmonious society domestically as well as contribute to the construction of a harmonious world internationally is an indispensably historical mission in the new century. Significantly, it is also the only way for Chinese Buddhism to keep pace with the time, adjust itself to the society and realize its healthy development.

1권 호.title_kr: 現代日本佛敎の動向と課題
1권 호.abstract_kr: 本論文は、現代日本佛敎の動向と今後の課題について論じたものである。第１章では現代日本の佛敎の問題点について論じ、第２章では現代日本の佛敎硏究の問題点について論じる。第１章ではまず、第2次世界大戰後の日本の佛敎の展開を槪觀した上で、それまで日本佛敎の基盤をなしてきた葬式佛敎が近年大きく變容しつつあることを指摘する。續いて、葬式に依存した體制からの脫却を圖る動向として社會參加佛敎を取り上げるが、しかし、近年の社會の大きな變化は社會參加佛敎をそのままの形では成り立ちがたくしていることを指摘し、葬式佛敎が切りひらいてきた死者との關わりをもう一度見直すべきことを提案する。第２章では、近代の日本の佛敎硏究が、江戶時代からの傳統に近代の西歐の硏究を接續するところに成り立ってきたことを指摘し、その文獻學的方法に對して嚴しい批判を突きつけた批判佛敎を取り上げる。續いて近年の佛敎硏究の動向として、學際的硏究の必要性や、從來無視されてきた近代佛敎硏究がようやく手がけられるようになってきたことなどを取り上げる。最後に佛敎硏究がそれだけで自立するものではなく、それぞれの民俗や文化圈の土着の宗敎や思想都の關係の中でみていくことの必要性を指摘する。

1권 호.title_kr: 특집 1 : 현대(現代) 한국불교(韓國佛敎)의 동향(動向)과 과제(課題)
1권 호.title_en: 現代 韓國佛敎の 動向と課題
1권 호.abstract_kr: 韓國佛敎の最大の特徵は 禪宗だけが 佛敎と言うところにある. これは現代韓國佛敎を理解するのにあたって必ず前提しなければならない事項である. 新羅末に傳來された 禪宗は 五敎九山を形成して高麗時代の禪宗の隆盛の基礎になった. 高麗中期武臣政權の下で成り立った 知訥の 定慧結社は韓國佛敎的な特色を取り剪えた禪宗である 曹부宗として發展した. 朝鮮時代には一貫された 排佛崇儒 政策によって以前に存在したすべての 宗派が 曹부宗に統合された. 禪敎兩宗を置いたとは言うものの, 實質的に敎宗は消えて禪宗だけが命脈を維持したまま近代を迎えた. 高宗の時に至って日本僧侶によって僧侶の 都城出入が許容されたが, 禪宗の基礎はそのまま維持された. 解放以後日本佛敎の殘在である僧侶の 帶妻肉食がイシュ□として著しく表面化した．それは結果的に比丘僧·帶妻僧の紛爭につながった. まだ紛爭が完全に終わったことではないが, 韓國の傳統寺刹の大部分を比丘側が占めるようになった. これにより帶妻側は新たに 太古宗を立てて今日に至る. 韓國佛敎は實質的に 曹부宗 一色であるといっても過言ではないのが現實である. 曹부宗と太古宗以外にも 40 余個の佛敎宗團があるが, 皆が 新興宗團である. その新興宗團の中でも敎勢が伸張一路にある天台宗を含めて眞覺宗, 一鵬禪敎宗, 元曉宗, 法華宗は敎勢が認められるが, その以外の宗團は非常に微微たるものである. 曹부宗以外の宗團は曹부宗で僧侶生活をした人や, 何かの影響を受けた人が起こしたもので, 結局韓國佛敎は曹부宗一色という結論が決して度が外れたものではないということである. その曹부宗が終始一貫禪宗の立場で悟りの佛敎だけが眞の佛敎であると主張するので多くの佛敎人たちは,「佛敎とは悟りの佛敎なのなのである」と斷定するようになったのである. いや, 佛敎だけではなく他の宗敎人たちも, 一般社會でも佛敎の認識が偏重されるしかないことが韓國佛敎の現實だ. ここで救援の佛敎, 信仰の佛敎は色があせたまま變形されている. そして敎學の佛敎は全く無視された. それは朝鮮王朝 500 年間の長い歷史と, 佛敎知識人たちの無關心が生んだ奇形的な斷相である.　これに對する深い反省は搜してみることもできない. むしろそれが韓國佛敎の長所とまで思う傾向さえある. 韓國佛敎の變化は 1960年代入って徐徐に起きる. 多種多樣の在家の信行團體が非常に積極的に敎學に力をつくし始めた．佛敎系大學は東國大學校の外には全くなかった韓國で，他の一般大學で佛敎文學, 佛敎史, 佛敎美術などの側面で佛敎に近付く意慾的な成果たちが目立つようになった. そうするうちに佛敎を標榜する円佛敎で円光大學校が建てられたし, 眞覺宗で威德大學が建てられた. 天台宗でも金剛大學を創立してもう初の卒業生を輩出するようになった. 禪宗に對する硏究に集中された佛敎學界に華嚴, 天台, 淨土, 唯識などの硏究が相當な水準に至ったし, 佛敎學者外にも佛敎學に關心を持って近付く人□がたくさん生じ始めた. 學會活動も活發になった. 過去には東國大學校佛敎學會以外にはなかったが，韓國佛敎學會, 韓國禪學會, 韓國淨土學會, 印度哲學會, 元曉學會, 韓國宗敎學會, 華嚴學會, 韓國円佛敎學會, 太古學會, などが創立された. 佛敎系硏究團體も燎原の炎のように應がった. 韓國佛敎硏究院が 70年代に意慾的な活動をして多くの著作を發行して後學たちや硏究者たちや溥門外の人たちにまでも役立つことにつながった. 伽山佛敎文化硏究院, 東國大の佛敎文化硏究員, 普照思想硏究院, 元曉學硏究院, 大覺思想硏究院, 義湘卍海思想硏究院, 性徹禪思想硏究院などが あいつぎ, 高麗大藏經硏究所, 佛學硏究所, 電子佛典硏究所, パ□リ文獻硏究所などが 80年代, 90年代, 2000年代初半までつながった. このような硏究團體たちはすべて溥ら眞劍で深みのある硏鑽活動を行い，それが韓國佛敎を一新した. 70年代以前の佛敎學者たちは主に漢文文獻に依存して佛敎學に近付いたが 70年代以後 80年代 90年代につながった硏究活動は若い佛敎學者たちの原典理解のきっかけに火をつけることになった.　今の若い學者たちは歐米や日本にも優る位サンスクリット語, チベット語, パ□リ□語に對する理解を深くしている. それによって印度佛敎の硏究活動が非常に積極的になっている. 『俱舍論』をはじめて，『中論』,『唯識三十頌』などの難解な論疏に對する硏究活動につながったし, 大乘論典に對する大단な解釋もたくさん成し遂げられた. 佛敎雜誌は 60年代から何ヵ月も引き繼いだ例がほとんどなかった. それは今日にも同じことがいえる. 過去にも 『佛敎思想』とか 『佛光』など, 水準の高い佛敎雜誌があったが讀者も確保することができずに財政的な裏付もなく，廢刊されてしまった. そんな中 『佛敎評論』はすごくおもしろい季刊誌である. 西洋哲學と佛敎の接点, 例えば, ハイデッガ□, デリダなどの佛敎的解釋を試みるとか, 微妙な社會問題を佛敎的に近付くなどのフレッシュな內容が□められた論文たちを果敢に發表しているし, 優秀な海外論文の飜譯, 紹介も倦まず弛まず成し遂げている. ラジオ放送の佛敎放送は 1990年に開局したし, ケ□ブル放送の佛敎TVは 1995年に開局した. これは TVという媒體の力强い電波力や, ラジオ聽取者たちの底邊を勘案するならば 90年代韓國佛敎界の最大の成果の中の一つとすることもできるであろう. ラジオ放送の場合，釜山, 大邱, 光州など各地域の佛敎放送局が開局する成果を成した. 以上のような現狀をふまえて，(1) 佛敎界のイメ□ジ刷新，(2) 社會的な問題に對する積極的な參加，(3) 學術硏究の基盤構築，(4) 新しいメディアに對する適應，(5) 倫理的な問題探求に對する方法論的模索，(6) 文化的な活性化，などが.現代韓國佛敎の 課題になるであろう．
keywords_kr: 韓國佛敎の 課題. 韓國の佛敎團體

1권 호.title_en: The Encounter of East-Asian Buddhism and Contemporary Civilization
1권 호.abstract_kr: It is significant research on the encounter of Buddhism and modernity, because Non-Western-Buddhist cultural societies are not a solitary island from away of modern cultural project and it is urgent to explore alternative on serious structural crisis of contemporary society originated from modern cultural project. This article discussed patterns of an encounter of Buddhism and modernity, and studied case of ``Engaged Buddhism`` as ``another encounter``. Then, we examined two meanings on encounter of Buddhism and modernity in East-Asian context: one is effect of modernity on East-Asian Buddhism, another is a countermove of East-Asian Buddhism to overcome problem of modernity. This study reached two conclusions: first, the Modernity, especially globalization and development of science and technology, will weaken traditional characters of East-Asian Buddhism such as protecting a country and supplicating a blessing, second, the advent of Engaged Buddhism means attempt to solve various socio-constructive problems from western modern project. Finally, this article proposed result that is desirable to maintain originality of Buddhism and to solve negative outcome of modern civilization positively in parallel.

1권 호.title_en: The Revivalism of Buddhism and Women in Modern China
1권 호.abstract_kr: In the modern era, male Chinese Buddhist leaders encouraged Buddhist women to practice and learn Buddhism. Illiteracy and moral corruption of Buddhist women were regarded as obstacles to Buddhism revival, so Chinese Buddhist revivalist have worked to enlighten the ignorant women. As a result, A sequel to Biographies of Chinese Buddhist nuns has published and the Buddhist schools for woman have founded. Buddhist women were expected to follow the example of Chinese Buddhist nuns in the Biographies. The first school that Buddhist women could receive modern Buddhist education is Wuchang Women`s Buddhist School. The renowned Buddhist leader, Ven. Tai Xu(太虛) established the school. On the other hand, Buddhist women made a contribution to revival Buddhism too. First of all, they founded many Buddhist school for women. There was a public school for female laborer, and a special school to train for female Buddhist researcher. In addition, we can see the Buddhist nuns who have worked for reconstruction of local Buddhist culture through A sequel to Biographies of Chinese Buddhist nuns. In the last place, the awareness of women`s rights was raised in the process of Buddhist reconstruction work among the Buddhist women. For example, they had a controversy with each other about Buddhist sexism, and asserted Buddhist nun`s rights for education.
keywords_en: A sequel to Biographies of Chinese Buddhist nuns
Women`s Institute of Wuchang Buddhist School

1권 호.title_kr: 특집 2 : 한일불교(韓日佛敎)와 생명윤리(生命倫理) -낙태(落胎)를 둘러싼 한일불교(韓日佛敎)의 생명문화(生命文化)와 그 기저(基底)-
1권 호.title_en: 韓日佛敎と生命倫理 -落胎をめぐる韓日佛敎の生命文化とその 基底-
1권 호.abstract_kr: 本稿は落胎に關する佛典の基本的である敎理を土台にして今日の韓日兩國の佛敎界で新しく照明を受けている「胎兒靈駕薦度齋」と「水子供養」を中心に生命文化の傳統と現況, そして接近方法などを生命倫理の觀点で比較論的によく見たのだ. 韓國佛敎の「胎兒靈駕薦度齊」と日本佛敎の「水子供養」は落胎兒に對する追慕供養と落胎を行った信徒の罪業を消滅させるための目的に近來に導入したのだ.ところが, 落胎(姙娠中絶)になった胎兒(流産を含み)のみを對象にして, 落胎兒(死者)とその産母(生者)を獨立的な個體(二元的な存在)ではない一つの個體(一元的な存在)として把握するという点で生命倫理の新しい觀点を提示するのだ. しかし「胎兒靈駕薦度齊」は靈駕の冥福を1次的な目的を置いているのに比べて, 「水子供養」は墮胎を行った者の罪意識の消滅と治癒を1次的な目的にする. このように韓日佛敎は傳統的な生命觀と文化的な差によって落胎兒に對する生命倫理の意識もその實際內容においては差を見せている. これはすなわち生命倫理は各國の歷史的·社會的な關係の中で眺望にならなければならないしこのような土台の上で定立にならなければならないことを意味するのだ.

1권 호.title_kr: 특집 2 : 생태적 삶의 태도로서 동일시와 동체자비
1권 호.title_en: Identification and Great Compassion as an Attitude of Ecological Life
1권 호.abstract_kr: This paper aims at revealing some similarities between identification of Naess and great compassion of Buddhism in a comparative way. Identification means that one respects all beings of the universe by taking them as oneself. Individuals transform themselves from a self into a big Self by extending objects identified. Great compassion means that one realizes interdependence of all beings, takes them as oneself, and cares them just like oneself. This paper reveals the following similarities. Identification and great compassion are based on holistic ontology that considers everything as interconnected one. So they are a cognitive practice. Yet they put emphasis on emotional sympathy. In identification and great compassion, individuality of each life is respected and all beings help each other interdependently. Identification and great compassion nullify the duality of self-benefit and other-benefit. Through identification and great compassion, the ultimate goal of Self-realization and enlightenment are achieved. This paper suggests that identification of Naess and great compassion of Buddhism can be chosen as an attitude of ecological life.

10권 호.title_en: On Multicultural Discourse and Buddhist Spirit
10권 호.abstract_kr: The research tries to search for the light proof in the early Buddhist Scriptures on the Buddha`s attitude in touching with other cultures. In order to do research the direct relationships between multicultural societies and Buddhism, we should illuminate into some cultural receptions of ancient Indian countries from all angles, but the research has focused on the Buddha`s attitude in getting touch with other religious people. That is to say, the research tries to analyze Buddha`s attitudes on the effort of establishing Buddhist identity and the thoughts of other religions. The topic of the study is to be in search of the Buddhist roles and essential perspectives, which would be crucial in the age of multicultural society. What was criticized repeatedly in the ancient Buddhist canons is that one will adhere to a certain opinion, believe that opinion in truth absolutely, and take hostile stance against other insists. In other words, in colliding with other cultures, thoughts, and cultural differences, one should not defend his opinion and argue against other ones but adhere to his own opinion, which can be serious problem. We should pay attention to Buddha`s attitude in that he took stance of the flexible and tolerant attitude on the aspects of Buddhist principles and other religions without falling into certain insists and opinions. He didn`t hesitate to demonstrate that we should receive any cultures, if the other cultures could bring about the effect reasonable and beneficient.

10권 호.title_en: 圓融無碍と佛敎の多文化: 大乘佛敎の立場から
10권 호.abstract_kr: この論文は多文化に對する佛敎的理解と觀點に對して考察したのだ. 今日の現代社會は急速な多文化の社會に履行している. ところで, これに對する佛敎的理解と觀點が何で, どんな對策が必要なことかに對する硏究と政策が充分でないのが韓國佛敎の現實だ. ある具體的代案を用意するためには, まずその 問題點に對する理解と接近方法が重要だ. したがって, この論文は實踐的な對策に先立って多文化に對する佛敎的理解と接近方法の一つとして大乘佛敎の円融無碍に對してよく見たのだ. 円融無碍はこの世の中のすべての存在は獨立的に存在することができないことで, お互いに相卽相入する共生的である關係なのを强調している. このような円融無碍の精神は特に大乘佛敎の華嚴思想によく現われるのに, 六相円融と法界緣起說がそれだ. 多文化の社會で一番の問題になることは自文化を優待と他文化を排除しようとする文化優越主義なのに, これは特定の文化が實際に存在するという文化實體論に根據した觀點だ. したがって, これを對り越えるためには特定文化と言うに値するのがないという無我說と緣起說に土台した円融無碍の精神をいかして多文化の問題點を乘り越えなければならないでしょう.

10권 호.title_en: The actual Situation of the Multicultural and Buddhism`s Altemative Plan in making migrant Workers
10권 호.abstract_kr: Among immigrants living in Korea who have started to immigrate since late in 1980s, there are labor immigrants, foreign women who immigrate to be married to Koreans, refugees, and foreign students, so on. Korean`s attitudes towards them seem to be more generous than in the past. In particular, Korean government supports actively immigrants who marry Korean men. It shows the fact that now Korean society heads for a multi-race, culture society, no more single race society in which only Koreans live with their history and language. However, there remains a question whether Korea is practically the multi-culture society. Multi-culture is generally based on the principles that it should absolutely respect cultural differences of minor groups and their rights, Seen from these principles, it is questionable that Korean society really follow them, This study intends to take a look at the situation of multi-culture in Korean society through the forming process of labor immigrants`` communities. In addition, it intends to search what alternatives Korean Buddhism should prepare for the multi-culture society. For this, it insighted into forming processes of three labor immigrants`` communities: Myanmar (Buddhism), Bangladesh (Islam), and the Philippines (Catholic). It has three reasons. First, a majority of foreigners immigrated in Korea are immigrated workers who account for about 43%. Second, most of immigrants in Korea are from south-east Asia in which each country mostly has its own particular religion, while Korean society has various religions, but Buddhism, Christianity, and Catholic make up 97% of religion population, Especially, 87.3% of korean aid centers for immigrants is made of christian communities, but those immigrants are mainly from nations of Buddhism and Islam. Immigrated people are those who live in a new and strange society by going across boundaries of nations and religions. Understanding how they adjust to Korean society by doing their community activities is significant to make preparations for the multi-culture society and to make a judge of realistic problems. Thus, religion can be a good mean for that. Last, Buddhism could learn from the cases of Islam and Catholics and prepare multi-culture society coming in Korea. With these reasons, it compared and insighted into the histories of community formation of labor immigrants, who are from Myanmar, Bangladesh, and the Philippines, in accordance with Korean society conditions: 1) whether labor immigrants`` religions and Korean assistance communities`` ones are same, 2) how is the degree of religion acceptance of Korean society. It, therefore, tried to go beyond the view point that immigrated workers in Korea are subjects who should be assimilated into Korean society. Instead it looked them as those who figure out well Korean society and lead their own lives independently. It identifies the followings from that insight. Firstly, according to Korean society conditions, some differences were showed in the organizations and activities of the three labor immigrants, It was important to them, who desperately needed helps of korean society, that what kind of religions aids communities had, For example, the Philippines could do many activities energetically by organizing their communities, because Korean Catholic community which is the same with the religions of the Philippines supported them. Contrary to them, labor immigrants from Myanmar and Bangladesh who are Buddhists and Islamists were given supports from Christianity that differs from their religions. It showed some differences in shaping their communities. Myanmar immigrants looked for Buddhism aid bodies and succeeded to reorganize their community, while Bangladesh ones were not, because it seems that their community activities were not active. Secondly, the three type immigrated workers constructed their own religion communities, adapted to an immigrated society of Korea, and kept their identities. But the status of their each religion was not the same. In case of Myanmar and the Philippines, their religion bodies play general roles, but in Bangladesh their functions were only limited to religion. Also, religion communities of Myanmar and Bangladesh did not have close relationships with Buddhism and Islam communities in Korea, while Philippines ones operate by cooperating with global ones as well as with Korean Catholic organizations. An immigration society is most of all critical to immigrants. Therefore, it gives some hints to Korean Buddhism making preparations for multi-culture society. From this basis, it should find its appropriate roles and ways.

The chief of this essay is to deal with the multicultural dynamics of korean traditional culture as an alternative for construction of Korean-oriented multicultural education model, Especially, I propose Buddhism as an alternative of Korean-oriented multicultural education, I intend to identify the multicultural dynamics of Korean Buddhism in not Buddhistic thought but Buddhistic cultural characteristics, Especially, I will try to understand the structure of special disposition of Temple(사찰) in multicultural perspective. Korea is not same as America and Europe in multicultural situations. Now almost 1,400,000 immigrants reside in Korea, most of them came from Cofucian and Buddhistic nations. Considering the Korean situation, It`s suitable approach for identifying the communicative space of majority and minority in Asian universal values. In Korea, many immigrants is in need of tolerance and love. The politics of rational mutual recognition in West is unfamiliar model to Korean, Because Korean was not enough experienced the modernity, the Korea-oriented multicultural education model extend to ``consideration`` and ``caring`` and ``serving`` beyond rational communication. I will identify the values of ``serving`` in Buddhistic holy spirit.

悟りの可能性を指稱する槪念は如來藏そして佛性なのに, 『大乘起信論』ではそれを本覺という.元曉(617-686)は本覺を心の本性で不覺相を死に別れたこと, 第9阿摩羅識といって, それは覺照の性質があると言った. 如來藏としての本覺は生滅門の本覺で, 生意の能力を持つ. 如來藏が生滅の意志になるということは本覺の現實世界に對する作用展開を說明するのだ. 元曉は如來藏と阿羅耶識(阿賴耶識)を同一視して不生不滅の如來藏が生滅の世界を展開する問題を解決する. すなわち, 如來藏と無明が一視にする構造を阿羅耶識の覺と不覺の構造で見る. 覺は不生不滅したことで如來藏だ. 無明による7戰識が生滅を起こす. 元曉は如來藏思想を通じて心眞如と心生滅の二元的構造を解決しようと思った. 私たちの本性は本私だ. だから, 無明による本覺, 修行の段階である始覺は本來に本覺で根源する. 不覺の狀態で本來の心原に歸るためには修行をしなければならなければ元曉は止觀竝修を强調する.

10권 호.title_en: The Tripitaka Koreana publication of Haein-sa Temple during the Joseon Dynasty
10권 호.abstract_kr: Haein-sa Temple has concentrated on Buddhist practice and doctrinal study based on the Hwa`eom(華嚴) philosophy since its establishment by Suneung(順應) in 802 in the 3rd year of King Aejang-Wang`s reign during the Silla Kingdom. Haein-sa Temple become one of the ten prominent Hwa`eom Temples(華嚴十刹), When King Taejo, the founding king of the Goryeo Dynasty, tried to unify Korea`s Later Three Kingdom. When the Ganghwagyeong-Edition Tripitaka Koreana was produce in the mid-thirteenth century during the Mongol invasion, Haein-sa provided not only financial and human resources for its production, but also workshop space within its compound. Shortly after the establishment of the Joseon Dynasty, the founding King Taejo ordered the relocation of Tripitaka Koreana woodblocks, which up till then had been kept at Seonwon-sa Temple on Ganghwa-do Island. And Haein-sa has performed various roles and functions as the Dharma Jewel Temple(法寶宗刹). Meanwhile, even though buddhism was suppressed offcially, many kings and royal families actively supported Buddhist works by the frequent publication of Buddhist sutras and the provision of resources. in particular, King Sejong`s and King sejo`s policy of upholding buddhism produced some korean translations of sutras and established the sutra publication agency, publishing many buddhist books. During the 15th and 16th centuries, Haein-sa was so busy printing the Tripitak Koreana that the work of engraving sutras on woodblocks was in decline. Extensive restoration of Haein-sa and the printing of the Tripitaka Koreana did not leave any room to produce new sutra printing woodblocks. When state-hosted sutra printing dwindled after the 17th century, Haein-sa extended its publishing horizons beyond Buddhism. So Haein-sa`s printing of sutras was significant to the development of Buddhism in the early Joseon era. The massive dissemination of buddhist sutras was highly probable considering that several complete copies of the Tripitaka Koreana were distributed to be enshrined at major Joseon temples, Parts of these printed copies kept at major temples were given to meet foreign demand, including requests from Japan and the Ryukyu kingdom, this helped to transmit Korean Buddhism abroad. By the late Joseon Dynasty, the monastic economic situation declined further, and thus many of Haein-sa`s engraver monks probably had to participate in the publication of literary works sponsored by family clans and Confucian academies in order to secure financial resources for their temples.
