So Dong Pa who liked Seon could leave poems with ample beauty of Seon in the communication with many Seon masters during Northern Sung Dynasty era, which might be because his life was greatly affected by Seon. The reason he could find new poems pursuing free spirit through human inner world was he could meet Seon of Buddhism.I, the researcher of this study, considered So Dong Pa's poems focusing more on Buddhism scriptures based on the research that views his poems in the perspective of Seon, and researched the characteristics and the trend of those days.

56호.title_kr: 나비무 복식이 종교의례로서 갖는 의미와 상징성에 관한 연구
56호.title_en: A Study on the Meaning and Symbolism of Navimu Dressing as a Religious Rite
56호.abstract_kr: This paper aims to examine the meaning and symbolism of butterfly dance in Buddhist rituals and to find out the connection between the Buddha and traditional Buddhist rituals contained in butterfly dance costumes. Buddhist rituals have been studied by many preceding scholars, but it has been difficult to find a study on the Buddhist and religious symbolism implied by ritual procedures and ritual dressings, not the Buddha's ideas and rituals. Jakbeop dance, Korea's representative Buddhist ritual, is used as the term “Jakbeop” to build Buddha's teachings (Buddhism: Buddhist Law) through movement. 1) Among them, the butterfly dance technique, called “dress,” has a simple movement, but the uniqueness of Korean traditional dance and symbolism as a Buddhist ritual contain the majesty accompanied by dress, so research on butterfly dance dress is significant. In this study, it was revealed that the butterfly martial arts were optimized for breathing training, and the color and splendor of the butterfly martial arts symbolized Banya and Buddhist missionary theory. In addition, it was interpreted that the butterfly dance doubles express ‘ball’ and form ‘haetal’. As such, the study of the butterfly dance costume accompanying the Buddhist ritual is not limited to the appearance of the ritual, but contains Buddhist saints and Buddhist rituals, and it is itself a symbolic tool of religious activities, so detailed consideration is needed.

56호.title_kr: 임제선승(臨濟禪僧)들이 일본불교에 전한 차문화 연구 - 남포소명(南浦紹明)을 중심으로 -
56호.title_en: Tea Culture of Nan Song(南宋) Introduced to Japan by Rinzai Zen(臨濟禪僧) Monks: Focused on Nanpo Shomyo(南浦紹明)
56호.abstract_kr: In this article, the study examines the process in which the tea culture, brought by Nanpo Shomyo (南浦紹明) on his return from studying in Nan Song (南宋), was accepted by Japanese society and gradually developed and transformed into a Japanese tea ceremony, especially with the response of samurai society.Japanese tea culture was imported by Chinese monks and monks who studied in China during the Kamakura period and settled in Japan using Zen as a medium.During the Nan Song (南宋) period, Chinese Zen Buddhism was in its heyday, so many Japanese monks went to the Jiangnan (江南) area of China to study Zen during the Kamakura period.In the process of settling in Japan, Rinzai Zen brought by Shomei Nampo and other Nan Song (南宋) Zen and Confucian monks provided a background for them to work by building temples and protecting Zen monks. The Zen culture of the Nan Song (南宋) was introduced to Japan through Confucian monks, included Zen culture and its associated substances as well as religious practices such as Rinzai or Soto Zen (曹洞禪). The Rinzai Zen and tea culture brought by Chinese Zen and Confucian monks who came to Japan are actively accepted by the samurai class, and the tea ceremony of Zen source gradually blends with Japanese cultural elements and develops into a tea ceremony (茶道; 茶の湯). Nanpo Shomyo, who was approved to study in Japan, was one of Rinzai Zen monks who brought tea seeds, knew how to make tea, how to drink tea, and tea-related literature and materials.In the end, Rinzai Zen monk contributed to the cultural expansion of medieval Japan by providing cultural background and new political ideology to the samurai class, which opened the era of the shogunate.

56호.title_kr: 송대 신유학의 수양법, 불교의 수행법, 도교의 수련법 간 상호 교섭과 회통에 관한 연구
56호.title_en: In Sung(宋) Dynasty, Mutual Negotiation and Penetration Between the Cultivation of Confucianism and the Practice of Buddhism and the Training of Taoism
56호.abstract_kr: By comprehensively examining Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism's training methods, I would like to systematically examine the theoretical and practical aspects of their mutual negotiation and communication relations in the early stages of North Song.Furthermore, the ultimate goal of this study is to provide nourishment to the physical and mental health of today's impoverished older and younger generations.It is because I thought that I could present a new theoretical model and practice method of personality education through mental and physical training, performance, and training.I believe that the achievements of such research will be the fundamental foundation for today's topics of well-being, healing, and cultivating the right personality.In addition, I believe that the results of this study will play a sufficient role in preventing deviations of meditation training groups in the early stages. In particular, today's Taoist training methods are distorted and transformed in various forms, permeating society like emerging religions rapidly, confusing the empty spiritual world of modern people.This point is what this researcher actually experienced.The results of this study are: First, I tried to find out about Buddhist practice, unlike the existing practice. Second, under the pretext that Taoist meditation training heals mental emptiness and physical exhaustion, it flows into a mysterious trend and contributes greatly to the prevention and prevention of the formation of religious groups.

56호.title_kr: 『占察善惡業報經』에 드러난 현대 불교상담 활용방안
56호.title_en: Application of Buddhist Counseling Method revealed in the 『Jeomchal Sutra』
56호.abstract_kr: This study substituted internal conflicts occurring in modern society for 『Jeomchal Sutra』 (hereinafter referred to as 『Sutra of Divination』) and considered if the solution for social·cultural conflicts can be applied to Buddhist counseling.『Sutra of Divination』 has not been passed down widely as a Buddhist counseling in modern society. In the The Heritage of the Three States and especially from the social·cultural perspectives, however, 『Sutra of Divination』 longed for the highs and happiness of folk beliefs, and from the perspectives of scriptures, and treated beliefs in the future existence such as thought, religion and Yin-Yang and Five-Elements occupied a large portion. Especially, it also implies opinions buddhistic and narrative concept, historical books and Buddhist culture books internally.Considering that the life of modern people is considered ‘coexistence of counseling continuity’, there is no reason to think of it as ‘absolute necessity of a special method’ for counseling. However, Buddhist counseling is not so unusual like Western psychology and counseling studies. It is truly a process of observing, listening, confirming and citing scriptures. Therefore, it refers to the process to help oneself to meditate and realize by oneself.This way, 『Sutra of Divination』 will become a part of new Buddhist counseling to solve modern·cultural conflicts in modern society.
keywords_en: The Heritage of the Three States

56호.title_kr: 『장자』와 『숫타니파타』의 깨달음에 관한 비유의 철학실천적 자기이해 연구
56호.title_en: A Study of the Self Understanding from the Viewpoint of Philosophical Practice-Focused on Metaphor of the Enlightenment in the 『Chuang-tzu』 and 『Suttanipata』
56호.abstract_kr: This article has a purpose of exploring a philosophical-practical meaning of the self-understanding for objectification of self-awareness through analyzing metaphor of the enlightenment in the 『Chuang-tzu』 and 『Suttanipata』.Reflective awareness of the self-objectification dealt with in philosophical practice and counseling primarily is a sufficient condition for a happy life. And it involves with direct confrontation with inner self suppressed by social representation, while turning into philosophical counseling to resolve conflicts of frustration and despair that the self experiences.From this perspective, metaphor and hyperbole in the 『Chuang-tzu』 and 『Suttanipata』 come to be means to facilitate ‘wandering in absolute freedom’ that Chuang-tzu’s philosophical ideas pursue, and ‘recognizing a path to the Buddha’s enlightenment’ that Buddhism emphasizes. Also, those emerge as processes of self-objectification against the suppressed unconsciousness and life struggles corresponded to natural properties.Thus, this paper tries to examine a process of self-objectification in order to resolve life struggles and develop disruptive self-awareness into holistic through analyzing meanings of metaphor that the 『Chuang-tzu』 and the 『Suttanipata』 retain. And the proceeding leads to a way of considering wandering in freedom which the 『Chuang-tzu』 underlines and awakening the enlightenment which the 『Suttanipata』 dwells on, in conjunction with self-understanding, in terms of philosophical practice, for self-objectification.

55호.title_en: Regarding Viruddhāvyabhicārin(antinomy): Focused on Wonhyo and Dharmakīrti
55호.abstract_kr: Dignāga defined cause for inference that derives contradictory claims(상위결정인) that is, the antinomy, due to the difference in philosophical world view or grammatical system as a pseudo cause for inference. On the other hand, China's Xuanzang(玄奘) fully accepts Dignāga's new logics as a basis to prove the validity of his claim. In addition, Xuanzang(玄奘) uses cause for inference that derives contradictory claims(상위결정인) as a basis for demonstrating the injustice of the claims of other schools. On the other hand, Wonhyo(元曉) accepts Dignāga's new logics like Xuanzang(玄奘), but tries to reconcile each argument, saying that all arguments do not have absolute truth, but only relative truth, that is, relative truth(一理). On the other hand, when Dharmkīrti expresses its argument based on the contradictory statement in the tradition, it is acknowledged that an inference that derives contradictory claims or antinomy, occurs. And the inference formula of antinomy presented by Dignāga cannot be established. However, in the process of discussion, it was seen that when the claim was made based on the contradictory statement in the Jaffa tradition, a higher order decision, or antinomy, occurred. In the end, Wonhyo(元曉) reveals that not all theories or arguments can be absolutely right, but can only be relatively right through an inference that derives contradictory claims, while Dharmakīrti tried to exclude pseudo-theories or pseudo-arguments by exploring the grounds for an inference that derives contradictory claims.
55호.abstract_en: 진나는 철학적 세계관이나 문법체계의 차이로 인해 상위결정 즉 이율배반을 초래하는 추론인을 상위결정인이라 하여 부정 추론인으로 규정했다. 한편 중국 법상종(法相宗)의 현장은 진나의 신인명을 전적으로 수용하여 자신의 주장의 타당성을 입증하는 근거로 삼는다. 아울러 현장은 진나의 상위결정인을 근거로 다른 학파의 주장의 부당성을 논증하는 근거로 삼는다. 이에 반해 원효는 현장과 마찬가지로 진나의 신인명을 수용하지만, 특히 상위결정인을 통해 모든 주장은 절대적인 진리성을 갖는 것이 아니라 상대적 진리성 즉 ‘일리’만 있을 뿐이라 하여 각 주장들의 화쟁을 시도한다. 반면 법칭은 전승성전 내의 모순적인 언명에 근거하여 자기의 주장을 피력할 때, 상위결정 즉 이율배반이 발생한다는 것을 인정한다. 그리고 진나가 제시한 이율배반의 추론식은 성립할 수가 없다. 다만 법칭은 토론의 과정에서 자파의 전승 성전 내의 모순적인 언명에 근거하여 주장을 피력할 때, 상위결정 즉 이율배반이 발생한다고 보았던 것이다. 결국 원효는 모든 이론이나 주장이 절대적으로 옳을 수는 없고 다만 상대적으로만 옳을 수 있다는 것을 상위결정을 통해서 드러내는 반면, 법칭은 상위결정이 발생하는 근거를 탐색함으로써 사이비이론이나 사이비주장을 배제하려고 했던 것이다.
keywords_en: An Inference that Derives Contradictory Claims(상위결정)
Cause for Inference that Derives Contradictory Claims(상위결정인)

55호.title_kr: 사능파(似能破) 주석을 통해 본 동북아시아 불교논리학 수용연구
55호.title_en: A Study on the Acceptance of Buddhist Logic in Northeast Asia through the Commentary of Dūsanābhāsa
55호.abstract_kr: This paper examines the unique flow of acceptance when Buddhist logic is accepted in Northeast Asia. This is the case with the two directions of Buddhist logic ideas of Dignāga, and Sankaraswamin In the 7th century, Korea, China, and Japan have a unique structures in their acceptance.Among them, the explanation and understanding of the ‘dūsanābhāsa’ a characteristic of the Buddhist logic of Dignāga, clearly shows how Northeast Asian countries accept Buddhist logic. The development of annotation books and the flow of explanatory notes in Nyāyamukha and Nyāyapraveśa were examined through commentators. The acceptance pattern of Mungwe's “commentary on 14Jāti’s”, the annotation book of dūsanābhāsa in Nyāyamukha, served as a reference point for the study of Buddhist logic acceptance in Northeast Asia.First, China developed its acceptance centered on the “Nyāyapraveśa” annotation book centered on Gyu-gi disciples under the field literature.Second, Korea developed the Nyāyamukha annotation book, which focuses on Silla people such as Mungwe, Wŏnch’ŭk, and Wonhyo.Third, it can be confirmed that Japan has accepted both directions of acceptance and lasted for a long time.
55호.abstract_en: 본 논문은 불교논리학이 동북아시아에 받아들여질 때 보여진 독특한 수용의 흐름을 살펴보았다. 디그나가의 불교논리학 사상과 상카라스와민의 함축된 불교논리학 사상의 발달이 그러하다. 7세기 중국, 한국, 일본은 그 수용의 양상이 독특한 구조를 보인다. 그중 디그나가의 불교논리학의 특징인 사능파에 대한 해설과 이해가 동북아시아 국가의 수용 형태를 확연히 드러나게 한다. 󰡔인명정리문론󰡕과 󰡔인명입정리론󰡕의 주석서의 발달과 찬술자를 통해 그 흐름을 살펴보았다. 그 중 󰡔인명정리문론󰡕의 사능파의 주석서인 문궤의  󰡔14과류소󰡕의 수용 양상이 동북아시아의 불교논리학 수용연구에 기준점 역할이 되었다. 첫째, 중국은 현장 문하의 규기 제자들을 중심으로 하는 󰡔인명입정리론󰡕 주석서 중심의 수용발전이 주를 이루었고, 둘째, 한국은 문궤, 원측, 원효등 한국 출신들이 중점이 되는 󰡔인명정리문론󰡕 주석서의 수용발전, 셋째, 일본은 두 가지 수용 방향을 모두 받아들여 지속되어 발달된 특징을 확인할 수 있었다. 이러한 수용특징을 통해 향후 불교논리학 연구의 새로운 방법론의 가능성을 찾는 계기를 마련한다.

55호.title_kr: 현사사비(玄沙師備)의 법계(法系) 연구- 현사에서 법안을 중심으로 -
55호.title_en: An Investigation of the Dharma Lineage of Xuansha Shibei(玄沙師備): Focusing on the Lineage from Xuansha(玄沙) to Fayan(法眼)
55호.abstract_kr: In this essay I investigate the Dharma lineage of Xuansha Shibei(玄沙師備) among the outstanding Tang Chan masters representing Xuefeng Yicun(雪峰義存)’s Chan. A question arises about the problems surrounding the Dharma lineage of Xuansha after the death of Xuefeng(雪峰) and Xuansha(玄沙), but there have not been many direct studies on this.This essay focuses on the historical writing associated with the transmission of lamplight, such as the Zutang ji(952), the Song gaoseng zhuan(987) and the Jingde chuandeng lu(1004), which are important materials for the study of Xuefeng Yicun’s Chan.In the historical writing on the transmission of lamplight, Xuansha was the first to enter Xuefeng’s lineage as a superior disciple of Xuefeng. After Xuefeng and Xuansha died, Gushan(鼓山) of Xuefeng’s lineage restrained Zhongta(中塔) who was designated as the successor of Xuansha and received the protection of Mr. Wang, commander in chief of Fujian province, and threatened to move Guichen(桂琛) to Xuefeng’s lineage. This action was caused by Gushan who attempted to maintain his power in Fuzhou(福州), capital of Fujian province, and to establish a Dharma lineage from Xuefeng to Gushan. Due to this influence, in the Zutang ji, he was completely denied entry into the Xuansha’s lineage after the death of Guichen.Guichen and Fayan were excluded from the Zutang ji but enrolled in the Song gaoseng zhuan and the Jingde zhuandeng lu, in its stead. Zhongta entered the Jingde zhuandeng lu but was excluded from the Song gaoseng zhuan. This was because each writing of lamplight transmission included intentional forms to reveal the Dharma lineage of its own. And because Gushan tried to separate the Xuansha group from the Xuefeng’s order, Fayan’s disciples emphasized the orthodox nature of the Dharma descent leading from Xuansha to Guichen and Fayan in the Song gaoseng zhuan and the Jingde zhuandeng lu. It can be seen that Fayan’s disciples resounded the praise of Xuansha’s Chan Dharma more than Xuefeng’s while considering the Xuansha sect as being orthodox, and sought the identity of their Dharma lineage from Xuansha’s tenets and from his Chan Dharma.
55호.abstract_en: 본 논문에서는 설봉계 선맥을 대표하는 뛰어난 선사들 중 현사사비(玄沙師備)의 법계(法系)에 대해 알아보고자 한다. 설봉(雪峰)과 현사(玄沙)가 죽고 난 후에 현사계(玄沙系)의 법맥전승 문제에 대한 의문점을 발견할 수 있는데 이에 관한 직접적인 연구는 많지 않다.설봉교단을 연구하는데 있어 중요한 자료인 󰡔조당집󰡕(952년) 󰡔송고승전󰡕(987년) 󰡔경덕전등록󰡕(1004년) 등 전등사서를 중심으로 살펴본다. 전등사서에서는 설봉(雪峰)의 상수제자로 현사(玄沙)가 제일 먼저 입전되어 있는데, 설봉(雪峰)과 현사(玄沙) 입멸 이후 설봉계(雪峰系)의 고산(鼓山)은 현사(玄沙)의 후계자로 지목되며 민(閩의) 왕씨의 비호를 받게 된 중탑(中塔)을 견제하고, 계침(桂琛)에 대해서는 설봉계(雪峰系)로 옮길 것을 협박한다. 이것은 고산(鼓山)이 복주에서 자신의 세력을 유지하고 ‘설봉－고산’이라고 하는 법계(法系)를 내세우기 위한 행동이다. 이러한 영향으로 󰡔조당집󰡕에서는 계침(桂琛)이 죽은 뒤에 그가 현사계(玄沙系)에 입전되는 것을 완전히 부정당하였다.계침(桂琛)과 그의 제자 법안(法眼)은 󰡔조당집󰡕에서 배제되고, 󰡔경덕전등록󰡕과 󰡔송고승전󰡕에서는 입전되어 있는데 중탑(中塔)의 경우 󰡔경덕전등록󰡕에는 입전되어 있고, 󰡔송고승전󰡕에서는 배제되었다. 이에 대해서는 전등사서마다 자가(自家)의 법계를 드러내기 위한 작위적인 형식이 포함되었기 때문이다.그리고 고산(鼓山)이 설봉교단에서 현사계(玄沙系)를 분리시키려 하였기에 󰡔경덕전등록󰡕과 󰡔송고승전󰡕에서는 법안(法安)의 제자들이 ‘현사－계침－법안’으로 이어지는 법계(法系)의 정통을 강조하고 설봉(雪峰)의 선법보다 현사(玄沙)의 선법에 대한 극찬을 아끼지 않으며, 현사계(玄沙系)의 선법이 정종이라 하고 그들의 법계(法系)의 정체성을 현사(玄沙)의 종지, 선법에서 찾고 있음을 볼 수 있다.

55호.title_en: The Ideological Understanding of the Early Buddhism Merit Transference
55호.abstract_kr: The purpose of this article is to materialize the basic understanding of the Early Buddhism through the ideological understanding of the early Buddhism merit transference. The merit transference is the attribution of the merits performed by oneself to one's own wisdom and others. The merit transference is known as a practical practice established by Buddhism to lead us to a comfortable life by pursuing goodness and guarding against evil. This idea implies the character of practical ethics to promote the welfare of oneself and others by giving merit transference to all beings without limiting the merits acquired as a result of one's practice to personal achievement.The Buddhism points out that the obstacles to the progress of our altruistic life are selfishness rooted in our strong desire to preserve ourselves and our obsession with the self, which regards the ethical life as self-sacrifice. According to Buddhism, there is no such thing as selfishness and altruism. It can be either selfishness or altruism, depending on what kind of action our heart directs. Therefore, Buddhism believes that one can change oneself and this world in a good direction through one's own efforts based on the autonomous nature of human beings.The early Buddhism merit transference is characterized by ethical understanding and practice that transforms one's inner self into a good character for a good life and strives to share that prosperity with others without being stingy to insist on one's own prosperity. In other words, it is an idea established with the goal of realizing a happy life for the purpose of common welfare by striving to recover the ethical mind of each individual and breaking down the boundaries between me and other beings.The critical mind of this article is about how virtue, the ideological basis of merit transference, prepares its foundation in the early Buddhism and develops merit transference. This article proceeded with the following problems as a task. First, it is the conceptual understanding of merit transference, which is the theoretical basis of virtue. In the early scriptures, we examined how the root and virtue were used, and on the other hand, by understanding the meaning of the combination of these two concepts, we examined the ideological basis of the early Buddhism merit transference. Second, it is a matter of limiting merit transference to the birth of heaven and the achievement of merit transference of individualism. This view seems to limit the nature of the early merit transference somewhat passively, so I looked closely at this issue from an ideological point of view and identified its active nature. Through this study, the meaning of this article is to present the fact that the merit of the early Buddhism is an active ethical guideline that reminds us that we can live only when we guide and comfort each other.
55호.abstract_en: 이 글은 초기불교 회향(廻向, Parināma)의 사상적 이해를 통해 불교 회향의 기본적 이해를 구체화하는데 목적이 있다. 불교 회향은 자신이 수행한 선근공덕을 자신의 지혜와 다른 사람들에게 돌리는 것이다. 회향은 불교가 선을 추구하고 악을 경계시켜 우리를 안락한 삶으로 이끌기 위해 시설하고 있는 실천적 수행으로 이해할 수 있다. 이 사상은 자신의 수행 결과로서 획득한 공덕을 개인적 성취에 국한시키지 않고 일체 존재들에게 돌려서 자타의 복지를 함께 도모하려는 실천윤리적 성격을 함축하고 있다.불교는 우리의 이타적 삶의 진행을 가로막는 장애물은 우리가 자아에 집착하여 자신을 보존하고자 하는 강한 욕망에 뿌리박은 이기심이라고 지적하고 있다. 불교에 따르면 이기심이 따로 있고 이타심이 따로 있는 것이 아니다. 우리 마음이 어떤 행위를 지향하느냐에 따라 이기심도 될 수 있고 이타심도 될 수 있다. 불교적 관점에서 인간은 자율적 존재이며 자신의 노력에 의해 자신과 이 세계를 선한 방향으로 변화시킬 수 있는 것이다. 불교 회향은 자타의 선한 삶을 위해 자신의 내면을 선한 품성으로 변화시키고, 자신의 번영만을 고집하는 인색함 없이 다른 사람과 그 번영을 나누기 위해 힘쓰는 윤리적 이해와 실천이 특징인 사상이다.이 글의 문제의식은 회향의 사상적 근거인 선근공덕이 초기불교에서 그 토대를 어떻게 마련하여 회향을 전개시키고 있는지에 대해서이다. 이 글은 다음의 문제들을 과제삼아 진행하였다. 첫 번째, 회향의 이론적 근거인 선근공덕의 개념적 이해이다. 초기경전에서 선근과 공덕이 어떻게 쓰이고 있는지 살펴보았으며, 한편 이들 두 개념의 결합이 갖는 의미를 파악함으로써 초기불교 회향의 사상적 근거를 고찰하였다. 두 번째, 회향을 하늘에 태어나는 것과 개인주의의 공덕 성취에 한정짓는 문제이다. 이러한 시각은 초기불교 회향의 성격을 다소 소극적으로 한계 짓는 것으로 보이기 때문에 사상적 관점에서 이 문제를 면밀하게 들여다보고 그것의 적극적 성격을 규명하였다. 이 연구를 통해 초기불교 회향은 우리 서로가 서로에게 안내자가 되고 위로가 되어야만 살아갈 수 있다는 사실을 일깨워주는 적극적인 윤리적 지침이라는 사실을 제시하는데 이 글의 의미를 둔다.

55호.title_kr: 생반삼분(生飯三分)의 사상적 의미 고찰
55호.title_en: A Study on the Ideological Meaning of Saengbansambun
55호.abstract_kr: There are two kinds of Saengbansambun. These are Saengbansambun of the place concept and of the contemplative concept. The former is a Saengbansambun related to the place where the Bulbokjang is being held, and the latter is a Saengbansambun related to the articles for Bokjang placed on the Buddha statue. This concept appeared for the first time in Wonderful, Universal, Secret and Highest Method for Meditation, Great Teaching King of Sūtras, and then it is the order of ritual of admiring the performer, surrounding mountains, and articles for Bokjang that must be performed in the Buddhist Ritual Literature related to the 󰡔Josanggyeong󰡕. In this paper, an ideological review was attempted on the Saengbansambun. Saengbansambun is a ritual theme that unfolds on ideological grounds such as five-part dharma body, four stages in the activation of enlightenment, six perfections, faith, understanding, practice, and realization, three kinds of siddhi etc. In addition, it wishes for assistance of Maitreya’s reborn into a superior state of existence, descent of Maitreya, and quiescent nirvāṇa. And the foundation is maṇḍala. The ritual of Bulbokjang is unfolded based on the spatial world view of the alter for Bokjang, that is, in the maṇḍala, where the saint and the secular world coexist. The place concept of Saengbansambun is ritual offerings for sentient beings in the six destinies, earth, and disciples of the Buddha. Saengbansambun, the concept of contemplation, is a ritual for offering the articles for Bokjang to be settled on a Buddha statue newly created by a disciple who has been purified and approved through a zone, sprinkling water, and consecration. Therefore, Saengbansambun gives assistance through mantra, mudrā, and maṇḍala, and all articles for Bokjang are divided into Buddha by attainment of three mysteries. In this way, Saengbansambun can be said to be a Korean Buddhist ritual with exoteric teaching and Esoteric Buddhism.
55호.abstract_en: 생반삼분은 장소적 개념의 생반삼분과 관상적 개념의 생반삼분으로 나눌 수 있다. 전자는 불복장의식이 이루어지고 있는 장소와 관련된 생반삼분이고, 후자는 불상에 안립되는 복장물에 대한 생반삼분이다. 이 개념은 󰡔대교왕경󰡕에서 처음으로 등장한 후 한국 조상경류의 복장단의식에서 반드시 행해야 하는 수행자 및 주변 산하, 복장물 등을 장엄하는 의식의 차제이다. 본고에서는 생반삼분에 대한 사상적 고찰을 시도하였다. 생반삼분은 오분법신ㆍ시각사위ㆍ신해행증ㆍ육바라밀ㆍ삼종실지 등의 사상적 근거에서 시전되는 차제이다. 또한 생반삼분은 미륵상생ㆍ미륵하생ㆍ적정열반의 가지를 염원한다. 그리고 그 토대는 만다라이다. 불복장은 복장단, 즉 만다라라는 성속이 함께 하는 공간적 세계관에 근거하여 펼쳐진다. 장소적 개념의 생반삼분에서는 육도중생ㆍ토지ㆍ불제자 등에 대한 공양의식이지만, 관상적 개념의 생반삼분은 복장물을 결계ㆍ쇄수ㆍ관정을 통하여 정화ㆍ인가된 불제자에 의하여 새롭게 조성되는 불상에 안립하는 공양의식이다. 따라서 생반삼분은 진언ㆍ수인ㆍ관상을 통한 삼밀가지로서 모든 복장물을 불(佛)로 가지하는 것이다. 이처럼 생반삼분은 현교와 밀교가 함께하고 있는 한국 불교의식이라고 할 수 있다.

55호.title_kr: 범어사 대웅전에 수용된 범자 특징 고찰
55호.title_en: A Study on the Characteristics of Sanskrit Characters Incorporated into the Daeungjeon Hall at Beomeosa Temple
55호.abstract_kr: The incorporation of Sanskrit characters into wooden architecture in Korea started with the emergence of coffered ceiling structures in the sixteenth century. From the time of their first appearance in the country as an element of traditional decorative coloring (dancheong) and religious ornamentation, Sanskrit characters had already developed standardized forms. By the seventeenth century, Sanskrit characters were being widely incorporated into wooden architecture throughout the country. While inheriting the conventions from the previous century, the incorporation of Sanskrit characters into wooden architecture in the seventeenth century displayed new applications, such as on diverse types of ceiling panels and ornately decorated crown moldings. Accordingly, the seventeenth century is considered a key period in the development of the use of Sanskrit characters in wooden architecture.Daeungjeon Hall at Beomeosa Temple is a prime example of the seventeenth- century application of Sanskrit characters, which is marked by the establishment of traditions and the emergence of new styles. It is also significant in the history of Korean wooden architecture for its unique level of originality and identified date of repair (1658). This paper explores the styles and meanings of the Sanskrit characters incorporated into Daeungjeon Hall at Beomeosa Temple. It proposes that the hierarchical structure often seen in layered ceilings was applied to a great extent to the components of the coffered ceiling, including the inner beam boards, crown moldings, and ceiling panels, in an attempt to amplify the characteristics of the coffered ceiling. The paper suggests that the incorporation of Sanskrit characters into Daeungjeon Hall was an outcome of elaborate plans formulated through the organic relationships among the artisans since the hierarchical orders in the coffered ceiling (consisting of inner beam boards, crown moldings, and ceiling panels), Sanskrit character compositions, and traditional decorative coloring all appear carefully premeditated and are clearly intentional.
55호.abstract_en: 목조건축의 범자 수용은 시기적으로 16세기, 구조적으로는 우물천장의 등장과 함께한다. 단청의 한 요소이자 장엄이라는 종교와 신앙적 측면을 대변하는 범자는 등장 시기부터 이미 일정한 형식을 갖추고 있었다. 목조건축의 범자 수용은 17세기부터 전국적으로 확대되면서 본격적으로 나타나기 시작하며, 이전 시기의 형식을 계승함과 동시에 반자청판의 다양성과 소란대의 장식성이 추가되는 등 새로운 특징을 보여준다. 따라서 17세기는 목조건축에 수용된 범자의 전개 양상을 논하는데 있어 중요한 의미를 지닌다. 특히 범어사 대웅전은 전통성의 확립과 새로운 형식의 등장이라는 17세기의 특징을 단적으로 보여줄 뿐만 아니라 다른 목조건축에서 확인되지 않는 독창성을 보유, 그리고 1658년이라는 정확한 중수 시기를 통해 시기성을 판단하는데 중요한 위치를 차지하고 있다. 이에 범어사 대웅전에 수용된 범자의 형식과 의미에 대하여 살펴보았으며, 천장의 층급 변화에 따른 위계적 특징을 제시하였다.범어사 대웅전은 상층 층급천장-빗천장-하층 층급천장으로 이루어진 천장의 구조를 적극 활용하여 위계 질서를 구현하였다. 반자청판을 기준으로 층급을 구별하거나 어칸을 강조하는 일반적인 방식에서 벗어나 우물천장을 구성하는 반자틀, 소란대, 반자청판까지 확대·적용함으로써 그 특징을 극대화 하였다. 이러한 양상은 17세기 목조건축을 포함하여 범어사 대웅전에서만 유일하게 나타난다는 점에서 의미가 있다. 범자 구성에 있어 육자대명진언과 佛, 卍, , 그리고 아미타 종자자와의 결합이 아닌, 관상과 포자법의 하나인 옴·아·훔 중 아자로 추정되는 자를 배치하고 있어 독특한 범자 구성을 보인다.반자청판, 반자틀, 소란대, 범자의 구성, 그리고 채색 방법에 이르기까지 범어사 대웅전의 층급과 위치에 따른 차이가 상당히 계획적이면서도 의도적으로 적용되었다. 이를 위해서는 공간 설계와 건축 진행을 총괄 담당하는 장인의 주도 아래 소목장과 단청장의 역할이 유기적으로 이루어져야만 한다. 따라서 범어사 대웅전의 범자 수용은 치밀한 계획 하에 장인들의 유기적 관계 속에서 완성된 결과물임을 추정할 수 있다.

55호.title_kr: 백곡 처능(白谷處能)의 사상과 시적 형상화의 특징
55호.title_en: The Characteristic of Baekgok Cheoneung’s Thought and its Poetic Expression
55호.abstract_kr: The purpose of this article is to look into the features of Seon master Baekgok Cheoneung(1619-1680)’s thought and his poetic aesthetics formed in the course of seeking after truth and enlightenment, of communing with nature and outside the secular world, and of guiding his disciples and lay people. Baekgok Cheoneung was a typical model of Seon masters in middle Joseon Dynasty, and he also took a great role in the development of Korean Seon poetry by expressing the world of Enlightenment in more simple and symbolic poetic dictions. Insisting that the mind is the basis of everything Baekgok Cheoneung tried to see the original nature through Samatha-vipassana rather than an idea. Therefore, in his poetic world originated and created in the course of seeking after the Truth and Enlightenment, his Seonistic no-mind, dignified and without attachment, is more lyrically depicted well.Succeeding the thought of Gakseong Byokam’s ‘Seon and the Doctrinal School are not different but the same one,’ Baekgok also practiced Seon and the Doctrinal Schools. He asserted that mind is the basis of everything. He attempted to find the original nature through Samatha-vipassana, and expressed his Seon mind in more simple and condensed poetic images and dictions as well. Hence, his poetic world, created in the course of his severe practice and enlightenment, is more lyrically depicted well. Consequently, the characteristic of Baekgok's poetic formation is the very beautiful combination of Seon intuition and poetic imagination. That's why the world of his enlightenment through the good combination of Seonistic intuition and poetic imagination in harmony with nature is depicted in his poetry well.In particular, originated and deepened in the practical course, Baekgok's poems include dharma fragrance, which can let conflict and attachment go and the fullness of emptiness in Covid-19. Consequently, reciting and appreciating Baekgok's simple and garbled poems can be a way to calm down our bubbly mind and to enjoy empty-mind. In this vein, the poetic description of Seon mind is the very Baekgok's poetic aesthetic of enlightenment and healing.
55호.abstract_en: 이 논문의 목적은 백곡 처능(白谷處能 1619-1680, 이하 백곡)의 사상의 특징과 선심의 시심화 세계를 살펴보는 데 있다. 벽계 정심－벽송 지엄－부용 영관－부휴 선수－벽암 각성의 법맥을 계승하고 있는 백곡은 8,150여자에 이르는 장문의 상소문 <간폐석교소>를 올려 불교탄압의 부당함을 지적하고 시정을 간청함으로써 강력한 ‘호법의지’를 보여주었다. 백곡의 이러한 적극적인 ‘호법의지’로 불교탄압이 완화되고, 풍전등화와 같았던 불교는 명맥을 유지할 수 있었다.백곡은 마음이 일체의 근본임을 깨닫고, 지관(止觀)을 통하여 본래 모습을 찾고자 하였다. 그래서 백곡 사상의 특징은 ‘선자심야(禪者心也) 교자회야(敎者誨也)’라고 정의하고, 선(禪)은 마음으로 전하고, 교(敎)는 말을 빌려 널리 전한다고 보았던 점에 있다 할 수 있다. 대체로 선사들은 선교일치를 강조하면서도 선을 우선시 하는 경향을 보이지만, 백곡은 선과 교를 구분하는 것조차 잘못이라고 보았으며, 선과 교를 나누어 상호 비방하는 경우를 통렬히 비판했다. 그 이유는 선과 교가 한 근원이라고 보았기 때문이다.백곡의 유가에 대한 이해와 시적 재능을 일깨워 주는데 가장 큰 영향을 준 인물은 당대의 문장, 시, 서화의 대가인 신익성(1588-1644)이다. 백곡은 신익성에게서 유가와 시문학을 체계적으로 배워 사대부들과 함께 시문을 교유할 정도로 탁월한 시적 재능을 보였다. 백곡의 이러한 시적 재능은 자신의 마음이 곧 부처이므로 마음 밖에서 따로 구할 필요가 없음을 강조한 선심(禪心)의 묘의를 담아낸 시문학에서 잘 드러나고 있다. 즉, 마음이 일체의 근원임을 내세우며 사물을 있는 그대로 보고 관조하는 구도와 깨달음의 과정, 탈속 무애한 무심의 경지, 승속 교유 등의 선심이 간결한 언어와 상징, 함축성을 기반으로 하여 잘 표현되고 있다. 백곡의 이러한 시문(詩文)을 묶어 놓은 것이   ≪대각등계집≫이다. 여기에 수록된 시들은 호불사상과 ‘색심불이(色心不二)’ 사상을 기반으로 한 선심의 시심화를 간결하고도 함축된 언어로 선명하게 나타나고 있다. 이는 곧 타자와 내가 분별과 차별이 없는 ‘색심불이’의 사유를 고도의 비유와 상징, 이미지를 통하여 표현한 선심의 시적 변용이라 할 수 있다.

55호.title_en: Study on Bonap-do(The Painting of Mending Monk Clothes) by Sim Sa-jeong
55호.abstract_kr: Shim Sa-jeong was a representative nobleman painter of the late Joseon Dynasty, and left a great footprint in the painting history of the late Joseon Dynasty. In this paper I reviewed the painting style, content, and iconography of <Bonapdo>, one of his figure paintings.First, 'bonap(補衲)s, a monk's mending up his clothes is a daily life, and at the same time, it is a topic of Buddhism's Zen sect that means that there is enlightenment in equanimity. Also, for monks, ‘bonap’ is the way to obtain the heavenly eye, and it is also an ascetic practice to control one’s mind.Second, it was found that the image of ‘bonap’ was originally frequently drawn as one of the detailed subjects of Arhat paintings, but gradually became one of the main subjects of Zen paintings. And sometimes monkeys were drawn on Bonabdo. The monkey is a motif that contrasts with the sewing monk. It is presumed that the monkey symbolizes the common man whose mind is unstable.Lastly, I looked into the relationship between Simsaejeong and <Bonapdo>. Currently, Shim Sim-jeong is one of the noble painters representing the late Joseon Dynasty and a painter of misfortune who had to live a miserable life. It can be seen that <Bonapdo> he painted is a painting that contains his image that he wanted to live while maintaining composure with a detached mind from the world.
55호.abstract_en: 심사정(沈師正, 1707~1769)은 조선왕조시대 후기의 대표적인 사대부 화가이다. 그는 조선후기 회화사에 큰 발자취를 남긴 화가이며, 그가 그린 인물화 중 <보납도> 역시 화풍과 내용, 그리고 도상에서 다각도로 중요한 의미를 지니고 있다.본고는 심사정 필 <보납도>의 가치를 규명하기 위해 ‘보납’, 즉 ‘승려가 낡은 가사를 깁는 일’에 담긴 함의를 살펴보았다. 그 결과 ‘보납’은 수행자의 일상이자, 다반사(茶飯事)와 평정심에 깨달음이 있음을 설파하는 선(禪)의 화두임을 알 수 있었다. 또한 승려들에게 ‘보납’은 천안(天眼)을 얻는 길이자 자신의 마음을 다스리는 수행이기도 함을 알았다.다음으로 보납도상의 성립과 전개과정을 검토했다. 보납도상은 본래 나한도의 세부 주제 중 하나로 빈번히 그려지다가 선종의 흥기와 더불어 선문에서 선종화의 주요 화제 중 하나로 자리하게 된다. 그리고 때론 원숭이가 추가되기는 하였는데, 원숭이는, 바느질하는 승려와 대조적으로 하나를 놓으면 다른 것을 잡아버리는, 그래서 마음이 안정되지 못하는 범부(凡夫)를 상징하는 것이 아닐까 추측해 보았다.마지막으로, 심사정과 <보납도>의 연관성을 살펴보았다. 심사정이 그린 도석화의 양상을 살펴본 후, 이를 토대로 <보납도>의 현상과 제작 배경을 규명해 보고자 했다. 현재 심사정은 조선후기를 대표하는 사대부 화가 중 한 명이자 불운한 삶을 살아야만 했던 비운의 화가이다. 본고를 통해 보납의 의미와 도상을 검토한 결과, 그가 그린 <보납도>는 세파에서 초연한 마음으로 평정심을 유지하며 살고자 했던 그의 심상이 담겨있는 그림임을 알 수 있었다.

55호.title_en: A Study of the Reciprocal Relationship between Medical Personnel and Patients based on Buddhist Ethics
55호.abstract_kr: This paper presents a reciprocal medical personnel-patient relationship based on Buddhist ethics for a humane medical care. Although modern and contemporary biomedical science has made tremendous progress in treating diseases, it has received criticism for moving away from addressing human suffering. Accordingly, medical humanities seeks to humanize medical care, and medical ethics reflects on the existing medical personnel-patient relationship to define a desirable relationship. However, most discussions are based on Western philosophy and Western ethics. In this paper, I suggest that a reciprocal relationship between medical personnel and patients based on Buddhist ethics can be desirable and mutually beneficial. In this relationship, patients benefit from disease treatment and recovery and medical personnel benefit from the realization of self-completion. Also, this relationship between medical personnel and patients is reciprocal because they heal each other's existential anxiety(duḥkha). Modern and contemporary Korean literature and movies such as Lee Kwang-soo's Sarang(Love), Han Yong-woon's Bakmyung(Misery), Han Seung-won's Aje Aje Bara Aje, and Lim Kwon Taek’s Come, Come, Come Upward specifically embody the reciprocal medical personnel-patient relationship. This relationship is familiar and appealing to Koreans; cuturally and emotionally and presents a sound and desirable medical personnel-patient relationship.
55호.abstract_en: 본고는 인간적인 의료의 실현을 위해 불교윤리에 바탕하여 자리이타의 호혜적 의료인－환자 관계를 제시하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 근현대의 생의학은 질병 치료에 있어서 큰 진전을 이루어냈지만, 그 과정에서 질병을 앓으며 고통받는 인간으로부터 멀어졌다는 비판을 받는다. 이에 따라 의료인문학은 의료의 인간화를 모색하며, 의료윤리는 기존의 의료인－환자 관계를 반성하고 바람직한 관계를 제시하고자 한다. 기존의 논의가 서양철학과 서양윤리에 기반한 것이 대다수인데 반해, 본고에서는  불교 윤리에 바탕하여 바람직한 의료인－환자 관계로 자리이타의 호혜적 관계를 제시했다. 이 관계에서 의료인은 환자를 치료하고 돌봄으로써 환자에게 질병 치료와 건강 회복이라는 이익을 줄 뿐만 아니라[利他] 자신도 자기완성의 실현이라는 이익을 얻는다[自利]. 또한 서로의 실존적 불안[苦, duḥkha]을 치유한다는 점에서도 의료인과 환자의 관계는 호혜적이다. 이광수의 󰡔사랑󰡕, 한용운의 󰡔박명󰡕, 한승원의 󰡔아제아제바라아제󰡕와 임권택의 동명 영화 <아제아제바라아제> 등 한국 근현대의 문학과 영화에는 이러한 자리이타의 호혜적 의료인－환자 관계가 구체적으로 형상화되어 있다. 이 관계는 한국인의 문화와 정서에 익숙하고 호소력 있는 관계이며, 바람직한 의료인－환자 관계로서 현대에도 유효하다.

55호.title_kr: 한국 근현대기 청담의 마음사회론에 기반한시민교육 모델 개발 연구
55호.title_en: A Study of Development of a Citizenship Education Modeling based on the Theory of Mind Society of Cheongdam during the Modern and Contemporary in Korea
55호.abstract_kr: This study defines the life and thought of Cheongdam during the Modern and Contemporary in Korea as the theory of mind society, and examines it from the perspective of Citizenship education to propose a model for citizenship education theoretically. Elements that are commonly emphasized in civic education are 'subjectivity or initiative', 'social participation', and 'activity or practice'. Considering the life and thought of Cheongdam through the lens of civic education, the core elements of civic education, such as self-awareness and social participation and practice, are strongly revealed. Based on this, Cheongdam was established as a citizen image based on Buddhism as a traditional idea. The specific capabilities of citizens that can be modeled in the life and ideology of Cheongdam are intellect and practicality. As a citizen based on our tradition, a civic education model based on Cheongdam's life and ideology is conceptually conceived as follows. It is based on Cheongdam's theory of Mind thought and the Buddhist Purification Movement, and at the same time aims for justice, a common value of modern society. Citizen education aims to “create pure social community for citizens with a pure mind.” The character of civic education based on Cheongdam's life and ideas is an inner exploration process that shows the way to recover the lost self and regain one’s own pristine inner-self of life, centering on the mind. Mind thought is the educational content of civic education, and the Buddhist Purification Movement provides a basis for reorganization as a practical method of civic education. Cheongdam's life history from his school days to entering the Buddhist priesthood, and the Buddhist Purification Movement and Buddhist modernization activities after renunciation can be evaluated as a model that shows the life of a citizen who lives his life independently and actively participates in society at the same time. In addition, this study, which aims to connect Cheongdam and civic education, will be meaningful in providing the traditional foundation of civic education symbolized by Buddhism at a time when the traditional foundation of civic education is weak.
55호.abstract_en: 본 연구는 한국 근현대기 청담의 삶과 사상을 마음사회론으로 규정하고, 이를 시민교육의 관점에서 고찰하여 시민교육 모델을 시론적으로 제안해본 것이다. 시민교육에서 공통적으로 강조하는 요소는 ‘주체성 또는 능동성’, ‘사회참여’, ‘활동 또는 실천’이다. 청담의 삶과 사상을 시민교육의 렌즈로 고찰하면 시민교육 핵심요소인 주체성 자각과 사회적 참여와 실천이 강하게 드러난다. 이를 근거로 하여 전통사상으로서 불교에 기반한 시민상으로서 청담을 설정해보았다. 청담의 삶과 사상에서 본보기로 삼을 수 있는 구체적인 시민의 역량은 지성성과 실천성이다. 우리 전통에 기반한 시민상으로서 청담의 삶과 사상에 기반한 시민교육 모델을 시론적으로 구상해보면 다음과 같다. 이것은 청담의 마음이론과 정화운동을 기반으로 하며 동시에 현대사회의 공통가치인 정의를 지향한다. 시민교육은 ‘청정한 마음을 가진 시민들이 청정한 사회 공동체를 만들어가는 것’을 목표로 한다. 청담의 삶과 사상에 기반한 시민교육의 성격은 마음을 중심으로 스스로 잃어버린 자아를 회복하는 일과 삶의 주인공으로서 위상을 되찾는 길을 알려주는 내면탐색 과정이다. 마음사상은 시민교육 교육내용으로, 정화운동은 시민교육의 실천적 방법으로 재구성할 수 있는 근거를 제공한다. 학창시절의 경험에서부터 출가에 이르기까지의 청담의 생애사와 출가 이후 불교정화 운동과 불교 현대화 활동은 자신의 삶을 주체적으로 살아가며 동시에 적극적으로 사회에 참여 하는 시민의 삶을 보여주는 하나의 모델을 보여준다고 평가할 수 있다. 궁극적으로 청담과 시민교육을 연결하고자 하는 본 연구는 시민교육의 전통적 기반이 미약한 시점에서 불교사상에 근거한 우리 시민교육의 전통적 기반을 제공하는 의의가 있을 것이다.

66호.title_en: A Study On The Lotus Sutra Transcribed by Hwang Jin-son
66호.abstract_kr: The Lotus Sutra that was transcribed by Hwang Jin-son was last printed in Dogapsa Temple, Jeolla-do Yeonggwang, in 1655, after its first publication in the 1450s. It has been printed for 20 years, and there are six types of clear source editions: Hwanghae-do Hwangju-si Shimwonsa Temple in 1539, Jeolla-do Buan-gun Silsangsa Temple in 1584, Jeolla-do Gimje-si Heungboksa Temple in 1586, Chungcheong-do Chungju-si Cheongnyongsa Temple in 1613, Jeolla-do Jinan-gun Banlyongsa Temple in 1627, and Jeolla-do Yeonggwang Dogapsa Temple in 1554. It is unclear of the sources for an edition of Gangwon-do Pyeongchang-si Sangwonsa Temple in the 1450s, an edition published after 1452 and held by Hansol, an edition of Gyeongsang-do Miryang-si Pyochungsa Temple, and an edition of Seoul Daeseongsa Temple. All of Hwang Jin-son's editions were published and distributed in Jeolla-do, except for the editions of Hwanghae-do Shimwonsa Temple and Chungcheong-do Cheongnyongsa Temple. The original version of Hwang Jin-son's edition is believed to have been published by Sangwonsa Temple around 1450. Initionally, Hwang Jin-son's edition was known to have been partially published in volumes 1 to 3. However, Shimwonsa Temple, Silsangsa Temple, Heungboksa Temple, Cheongnyongsa Temple, and Banlyongsa Temple appear to have published all 1 to 7 complete editions. Hwang Jin-son, who trascribed the Lotus Sutra, is generally known to have been active from the time of King Sejo to the time of King Seongjong, but he is identified as a person with the same name. 黃振孫 was born during the King Sejong period and was active during the King Sejo period. He belongs to the Wooju Hwang clan and is the second national contributor for his contributions to King Sejo’s accession to the throne. On the other hand, 黃震孫 was mainly active during the reign of King Seongjong and King Yeosan, and his main building was the Pyeonghae Hwang clan. He was born in 1426 and died in 1526. The Lotus Sutra has been engraved more than 10 times in the 200 years since Hwang Jin-son transcribed it and published it. His handwriting was soft and clean at first, but it became clunky in later generations, and many variations occurred as the engraving was made several times.

66호.title_kr: 초기불교와 대승불교 『열반경』에 나타난재가불자의 계율 사상 연구
66호.title_en: A Study on the Concept of Precepts for the Lay Buddhists in the Nirvana Sutras of Early and Mahayana Buddhism
66호.abstract_kr: This paper explores the ethical principles for lay buddhists as depicted in the Nirvana Sutras of Early and Mahayana Buddhism. It argues that the survival of the Buddhist community after the Buddha’s parinirvana rests on safeguarding the Dharma through adherence to precepts (śīla).Both Early and Mahayana Buddhism’s Nirvana Sutras stress the importance of observing precepts. The main body of the paper focuses on their respective perspectives on ethical principles for lay practitioners. Both traditions value ethical conduct and agree that following precepts leads to enlightenment. However, the Early Buddhist Nirvana Sutras place greater emphasis on the worldly benefits of precepts, such as prosperity and heavenly rewards. In contrast, the Mahayana Nirvana Sutra underscores the proactive role lay Buddhists must play in addressing monks who violate precepts and highlights the essential role of ethical conduct in achieving enlightenment.The paper also examines views on the Five Precepts (pañcaśīla) for lay practitioners across different versions of the Nirvana Sutra. Both Early and Mahayana Buddhism regard the Five Precepts as a foundational requirement for lay Buddhists and a pathway to nirvana. However, the Mahayana Nirvana Sutra reinterprets these precepts, allowing lay Buddhists to bear arms to protect the Dharma while emphasizing the principle of nonviolence (ahiṃsā). This reinterpretation reflects a Mahayana perspective that prioritizes the defense of the Dharma.By analyzing these perspectives, the paper highlights how Mahayana Buddhism reinterpreted precepts to prioritize the protection of the Dharma, thereby ensuring the continuity of the Buddhist community after the Buddha's parinirvana. This reinterpretation also offers insight into the background for the creation of the Mahayana Mahāparinirvāṇa Sūtra, which, while sharing its name with the Early Buddhist scripture, adopts a distinctly different doctrinal approach.

66호.title_en: A Study on Cases of Mantra Practice: Transformation of Sanskrit Phonemes into Mantra
66호.abstract_kr: The two forms of Sanskrit phonemes that were transmitted to China are the 42-character Sanskrit Dhāraṇī and the 50-character Siddhavastu. The former was transmitted as a phonetic mantra by learning Buddhist ideas from the Prajñāpāramitā-sūtra and the Buddhâvataṃsaka-sūtra and reciting basic dhāraṇī, and the latter is the Sanskrit phonetics that appear in the Shildamjagi, a Sanskrit learning textbook written by a Chinese person around 800 AD. In this paper, I examined how this composition of Sanskrit phonemes has been accepted as a mantra and has been passed down to the present. In Esoteric Buddhism, the practice of mantra is an important element of the attainment of three mysteries. The ultimate goal of practicing mantra is to ‘entering the self, the self entering’ with Vairocana by making a seal with your hand, reciting the mantra with your mouth, and observing the appearance and virtue of the Buddha with your mind. The 42-character Dhāraṇī appears in Buddhist literature as the ‘meditative insight into perfectly bright wheel of words’ and the 42-character recite, and the 50-character appears in the Jineonjip as ‘the mantra of omnipresent wheel of words before one's forehead,’ ‘right side of one’s head mantra,’ ‘left side of one’s head mantra,’ ‘mouth’s front mantra,’ and ‘mouth’s after mantra.’ In addition, the first five letters of the 42-character syllable, a·ra·pa·ca·na, appear in the four-line verse of the Samgukyusa and the emergence siddhi mantra of the Josanggyeong, and in particular, the ‘12 letters of Avatamsaka’ through the 12 tones of the sa sound in the 42-character syllable dhāraṇī can be said to be a unique composition of Korean Buddhism that emphasizes the importance of the truth [諦] of Buddhism.

66호.title_en: Shubuti’s Maturation of Contemplation in the Five Periods of Teachings
66호.abstract_kr: This research aims to clarify Shubuti’s maturation of contemplation, focusing on how he believes, understands, practices, and realizes the Truth of Emptiness[空], Provisional Existence[假] and the Middle[中] in sequential order, through examples found in the Sutras of the Five Periods of Teachings. Especially, in Chapter 4 of the Lotus Sutra, Shubuti and the other four śrāvaka disciples express their maturation of contemplation on Emptiness, Provisional Existence, and the Middle in sequential order, by believing in and understanding the Five Periods of Teachings of Sakyamuni Buddha. Therefore, based on the parable in Chapter 4, it seeks to identify the specific aspects of Shubuti’s maturation of contemplation found in the Sutras of the Five Periods of Teachings.Shubuti is the śrāvaka disciple of the Sakyamuni Buddha. Shubuti advances his contemplation through the preaching of Sakaymuni Buddha’s Five Periods of Teachings. In the Three periods of Avataṃsaka teaching(華嚴敎), Agama teaching(阿含敎), and Vaipulya teaching(方等敎), Shubuti practiced the analytical method of understanding Emptiness(析空) of the Hīnayāna Vehicle. In the period of Prajñā teaching(般若敎), Shubuti shows advancement in his contemplation by entering the Mahāyāna Vehicle with the contemplation of Emptiness itself(體空). In the period of Lotus Sutra teaching(法華敎), Shubuti listens to the Preach by Parable(譬說) among the Three Rounds of Buddha’s Preaching(三周說法) and comprehends the One Buddha Vehicle of the Perfect Teaching(圓敎). Sakyamuni Buddha knew Shubuti’s comprehension of One Buddha Vehicle and after describing the achievement of his four disciples of śrāvakas, granted the Notification of Attaining Buddhahood(授記) to Shubuti as Tathāgata of Ming-Xiang(名相如來).Before the period of Lotus Sutra teaching, in the Four periods of teachings, śrāvakas can not attain the Buddhahood. Four periods of teachings are set as a skillful means(方便) to mature the learning ability of sentient beings. Therefore, practitioners with clever learning abilities(利根) can enter the One Buddha Vehicle of the Perfect Teaching, however, practitioners with slow learning abilities(鈍根) can not enter the One Buddha Vehicle of the Perfect Teaching. In contrast, śrāvakas can enter the One Buddha Vehicle of the Perfect Teaching, when śrāvakas develop their learning abilities and comprehend the One Buddha Vehicle by listening to the Exposing the Expedient and revealing the Real(開權顯實) in the period of Lotus Sutra teaching by Sakyamuni Buddha. Accordingly, the Notification of Attaining Buddhahood of Shubuti is possible because Shubuti has accomplished the maturity in comprehension of the One Buddha Vehicle.

66호.title_en: Jīvitindriya and Ālayavijñāna: From the Standpoint of Meditation
66호.abstract_kr: This article is based on a general understanding of the jīvitindriya of the Sarvāstivādins and the early ālayavijñāna theory of the Yogācāras, and aims to compare and examine the roles of the two in terms of meditation practice.The jīvitindriya of the Sarvāstivādins are difficult to explain directly in connection with meditation practice, even though they clearly express the results of the controversy over the presence or absence of mind in a state of acittasamāpatti during the Abhidharma Buddhist‘s period, along with tthe bhavaṅgacitta of the Theravādins and the bīja of Sautrāntika.On the other hand, with the character of the platform, which has a multi-lane flow of mind likened to the waterfall stream, and the ālayavijñāna-Causation, which creates or changes the Dharma Realm through ālayavijñāna, we were able to approach a series of mental and physical changes caused by meditation practice differently from other schools. Furthermore, the early theory of ālayavijñāna, which can be seen on the introduction of ālayavijñāna, had the characteristics presupposed for meditation practice, which were limited to the body and the structural relationship of ekayogakṣema between the mind and body linked to the process fo āśrayaparāvṛtti. These are distinct features from the ālayavijñāna theory that has been developed since then.

66호.title_en: A Preliminary Study on the Practice System of the Tathāgatagarbha Thought
66호.abstract_kr: This paper investigates the relationship between Tathāgatagarbha thought and Buddhist practice based on Tathāgatagarbha thought. This paper examines the meaning of Tathāgatagarbha in sutras and the relationship of Tathāgatagarbha thought and Buddhist practice.Although Tathāgatagarbha thought cannot be seen in Early Buddhist sutras, it is a self-nature, self-centered mind(自性淸淨心), and dyed with all kinds of desires and desires, so even though the original mind is unreliable(客塵煩惱染), it is enveloped in desires. Mahayana Buddhist sutras explain Tathāgatagarbha.Mahayana sutras says, Tathāgatagarbha will showing up diffuse of the dharma’s body theory of Avatamsaka-Sutra, retribution body of Saddharmapundarika-Sutra, submit to the Throne of Buddha’s body theory of Mahaparinirvana-Sutra. And laid out below Śrīmālādevī-Siṃhanāda-Sūtra, Tathāgatagarbha-Sūtra, Anūnatvāpūrṇ-atvanirdésa -Sūtra that classified as Three Tathāgatagarbha sutras and Ratnagotra-vibhāga.Tathāgatagarbha thought is that all sentient beings are becoming Buddha, showing the Buddhist practice and experience based on belief. It means that Tathāgatagarbha thought’s practice is start from belief of Dharma and belief in Oneself. It shows that Tathāgatagarbha thought’s practice is religious practice based on faith through belief of dharma and oneself.The limitations of this paper are that it is a preliminary investigation into the practice as an ideological foundation and method of Tathāgatagarbha thought.

66호.title_kr: 한국불교의 돈오점수(頓悟漸修)와초기불교의 행(saṃskāra)에 관한 고찰
66호.title_en: A Study on Sudden Enlightenment and Gradual Practice in Korean Buddhism and Saṃskāra in Early Buddhism
66호.abstract_kr: This paper aims to compare and analyze the concept of sudden enlightenment and gradual practice in Korean Buddhism and saṃskāra in early Buddhism to explore the relationship between enlightenment and practice and reexamine it from a contemporary perspective. Jinul's system of sudden enlightenment and gradual practice explains the process of transitioning from avidyā to vidyā through enlightenment (頓悟) and deepening this realization through gradual practice (漸修), expanding it into an ethical and practical way of life. In early Buddhism, saṃskāra is viewed as a core element of saṃsāra, with avidyā reinforcing the distorted directionality of saṃskāra. Early Buddhism emphasizes repetitive practices, such as mindfulness (sati) and the Noble Eightfold Path (Aṭṭhaṅgika Magga), to transform this distortion and reach nibbāna (liberation). While sudden enlightenment and gradual practice and saṃskāra represent distinct systems of practice, they share a philosophical continuity in their emphasis on the complementary relationship between enlightenment and practice and their aim of transforming and completing saṃskāra. Sudden enlightenment can be understood as a turning point in early Buddhism's twelve links of dependent origination (paṭiccasamuppāda), where avidyā is removed and a new direction for saṃskāra is established. Gradual practice, on the other hand, suggests a path to liberation by progressively adjusting the qualities and patterns of saṃskāra.This study highlights how Korean Buddhism and early Buddhism contribute to integrating enlightenment and practice to bring about ethical and philosophical transformation in life. In the repetitive and habitual patterns of contemporary life, the concepts of sudden enlightenment and gradual practice and saṃskāra offer practical insights into recovering directionality through daily realizations and consistent efforts. This paper explores the applicability of these practice systems in modern life, reaffirming the universal value and contemporary relevance of Buddhist practices.

66호.title_kr: <구미 금강사 금동약사여래입상> 복장 다라니 연구- 다라니의 도상화와 수구다라니에 실린 제종(諸種) 진언 -
66호.title_en: A Study on the Dhāraṇī from the Gilt-Bronze Standing Bhaisajyaguru Buddha of Geumgang-sa Temple in Gumi:Various types of mantras contained in Dhāraṇī of the Precious Casket Seal Enshrined (寶篋印陁羅尼) and Mahāpratisarā-dhāraṇī (隨求陀羅尼)
66호.abstract_kr: This study analyzed three dhāraṇīs found in < Bronze Standing Bhaisajyaguru Buddha of Geumgang-sa Temple in Gumi >. The study first mentioned the possibility that < Dhāraṇī of the Precious Casket Seal Enshrined (寶篋印陁羅尼) > published by Hǎi yànsi (海晏寺) instead of Hǎi zhēn si (海真寺) in 1152 as it was known before. It is estimated that the dhāraṇī was made based on the reference of ≪Beomseochongjijib (梵書摠持集)≫ published in 1150.There is the letter a(□) symbolizing Vairochana Buddha (毘盧遮那佛) at the center of < Dhāraṇī of the Precious Casket Seal Enshrined (寶篋印陁羅尼) >. According to the phrase that likened this dhāraṇī to “dhātū garbhe (胎藏界) to guard All Tathagatas” from the 40 phrases of dhāraṇī in ≪Dhāraṇī Sūtra of the Precious Casket Seal Enshrined (寶篋印陀羅尼經)≫, they placed < Dhāraṇī of the Precious Casket Seal Enshrined (寶篋印陁羅尼) > with the letter a(□) symbolizing Vairochana Buddha (毘盧遮那佛) at its center and made it into an icon embodying dhātū garbhe (胎藏界).In < Mahāpratisarā-dhāraṇī (隨求陀羅尼) >, the first 57 of its entire 1,978 Sanskrit characters mark the title dhāraṇī (陀羅尼), and they were followed by the dhāraṇī of 1,921 Sanskrit characters. The previous study reported that the mantra called < Unting The Karmic Knots Of Hundred lifetimes Dharani (解百生寃家陀羅尼) > was a Mindfulness Reciting - mantra (正念誦眞言) and an example of a ritual related to mantra recitation.

66호.title_kr: 서산 보원사지(普願寺址) 오층석탑사리장엄(舍利莊嚴) 고찰
66호.title_en: A Study on the Sarira Relics of the Five-Story Pagoda at the Boweonsa Temple Site in Seosan
66호.abstract_kr: The Five-Story Stone Pagoda of Bowonsa Temple Site in Seosan revealed a complete set of reliquaries during its dismantling and repair process in 1968. These reliquaries consist of a gilt-bronze outer case, an inner case, a green glass reliquary bottle, and steatite miniature pagodas. Particularly notable are the inscriptions of the Yeonki Beopsong (Verses on Dependent Arising) and the depictions of a bodhisattva and a monk on the outer case, which stand out as unique examples in East Asian Buddhist cultural studies. This study focuses on analyzing the reliquaries’ artistic craftsmanship, Buddhist doctrinal significance, and aesthetic design to elucidate their production period and historical context.The outer case holds significant meaning in its Yeonki Beopsong inscriptions and iconographic elements. The Yeonki Beopsong, a concise summary of Buddhist teachings, is linked to the sutras translated by the monk Uich’ŏng, illustrating its transmission from late Unified Silla to early Goryeo. Furthermore, the depiction of the bodhisattva and the monk is interpreted as symbolizing a scene of either receiving a prophecy (suji) or receiving the Dharma (subŏp). Its stylistic features, resembling those of the bodhisattva image in the Avatamsaka Sutra illustrations housed in the Leeum Museum, are indicative of late 9th to early 10th-century characteristics. The inner case, adorned with Four Heavenly Kings and pearl-like bead patterns, showcases intricate decorative techniques that reflect the evolution of metalwork styles from Unified Silla to early Goryeo.Beyond serving as mere offerings, these reliquaries provide critical insights into the production period of the pagoda and its significance in Buddhist art. The Five-Story Stone Pagoda of Bowonsa Temple Site is recognized as a transitional masterpiece that inherits and develops the stone pagoda traditions of late Silla and early Goryeo. While scholars generally date its construction to early Goryeo, some argue for its origin in late Unified Silla. The composition and craftsmanship of the reliquaries represent a synthesis of Silla and Goryeo stylistic elements, marking them as products of a transitional era. Notably, the Yeonki Beopsong inscription on the metal outer case, a rarity in East Asian Buddhist history, holds exceptional research value.

66호.title_kr: 茶禪一味가 한국 禪茶에 미친 영향
66호.title_en: A Study on the Origins of the Concept of Daseon Ilmi in Korean Zen Tea Culture
66호.abstract_kr: This paper examines the origins and developmental processes of the concept of daseon ilmi(茶禪一味) within the history of Chinese tea culture, focusing on its influence on Korean Seoncha from a historical perspective.To this end, the study explores the close relationship between tea and Zen Buddhism, particularly centered on Gangseo Castle. The foundational philosophy that elevated the act of tea drinking into an everyday practice of enlightenment lies in Mazu’s doctrine of Ordinary mind is the Way The Zen koan, Have a cup of tea Huatous from Master Zhao Zhou, which represents Mazu's philosophy, became always a drank tea in Zen daily life. This eventually led to the emergence of the term daseon ilmi by Won Oh Geuk Geun.The origins of daseon ilmi in Korean Seoncha can be traced from two perspectives. First, the Gangseo Castle of China, which had the greatest influence on Korean tea culture, saw the concurrent introduction and development of Zen and tea. First, the transmission of Mazu’s tea tradition to Silla and Second, two theories are explored: the connection of Mazu’s Seoncha to the Linji Yixuan tradition of China. The latter included the dharma lineage of Seogogcheonggong, which led to the tea lineage at Daedunsa Temple. The study further examines the daseon ilmi philosophy as represented in the tea practices of Cheongheo, the initiator of the tea culture at Haenam Daeheungsa Temple, along with the 12th-generation monk Yeondam Yuil and the 13th-generation monk Choeui Eui-soon.In identifying the origins of daseon ilmi in Korean Seoncha, the study confirms the deep connections between the Zen lineage transmission, the meditation sites of Korean monks who founded the Nine Seon Schools during the Silla period, and Korean tea culture. It also observes how the relationships among these Zen monks were reflected in the acceptance, development, and inheritance of the Zen tradition. Furthermore, it highlights how the traditional Zen lineage of the Linji Yixuan school was transmitted to the tea saint Choeui and flourished as the tea culture of Daeheungsa Temple.

66호.title_kr: 대승불교의 형성과 ‘페르시아-베딕(Vedic)’ 종교의 융합 - 아미타불과 서방정토 신앙의 형성을 중심으로 -
66호.title_en: The Formation of Mahayana Buddhism and the Convergence of ‘Persian-Vedic’ Religion: Based on the formation of Amitabha Buddha and Western Pure Land beliefs
66호.abstract_kr: The research on the origins of Mahayana Buddhism, which leads the field of Buddhist studies in Japan, has been relatively lacking in the study of the interaction between Buddhism and Persian cultural spheres.In particular, the new paradigm shift of Buddhism in the Persian cultural sphere does not mean a distortion of Buddhism or that it was absorbed by Persian religions, as suggested by theories such as the Mahayana non-Buddhism(大乘非佛論).On the contrary, through the process of reinterpreting and integrating the deities of Persian traditional religions into Buddhist doctrine and thought, it also means that Buddhism’s scope could be expanded even further.In fact, scholars like Maeda Eun (前田慧雲), who analyze Mahayana Buddhism as inheriting the philosophical traditions of traditional Indian Buddhism, point out that Mahayana Buddhism’s core doctrines―such as the concepts of emptiness (空, sunyata) and non-self (法無我論, anatman)―which are largely absent in Persian traditional religions, became central to Mahayana thought.This shows that Mahayana Buddhism, within the paradigm of a new cultural sphere, actively integrated and harmonized Persian traditional religious elements.In this sense, A. L. Basham's analysis, which suggests that the faith in Amitabha Buddha and the belief in Bodhisattvas within Mahayana Buddhism were formed through a process of mutual integration and fusion with Zoroastrianism, implies that Buddhism’s spread into the Persian cultural sphere marked a paradigm shift where it fused with the traditional Persian religion of Zoroastrianism.Thus, it can be hypothesized that as Indian Buddhism evolved and developed historically, doctrines such as the concept of emptiness (空) and non-self (法無我論) emerged, leading to the completion of Buddhist doctrine. From there, as Buddhism spread into new cultural spheres, it merged with Persian religions such as Zoroastrianism, which led to the emergence of the Amitabha doctrine and Bodhisattva beliefs. Religious elements such as stupa worship also infiltrated, and Mahayana Buddhism was constructed and established in this new paradigm.

66호.title_kr: 관세음보살 서원을 적용한 관세음보살 명상 프로그램
66호.title_en: The Avalokiteshvara Meditation Program Applying the Vows of Avalokiteshvara
66호.abstract_kr: This study aims to explore the vows of Avalokitesvara (觀世音菩薩), reframing Avalokitesvara's vow of saving all sentient beings to provide practical solace to modern individuals through an Avalokitesvara meditation program. Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva’s vows symbolize the pinnacle of compassionate aid, addressing the suffering and anxieties of all sentient beings. To achieve this reconstruction, this study compares Avalokiteśvara’s vows with those of other bodhisattvas, analyzing and revisiting “The Universal Gate of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva” (觀世音菩薩普門品) in Lotus Sutra (妙法蓮華經), especially the Sutra on the Causes of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva’s Birth in the Pure Land (觀世音菩薩往生淨土本緣經). This study particularly confirmed that Avalokiteśvara’s vows are distinct from those of the other Mahayana bodhisattvas, which typically focus on enlightenment, in that the former is more concrete and actionable, centering on the perspective of sentient beings. This actionability makes Avalokiteśvara’s established vows worthy of reconstruction for contemporary society. These practical vows lead to the salvation of all beings and, for this reason, may provide valuable assistance in people’s lives. Consequently, this study argues for the necessity of expanding the theoretical foundation and background research on Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva’s previous lives, vows, and the “Hundred Great Vows” (百大願), focusing on the salvation for all beings in the present world. Such perfective will provide an intellectual approach to understanding the social context surrounding Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. To this end, this study proposes that by applying this understanding to modern contexts, these elements can serve as a source of concrete existential security and hope in contemporary life. To widely and directly disseminate the compassionate vow of Avalokiteshvara, an Avalokiteshvara meditation program has been developed, with the hope that this small initiative will lead to active research in implementing Avalokiteshvara's spirit in practical programs.

66호.title_kr: 불교 ‘無心’의 검도적 변용 -『不動智神妙錄』을 중심으로 -
66호.title_en: A kendo transformation of Buddhism's ‘No-Mind’: Focused on 『Fudochishinmyoroku』
66호.abstract_kr: The purpose of this paper is to explore the Buddhist ‘No-Mind(無心)’ and its kendo transformation, which form the ideological basis of Japanese kendo. ‘Zen Buddhism(禪宗) suggested a method of performing ‘No-Mind(無心)’ and Ordinary-Life-Mind(平常心)’ to maintain an ideal state of mind for warriors to handle swords even in front of the enemy. This ‘No-Mind(無心)’ was melted into kendo and transformed to fit the kendo. In the 『Fudochishinmyoroku(不動智神妙錄)』 Takuang emphasized the mental state of samurai rather than the technical aspect of kendo. In particular, it was said that the highest level of kendo was the same as that of Buddhism's ‘No-Mind(無心)’. Dakuang regarded the ‘No-Mind(無心)’ that moved in all directions and never stopped, and the mind that stopped was a mystery. The technique expressed in the state of ‘No-Mind(無心)’ is ‘No-Sword(無刀)’, and the specific state of mind is explained by ‘without a gap in one's hair(間不容髮)’ and ‘a flash of lightning(石火之機).’ In the end, it refers to ‘Sameness of Sword and Zen(劍禪一如)’ that the state of Zen Buddhism and the state of kendo are not different. This idea has continued to this day, and many kendo masters emphasize the necessity of Zen meditation along with kendo.

66호.title_kr: 근대 일본에서의 승병 인식과 조선불교 부정론
66호.title_en: Awareness of Seungbyeong and Denial of Joseon Buddhism in Modern Japan
66호.abstract_kr: In Japanese and Korean Buddhism, seungbyeong(僧兵) actually existed in the past history, and from the early days, it attracted attention as a heterogeneous being who served as a monk and a soldier. This article paid attention to the discourse of seungbyeong left by the Japanese at the end of the 19th century and examined how it influenced the view of denying Joseon Buddhism. The Japanese who entered Joseon at the end of the 19th century negatively evaluated the seungbyeong as inappropriate for the times. This inherited Japan's negative evaluation and perception of Japanese seungbyeong. This is because, according to the writings left by the Japanese, the existence of ‘seungbyeong’ regardless of Japan and Joseon was recognized as inappropriate for the present era and unacceptable in Buddhism.A new interpretation is emerging to overcome the negative view that seungbyeong is a monk who deviated from teaching in recent Japanese seungbyeong studies. The Joseon seungbyeong also needs a different perspective from the evaluation that the Japanese identified as a symbol of the decline of Joseon Buddhism at the end of the 19th century. This is because different temples also had different trends. Therefore, since the Japanese discourse on Joseon Buddhism, including seungbyeong, projected a comparison with Japanese Buddhism, it insisted that the Joseon seungbyeong should be reviewed in accordance with the background of Joseon society and the times at the time.

66호.title_kr: 불교전래 이후 중국인의 죽음에 대한 발상전환에 대한 연구
66호.title_en: Conversion of Idea about the Death of Chinese after the Introduction of Buddhism
66호.abstract_kr: The idea of the death has been inevitable pain and fear for human beings. It is possible to say that religions had aroused from the fear for the end of one’s life and the unknown beyond of it.The fear had lead ancient East Asians to worship objects as hylozoism. Later the hylozoism had created gods. Each god had its own roles participating in human’s life and death. They had separated the quick and the dead very strictly.After Buddhism was spread to East Asia, the viewpoint on the dead has been changed to an object be prayed for from the one to be fearful of.As an example, the graves outside of the royal castle moved into the castle after Buddhism had accepted. People also built temples near the graves for memorial service.East Asians had embraced the Buddhist idea that life and death are not separated naturally. The acculturation of Buddhism and East Asian original cultures also changed the culture of funeral service.Buddhism had changed the idea of death to be a part of life in East Asia since it came into the region.

66호.title_kr: 포스트휴먼 담론에 대한 중도 존재론적 접근 ③- 포스트휴먼 존재론의 중도 존재론적 의미 -
66호.title_en: A middle-way ontological approach to the posthuman discourse ③: On the Middle-Ontological Implications of Posthuman Ontology
66호.abstract_kr: This article examines the possibility of communication between posthuman discourse and Buddhist Mādhyamika, focusing on the ‘posthuman turn.’ Posthumanism arises from the contemporary experiences such as the scientific and technological advancements symbolized by the Fourth Industrial Revolution and the climate crisis. In contrast, Buddhist Mādhyamika is rooted in ancient religious traditions. Despite their differing origins, both framework challenge dualistic thinking and contribute to a new, relational ontology.Neither posthumanism nor Buddhist Mādhyamika adheres to dualistic paradigms. Posthumanism, grounded in ‘post-dualism’, subverts traditional dualistic thought, while Buddhist Mādhyamika represents a foundational non-dualistic tradition. By breaking away from dualistic frameworks ‘post-dualist’, posthumanism and Buddhist Mādhyamika converge in their respective ontology: posthuman ontology and ‘middle-way ontology’ of dependent origination. These parallels suggests that ‘post-dualism’ and ‘middle-way ontology’ are serve as ‘intercultural overlaps’ mediating the dialogue between the two traditions.Positioning ‘post-dualism’ and ‘middle ontology’ as thresholds for this encounter, the two framework engage further through concepts such as ‘zoe’ and ‘emptiness’, and with the ‘nature-culture continuum’ and ‘pratítyasmupāda’. For example, Braidotti's concept ‘zoe’ the transition to posthuman ontology, while Nāgārjuna's notion of ‘emptiness’ elucidates pratítyasmupāda. Nāgārjuna employs ‘emptiness’ to lead to the insight into the reality of the world, pratítyasmupāda, just as, Braidotti arrives at the concept of the ‘nature-culture continuum’ that leads to the insight into the reality of the world’s existence through ‘zoe’.However, significant temporal and spatial gaps separate posthuman discourse from Buddhist Mādhyamika. These gaps are compounded by vast differences in cultural context. Further research is needed explore this encounter, particularly from the perspective of Buddhist Mādhyamika. Such research could provide valuable insights into the applicability of Buddhism in contemporary contexts and offer a deeper understanding of morden experiences and their pressing questions.

65호.title_kr: 중관 진속이제설에 대한 화엄 사종법계설의논리적 계승에 대한 연구- 절대적 진리의 부정과 현상으로의 회귀 -
65호.title_en: A Study on the Logical Succession of ‘The four realms of reality’ of Huayan to ‘Two truths of absolute and conventional’ of Madhyamaka.: Denial of Absolute Truth and Return to Phenomena
65호.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 불교적인 진리를 설명하는 두 체계인 중관의 진속이제설과 화엄의 사종법계설의 논리적 연결점에 대한 연구이다. 결론적으로 두 체계는 외형과 논조의 차이에도 불구하고 ‘진리를 통한 현상의 허망분별의 극복’과 ‘절대적 진리의 부정을 통한 현상으로의 회귀’라는 공통된 맥락을 가진다. 󰡔중론󰡕은 팔불(八不)을 통하여 ‘자성(自性)을 가진 존재를 상정하는 한 현상적으로 나타나는 생성·소멸과 이동·변화가 불가능함’을 설명하며, 그로부터 모든 집착가능한 자성은 없다는 공(空)의 사상을 도출한다. 또한 이러한 공의 원리는 공 자체에도 적용되며, 진리라고 언명되는 모든 체계에 적용된다. 중관에서는 진리의 차원인 진제(眞諦) 역시 절대적인 것이 아니며, 현상의 차원인 속제(俗諦) 역시 부정되는 것이 아니다. 진속이제설에서의 진제는 ‘속제의 승의적 무애자재함’이라고 할 수 있다. 이러한 사상적 기조는 동아시아로 전래되어 심도 있게 논의되었으며, 그 결과 삼론종이나 천태종 같은 동아시아적 중관학이 성립되었다. 이것은 인도의 불교도들과 동아시아인들이 모두 ‘뗏목의 비유’와 같은 절대진리를 부정하는 사상적 방편을 가지고 있기에 가능하였다. 화엄불교는 이런 동아시아적 중관학의 전통 속에서 󰡔중론󰡕의 진속이제설을 재해석하여 사종법계설을 완성한다. 사종법계설에서 현상의 차원인 사법계와 진리의 차원인 사사무애법계가 같은 사(事)를 내용으로 하는 것은 두 차원이 둘이 아님을 말하고, 진리를 표현하는 방편인 리(理)가 최종단계에서 사라지는 것은 진리 자체도 방편일 뿐 집착의 대상이 아님을 말한다. 사종법계설은 이런 방법으로 초기불교부터 중관불교까지 이어온 무주처적 진리관을 계승하였으며, 진리와 현상에 대한 효과적인 접근이 가능한 방편의 체계를 만들었다.
65호.abstract_en: This paper is a study on the logical connection between the two systems that explain Buddhist truth: ‘Two truths of absolute and conventional’ of Madhyamaka and the theory of ‘The four realms of reality’ of Huayan. In conclusion, despite the differences in appearance and tone, the two systems share the common context of ‘overcoming the absurd discrimination of phenomena through truth’ and ‘returning to phenomena through the denial of absolute truth.’ Madhyamaka-śāstra explains that phenomenal creation, destruction, movement, and change are impossible when one assumes a being with intrinsic nature through the Eight negations, and from this, it clarifies the idea of ​​emptiness, that there is no intrinsic nature that can be clung to. This principle of emptiness also applies to the emptiness itself and to what is said to be truth. In Madhyamaka Buddhism, the dimension of truth, Ultimate truth, is not absolute, and the dimension of phenomena, Conventional truth, is not denied either. In the theory of Two truths of absolute and conventional, Ultimate truth can be said to be the free and unhindered use of the Conventional truth. This ideological trend was transmitted to East Asia and discussed in depth, resulting in the establishment of East Asian Madhyamaka Buddhism, such as the Three Treatise school and the Tiantai school. This was because both Indian Buddhists and East Asians had ideological devices that denied absolute truth, such as the ‘Metaphor of the Raft.’ ‘The four realms of reality’ of Huayan’ was completed by reinterpreting the ‘Two truths of absolute and conventional’ of Madhyamaka-śāstra within the tradition of East Asian Madhyamaka philosophy. In the theory of ‘The four realms of reality’, the fact that ‘the realm of individual phenomena’, which are the dimension of phenomena, and ‘the realm of non-obstruction between phenomena’, which are the dimension of ultimate truth, contain the same ‘phenomena’ means that the two dimensions are not two different things, In this way, ‘The four realms of reality’ inherited ‘No permanent abode’ view of truth that had been passed down from early Buddhism to Madhyamaka Buddhism, and created a system of expedient means that enabled effective access to truth and phenomena.
keywords_en: Two Truths of Absolute and Conventional(眞俗二諦)
Four Realms of Reality(四種法界)
Afflictions are none other than enlightenment(煩惱卽菩提)

65호.title_kr: 대정신수대장경(大正新修大藏經)과 티벳대장경에등재된 경론의 서두(書頭)와 말미(末尾)의체재(體裁) 비교 분석
65호.title_en: Comparison and Analysis of the Formats of the Beginning and the End of the Sutras & Treatises Listed in the Taisyou Shinsyu Tripitaka and the Tibetan Tripitaka
65호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 󰡔대정신수대장경(大正新修大藏經)󰡕과 󰡔티벳대장경󰡕에 등재된 경론의 서두와 말미의 체재에 대한 사례로써 이들 두 번역의 체재를 비교 분석하는 데 주된 연구의 목적이 있다. 본문은 서두와 말미의 체재에 관한 개별적 분석과 체재 전반에 관한 총체적 분석으로 나눈다. 단락별 개요는 다음과 같다.첫째, 서두와 말미의 체재에 관한 개별적 분석에 관한 것이다. 제시한 사례로써 비교 분석한 결과, 한역과 티벳역의 서두와 말미의 체재는 다음과 같은 특징을 보인다. 티벳역의 서두에는 인도어와 티벳어 경론명의 병기(倂記), 밤뽀수, 번역 귀경문이, 말미에는 번역 기록문이 들어 있다. 이는 한역과는 다른, 티벳역의 특징이다. 또한 티벳역 말미의 번역 기록문에는 번역의 주체인 인도 뻰디따와 티벳 역경사의 명호 등이 명시되어 있다. 이에 비해 한역은 역경사의 명호 정도만 서두에 기록되어 있을 뿐이다. 이는 티벳역과는 다른, 한역의 특징이다. 이러한 두 장경의 경론 체재를 보다 명확히 인식할 수 있도록 다시 한번 도표로 제시한다.둘째, 체재 전반에 관한 총체적 분석이다. 여기서 총체적 분석은 다음의 네 가지 측면에 관한 것이다.하나, 도출한 결과는, 제시한 사례 또는 체뗀샵둥(Tshe tan zhabs drung/) (2017)의 󰡔설역 티벳의 문법론 삼십송(三十頌)과 음세론(音勢論)의 체계 광석, 퇸미(쌈보따)의 구전심요(口傳心要)(Gangs can bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug gi rnam gzhag rgya cher bshad pa thon mi'i zhal lung zhes bya ba/)󰡕에 따른 것이다.둘, ‘중론(Madhyamaka Śāstra)’ 서두의 용수의 찬술 귀경게와 말미의 회향게는 본 연구의 체재에는 편입되지 않는다. 그 이유는 여기서 티벳역의 체재는 인도어 경론이 티벳어로의 대규모 역경사업이 성행하기 시작하던 A.D.8C 경에 국왕 티쏭데쩬의 법령에 의해 제정된 것으로, 저본인 인도어본 자체에는 없지만 번역 당시에 첨가된 부분에만 한정되기 때문이다.셋, 비록 ‘중론’ 서두의 용수의 찬술 귀경게와 말미의 회향게는 본 연구의 체재에는 편입되지 않지만 이와 같은 티벳역 서두와 말미의 정형화된 체제는 A.D.14-15C 쫑카빠의 󰡔대보리도차제론(Byang chub lam rim che ba/)󰡕 등과 같은 후대의 티벳 찬술서의 보편적 체재로 자리매김하는 데 지대한 영향을 미친 것이 분명해 보인다.넷, 티벳역 말미의 번역 기록문에 따르면 번역의 주체는 인도 뻰디따와 티벳 역경사이다. 이로써 본다면 티벳역은 역경사의 단독 번역이 아닌 공동 번역의 방식을 취한 것으로 보인다. 이는 󰡔티벳대장경󰡕에 등재된 경론 전반에 걸쳐 나타나는 방식이다. 한역도 이와 마찬가지로 공동 번역의 방식을 취한 것으로 보인다. 이는 당대(唐代) 현장(玄奘) 당시의 ‘역경장의 역할’ 등에 관한 기록에서 확인할 수 있다.본 연구가 한역과 티벳역의 체재에 관한 새로운 정보를 제공하고, 이에 관한 연구의 지평을 넓히는 계기가 되기를 기대한다.
65호.abstract_en: This study aims to compare and analyze the formats of the beginning and the end of the Sutras & Treatises in the Taisyou Shinsyu Tripitaka and the Tibetan Tripitaka. The main purpose of this study is to compare and analyze the formats of these two translations. The main text will be divided into individual analyses of the formats of the beginning and the end and a comprehensive analysis of the formats. The outline of the results is as follows.First, it is about the individual analyses of the formats of the beginning and the end. As a result of the comparative analysis of the presented cases, the formats of the beginning and the end of the Chinese and Tibetan translations show the following characteristics. The beginning of the Tibetan Translation contains parallel records of the names of the Sutras & Treatises in Indian and Tibetan, bamposu, and a Homage's sentence of translation, and the end contains a writing about translation. This is a characteristic of the Tibetan Translation that is different from the Chinese Translation. In addition, the writing about translation at the end of the Tibetan Translation clearly states the name of the translator, Paṇḍi ta & the Tibetan translator[lo tsā ba]. In contrast, the Chinese Translation only contains the name of the translator in the beginning. This is a characteristic of the Tibetan Translation and the other Chinese Translation. In order to more clearly recognize the format of the two Tripitaka Sutras & Treatises, I will present it again in a table.Second, it is a comprehensive analysis of the overall format. Here, the comprehensive analysis is about the following four aspects.(1) The results are based on the presented case or Tshe tan zhabs drung's Gangs can bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug gi rnam gzhag rgya cher bshad pa thon mi'i zhal lung zhes bya ba.(2) The Homage's gāthā and the Dedication prayer's gāthā in the beginning of the Madhyamaka Śāstra by Nāgārjuna are not included in the format of this study. The reason is that the format of the Tibetan translation here was established by the decree of King Khri Srong Ide Btsan around 8th century A.D. when the large-scale translation of the Sutras into Tibetan was beginning to flourish, and is limited to the parts added when translating what was not in the original Indian language edition.(3) Although the Homage's gāthā and the Dedication prayer's gāthā in the beginning and end of Nāgārjuna's Madhyamaka Śāstra are not incorporated into the format of this study, it is clear that this standardized format of the beginning and end of the Tibetan translation had a great influence on establishing itself as the universal format of later Tibetan writings, such as Tsong kha pa's Byang chub lam rim che ba in A.D.14-15C.(4) According to the translation record at the end of the Tibetan Translation, the translators are the Indian Paṇḍi ta & the Tibetan Translator. From this, it can be seen that the Tibetan Translation is not an exclusive translation by the Translator, but a collaborative translation. This is the common method used in the Sutras & Treatises listed in the Tibetan Tripitaka. Likewise, it is reasonable to view the Chinese Translation as a collaborative translation. This is because there are records of the ‘role in the place Translation of Sutras’ at the time of Zan tsang(玄奘) in the Tang(唐) times.It is hoped that this study will provide new information on the format of the Chinese and Tibetan translations and broaden the horizon of research on them.

65호.title_kr: 『능가경』의 여래장․아뢰야식의 공성에 대한 이해
65호.title_en: Understanding of Śūnyatā of Athāgatagarbha․Ālayavijñāna in Laṅkāvatārasūtra
65호.abstract_kr: 『능가경』은 아뢰야식과 여래장을 동일시한다. 선행연구자들은 외도의 상견을 바로잡기 위해 여래장을 아뢰야식과 동일시했다고 주장한다. 필자가 보기에, 그들의 주장은 유가행파의 공성 해석에 기반한 것이다. 유가행파에서는 이뢰야식의 공성을 지각이 없는 무심으로 해석한다. 그러나 『능가경』에서는 아뢰야식․여래장의 소멸을 주장하는 단견으로 간주한다.유가행파에서는 아뢰야식의 공성을 두 가지로 해석한다. 『보살지』에서는 선취공과 악취공을 제시한다. 선취공이란 사물 자체에 언설이 없는 것이고, 악취공이란 언설도 없고 사물도 없는 것이다. 『중변분별론』과 『삼십송』에서는 첫째는 마음 자체에 대상이 없는 것이고, 둘째는 대상도 없고 마음도 없는 것이다. 특히 세친은 공성․유식성에 머무는 것을 지각이 없는 무심이라고 해석한다.여래장 경론에서도 여래장의 공성을 두 가지로 해석한다. 『보성론』에서는 공과 불공을 제시한다. 공은 여래장에 번뇌가 없는 것이고, 불공은 여래장에 불성․지혜가 있는 것이다. 『능가경』에서도 아뢰야식․여래장 자체에 번뇌는 없고 지혜는 있는 것이라고 해석한다. 『능가경』에서는 유식성에 머무는 것을 여래장․아뢰야식의 소멸, 즉 무심으로 해석하는 것은 외도의 단견에 불과하다고 지적한다.이상 본 연구에 의하면, 지금까지 유식사상과 여래장사상을 융합한 경전이라고 알려져 있는 『능가경』은 유식사상보다는 여래장사상을 핵심적인 교학으로 해서 설해진 경전이라는 것을 알 수 있다.
65호.abstract_en: In Laṅkāvatārasūtra, ālayavijñāna and tathāgatagarbha are considered to have the same meaning.
