For this purpose, the teachings of the Buddha contained in the Aṅguttara Nikāya were examined using an analytical framework divided into two categories: “guarantee of opportunity” and “elimination of discriminatory factors.” The former was further subdivided into “innate equality of rights” and “equality in opportunity ownership,” while the latter was analyzed in terms of “equitable conditions,” “social justice,” and “redistribution of resources.” Representative suttas were selected for analysis: “The Case Sutta” (A5:57) for innate equality of rights, “The Endeavor Sutta” (A3:15) for equality in opportunity ownership, “The One Who Experienced Sutta” (A3:21) for equitable conditions, “The Fetters Sutta” (A2:1:6) for social justice, and “The Blind Sutta” (A3:29) for the redistribution of resources. Through this analysis, it was confirmed that the teachings of the Aṅguttara Nikāya are closely aligned with the modern value of equality of opportunity. These teachings hold practical implications for ensuring human dignity and providing fair opportunities to the socially disadvantaged and marginalized, thereby contributing to the realization of justice and equality in contemporary society.

71호.title_kr: 인도종교철학에서 ‘사람’을 바라보는 상이한 시각- 베다 상히따(Veda Saṃhitā)와 니까야(Nikāya)를 중심으로 -
71호.title_en: A Different Perspective on ‘Person’ in Indian Religious Philosophy: Centered on Veda Saṃhitā; and Nikāya
71호.abstract_kr: 본 연구의 목적은 인도종교철학에서 ‘인간’을 보는 다양한 시각을 ‘자아’와 ‘사람’이라는 양자 구도로 분석해 보는 데 있다. 인도정통파철학에서 아뜨만(ātman)은 범아일여(梵我一如) 곧 절대자와의 합일이 전제된 ‘자아’로 간주되며, 이에 대한 논의 역시 구원론적 관점에서 행해졌다. 반면 뿌루샤(puruṣa)는 사람, 특히 남성을 의미하는 대표적 용어이다. 아뜨만과 뿌루샤는 브라만교 철학에서 시대와 종파에 따라 혼용되기도 했고 구별되기도 했다. 본 논문은 아뜨만과 뿌루샤를 비롯한 인간을 지시하는 개념들을 연대기적 배열에 입각한 문헌의 수순에 따라 분석해 보고자 한다.연구 내용은 먼저 인도종교 최초기 문헌에 해당하는 리그베다(Ṛg-veda)에서의 인간에 대한 이해가 어떤 양상으로 전개되는 지를 살펴본다. 이를 통해 ‘사람’에 대한 그들의 관심사가 현실을 살아가는  일상의 ‘사람’이라기보다는 초월적 존재와 연결되어 있는 우주적·신화적인 ‘사람’에 방점이 찍혀 있음을 알게 된다. 이는 리그베다의 뿌루샤찬가(Puruṣa-sūkta)로부터 그 맹아를 찾을 수 있다. 반면 리그베다의 다른 찬가에서 인간은 죽음을 피할 수 없는 유한한 존재임을 자각하는 내용도 등장한다.두 번째로 우빠니샤드(Upaniṣad)를 거치면서 ‘자아’에 대한 성찰이 심화되지만, 여전히 그들의 관심사는 초월적 존재와의 합일이었다. 다층위의 자아에 대해 설명하는 오장설(五藏說)이나, 뿌루샤를 인간 내부에 실재하는 자아로 보는 관점 등이 그것이다. “아니다. 아니다.”라고 부정할 수밖에 없는 불가지론적 존재로서의 자아에 대한 야즈냐발캬의 교설도 있다. 이들 대부분의 사변은 현실을 살아가는 ‘사람’에 대한 인식이 아니었다.세 번째로 초기불교 니까야(Nikāya)에서 아뜨만은 부정되어야 하는 것으로 나타나는 반면, 뿌루샤는 빠알리어로 뿌리사뿍갈라(purisa-puggala)라는 복합어로 쓰이며, 정신적·육체적 활동을 하는 남자 ‘사람’으로서 인정되었다. 여기서 이 ‘사람’은 스깐다(skandha, 五蘊)로 구성되었으며, 아뜨만과는 동일시되지 않는다. 요컨대, ‘자아’가 아닌 현실을 살아가는  ‘사람’에 대한 이해가 불교에 이르러서야 본격화되었던 것이다.리그베다 이래 인도종교철학 전반에 있어 알 수 없는 영역과의 통로를 개척하는 길은 여전히 모색되어야 하는 핵심 과제였다. 형이상학적 문제에 대해 무기(無記)의 입장을 보였던 붓다와는 달리 이후 부파불교에서는 불가설(不可說)의 입장으로 선회하는 양상을 보이게 된다. 이런 점에서 볼 때, 초기불교는 인도종교사상에 있어 ‘자아’를 ‘사람’으로 인식한 가장 적극적인 사례라고 평가된다.
71호.abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to examine the diverse perspectives on “man” in Indian religious philosophy through the dual framework of “self” (ātman) and “person” (puruṣa). In orthodox Indian philosophy, ātman is regarded as the “self” presupposed in the unity with the Absolute (brahman), and discussions surrounding it have been conducted within a soteriological framework. In contrast, puruṣa is a representative term denoting a “person,” particularly a male human being. Within Brāhmaṇical philosophy, ātman and puruṣa were at times used interchangeably and at other times distinguished, depending on the period and the school of thought. This study aims to analyze concepts referring to existence of man, including ātman and puruṣa, in accordance with the chronological order of the relevant texts.First, the study investigates how the understanding of man develops in the Ṛg-veda, the earliest text of Indian religion. In this text, interest in “man” is directed not toward man as everyday, empirical entities but toward divine beings related to the transcendent. This orientation is epitomized in the Puruṣa-sūkta of the Ṛg-veda. At the same time, other hymns of the Ṛg-veda reveal an awareness that men are finite and subject to death.Second, in the Upaniṣads, reflection on the “self” becomes more profound, yet the primary concern remains the union with the transcendent. This is evident in the doctrine of the pañcakośa, which presents the self as a multilayered structure; in the conception of puruṣa as the true self residing within man; and in Yājñavalkya’s teaching that the self is an agnostic entity knowable only through negation (“neti neti,” “not this, not this”). However, most of these speculations did not concern an understanding of man as concrete, living persons.Third, in the early Buddhist Nikāyas, the notion of ātman is explicitly denied, while puruṣa—appearing in the Pāli form purisa-puggala—is recognized as the “person” who performs mental and physical activities. This “person” is composed of the five aggregates and is not identified with ātman.In summary, it was only with Buddhism that the notion of the “person” as a being who lives within empirical reality, rather than as a metaphysical “self,” came to full development. Since the Ṛg-veda, a central task throughout Indian religious philosophy has remained the exploration of channels to the unknowable realm. Unlike the Buddha, who adopted a position of unexplained (avyākṛta) regarding metaphysical issues, the subsequent schools of sectarian Buddhism shifted toward a stance of inexpressibility (avaktavya). In this light, early Buddhism may be evaluated as the most active case in Indian religious thought of recognizing the “self” as “person.”

71호.title_kr: 『菩提場所說一字頂輪王經』의 板本 校勘 硏究*- 고려 초조·재조본과 송·요 계통 자료의 비교를 중심으로 -
71호.title_en: A Philological Study on the Editions of the Bodhi-maṇḍa-nirdeśa Ekākṣara Uṣṇīṣa-cakravarti-rāja Sūtra : Focusing on the Comparison between the First and Second Goryeo Tripiṭaka Editions and the Song–Liao Lineage Texts
71호.abstract_kr: 『보리장소설일자정륜왕경(菩提場所說一字頂輪王經』, (이하 『일자정륜왕경』)은 고려대장경(高麗大藏經)의 초조본(初雕本)과 재조본(再雕本)에 전해지는 밀교 경전으로, 당대의 대표적 역경가(譯經家)인 불공(不空, Amoghavajra, 705-774)에 의해 번역된 불전이다. 이 경은 보리유지(菩提流支, Bodhiruci, ?- 527)가 앞서 한역한 『일자불정륜왕경(一字佛頂輪王經)』의 이역본(異譯本)이자 변형된 형식을 보여주며, 당 밀교의 교학과 의례 전통을 강하게 반영한다.이 경전은 한역 불교사와 고려대장경 편찬사 연구에서 두 가지 측면에서 주목할 만하다. 첫째, 밀교 경전으로서 불공 번역의 특징과 구체적 수행 의례를 살필 수 있는 핵심 자료라는 점이다. 둘째, 고려 초조·재조대장경 간의 교감(校勘)을 통해 판본 계통과 저본(底本)의 문제를 재구성할 수 있는 실증적 근거를 제공한다.그러나 지금까지의 연구는 교정별록 속해서 단편적인 교감본의 하나로 간략히 언급된 수준에 머물러, 『일자정륜왕경』 자체의 교감학적 분석은 충분히 이루어지지 않았다고 생각한다. 이에 본 연구는 이러한 공백을 보완하고자 구체적으로, ① 본 경의 성립 배경과 번역 맥락을 정리하고, ② 고려 초조본과 재조본의 교감 분석을 통해 권차별 특징과 변이 양상을 밝히며, ③ 이를 토대로 저본과 판본 계통을 재검토한다.나아가, 본 경이 밀교 교학·의례사적 흐름 속에서 갖는 사상적·학술사적 의의를 탐구함으로써 고려대장경 편찬사의 성격을 재조명하고자 한다.
71호.abstract_en: This study reexamines the Bodhimaṇḍa-nirdeśa-ekākṣara-uṣṇīṣa-cakravarti-rāja Sūtra (hereafter Ekākṣara Uṣṇīṣa Sūtra), a key Esoteric Buddhist scripture translated by Amoghavajra (705–774) and preserved in both the First (Chojang/國本) and Second (Jaejang) editions of the Goryeo Tripiṭaka. Previous scholarship has focused on macro-level bibliography, leaving the text-critical reconstruction of this individual scripture—particularly its ritual and mantric strata—largely underexplored.The analysis draws on (1) the Goryeo Chojang and Jaejang editions, (2) Song–Liao witnesses including danben/danziben, and (3) Japanese fragments such as the Nanzen-ji holdings. Special attention is given to the bibliographic and collation records in the Gyojeong beollok (高麗國新雕大藏校正別錄) and Xu Zhengyuan luzang (續貞元錄藏). Physical-bibliographic data (fascicle and sheet counts, page frames, line/character matrices, paratextual features) are systematized. A normalized fivefold variant taxonomy—異 (substitution), 脫 (omission), 衍 (addition), 倒 (transposition), 到 (intrusive displacement)—supports quantitative mapping of textual instability by fascicle.Three major dislocations and omissions in Chojang fascicle 1 are identified; the Gyojeong beollok restores the proper narrative and doctrinal flow, and the Xu Zhengyuan luzang provides independent corroboration. Variant density peaks in the ritual/mantric sections: fasc. 1 = 21, fasc. 2 = 35, fasc. 4 = 66, fasc. 5 = 22, with fasc. 4–5 showing both the highest counts and the broadest error-type spectrum. Reassessment of the prevailing hypothesis that the Chojang edition was based exclusively on the Xu Zhengyuan luzang reveals instead a hybrid collation ecology—Goryeo editors cross-checked multiple Song–Liao witnesses alongside jinglu catalogues rather than relying on a single base text.The Ekākṣara Uṣṇīṣa Sūtra exemplifies how Goryeo compilers combined bibliographic standardization with ritual pragmatism: textual authority was secured through multi-witness collation, while local ritual practice shaped redactional choices, especially in fascicles 4–5. This study clarifies stemmatic relations within the Goryeo Tripiṭaka, challenges the one-base-text hypothesis, and proposes a digital-philological workflow integrating variant tagging with conservation metadata to advance research on tantric liturgy, mandala iconography, and East Asian textual transmission.
keywords_en: Gyojeong Beollok (Record of Collation and Correction)

71호.title_kr: 운허 용하(耘虛龍夏)의 저술 및 역경 연구- 자료 발굴에서 불교 출판문화 비판까지 -
71호.title_en: Ven. Unheo Yongha's Writings and Buddhist Scriptural Translations: From Archival Discovery to a Critique of Korean Buddhist Publishing Culture
71호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 근현대 한국불교의 대표적 고승 운허의 방대한 저술 및 역경 작업을 재조명하고, ｢탁상일기｣, ｢역경간행일람｣, ｢자초연보｣ 등 1차 자료에 근거하여 그의 출판물 68종을 정리하였다. 운허의 작업은 단순한 경전 번역을 넘어, 해방 이후 한국불교의 신행과 교육, 출판의 현대화와 대중화를 선도한 종교적・문화적 실천이었다. 본 연구는 기존에 정확히 정리되지 않았던 도서 목록을 오류 수정과 함께 보완하고, 『조계종요강』, 『불교통사』, 『권발보리심문』. 『초발심자경문』, 『철오선사어록』, 『고독지옥참회』, 『삼시계념불사』 등 그간 간과되어 온 출판물의 존재를 발굴하고 검증하였다. 아울러 『자비수참』, 『철오선사어록』, 『불교의자비(방생)이야기』, 『문수사리 발원경(외 二경)·문수보살 영험록』 등은 운허 번역 및 편찬임에도 불구하고 역자가 표기되지 않았거나 타인 명의로 출간된 사례들을 밝혀내고, 그 유통 경로를 추적하였다. 특히 반복적인 재출간에도 불구하고 번역자가 누락되어 유통되는 불교계의 출판 관행은 법보시 중심의 전통적 문화와 얽혀 있음을 확인하였다. 본 논문은 이러한 출판문화가 역경의 지속 가능성과 후속 세대의 참여를 저해할 수 있음을 지적하며, 번역 작업의 전문성과 공적 책임성을 확보하기 위한 성찰과 제도적 논의의 필요성도 제기한다.
71호.abstract_en: This study reexamines the extensive writings and translation work of Ven. Unheo, a representative monk of modern Korean Buddhism, and catalogs his 66 publications based on primary sources such as his Desk Diary (Taksang Ilgi), Record of Translation Publications (Yeokgyeong Ganhaeng Illam), and Autobiographical Notes (Jacho Yeonbo). Ven. Unheo’s work transcended simple scripture translation; it was a religious and cultural practice that contributed to the modernization and popularization of Buddhist practice, education, and publishing in Korea after liberation. This study supplements the previously incomplete bibliography by correcting errors and identifying previously unconfirmed publications, such as Jogye Order Essentials (曹溪宗要綱), History of Buddhism (佛敎通史), Gwonbalborisimmun (勸發菩提心文), Chobalsimjagyeongmun (初發心自警文), Cheoro Seon-master’s Word Record (徹悟禪師語錄), Godokjiokchamhoe (孤獨地獄懺悔), and Samsigyenyeombulsa (三時繫念佛事). Furthermore, it uncovered cases in which Ven. Unheo’s translations were either left uncredited or published under another’s name - such as Jabisucham (慈悲水懺), Cheoro Seon-master’s Word Record, Stories of Buddhist Compassion (佛敎의 慈悲(放生)이야기), and Manjusri Vows Sutra (and Two Other Scriptures)․Miraculous Records of Manjusri Bodhisattva (文殊師利 發願經(外二經)․文殊菩薩 靈驗錄) - were published without attribution or under the names of others, and traces their circulation pathways. It was confirmed that the Buddhist publishing practice of distributing works with omitted translator credits, despite repeated reprints, is intertwined with the tradition centered on the dharma offering. This paper points out that such publishing culture can hinder the sustainability of translations and the participation of subsequent generations, and also raises the need for reflection and institutional discussion to ensure the professionalism and public accountability of translation work.

71호.title_kr: 조선 후기 범어사 왕실 원당의 설치 배경과 운영- 1902년 상축 현판을 중심으로 -
71호.title_en: A Study of the Establishment and Operation of Beomeosa’s Royal Monastic Shrine in the Late Joseon Dynasty: Focusing on the 1902 Sangchuk Hyeonpan
71호.abstract_kr: This study focuses on the role of Beomeosa, the head temple of the 14th parish of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism, as a royal monastic shrine during the late Joseon dynasty, and seeks to shed new light on the status and social foundations of modern Beomeosa. Founded by the monk Uisang in the Silla period and reconstructed in the late Joseon dynasty, Beomeosa has often been highlighted in previous scholarship for its Zen practice led by eminent monks, its contribution to the anti-Japanese resistance, and its operation of modern educational institutions. However, the function of Beomeosa as a royal monastic shrine has been largely overlooked, despite its importance in understanding the temple’s place in Korean Buddhist history and the regional history of Busan.This paper examines especially the Sangchuk Hyeonpan of 1902, the calligraphic record Beomeosa Chongseop Banghamnok written by Gyeongheo, and related documentary sources, as well as photographs and architectural drawings from the Japanese colonial period. These materials confirm that the abbot of Beomeosa carried out the duty of protecting the royal shrine, and that Cheontae-gak and Gyemyeong-am were operated as royal votive sites. Furthermore, the enshrinement of royal tablets, rituals of supplication, and connections with members of the royal family reveal Beomeosa’s close relationship with the Joseon court.Ultimately, the replacement of the plaque on Beomeosa’s Jogye Gate from “Royal Votive Temple for the Enshrinement of Imperial Writings” (Eoje Bong-an Chukri Wondang) to “Head Temple of the Seon Tradition” (Seonchal Daebonsan) symbolizes both the loss of national sovereignty and the enactment of the Temple Ordinance, while also reflecting Beomeosa’s efforts to solidify its identity as a Seon temple. This change stands as a significant marker of transformation in modern Korean Buddhism and the regional history of Busan. By highlighting Beomeosa’s role as a royal monastic shrine, this study seeks to broaden the horizon of modern Buddhist historical research and proposes the need for further scholarly inquiry.

71호.title_kr: 현대인들의 불안 해소를 위한 수(受, vedanā)의 치유 가능성 시론(試論)- 고엔카, 마하시 전통의 위빠사나, 바디스캔을 중심으로 -
71호.title_en: An Exploratory Study on the Healing Potential of Vedanā for Alleviating Anxiety in Modern Society:Focusing on Goenka Vipassanā, the Mahāsī Tradition, and Body Scan Meditation
71호.abstract_kr: This study aims to explore the healing potential of vedanā (受, feeling/sensation) as a means to overcome anxiety in modern society. The research defines vedanā as the bodily reactions, sensations, and perceptions arising from the convergence of three factors-sense organ (根, indriya), object (境, viṣaya), and consciousness (識, vijñāna)-in sensory contact (三事和合), and develops the discussion centered on this understanding.To achieve this objective, the study examines the traditional meaning of vedanā and trends in contemporary interpretations, reviews the current state of anxiety disorders in Korea, and explores the relationship between anxiety and vedanā from a neuroscientific perspective to investigate the healing potential of vedanā.The study confirmed the key principle in the neuroscientific mechanism of anxiety that bodily responses precede emotional experiences. Furthermore, observing  bodily sensations at the stage of vedanā was found to prevent the escalation of anxiety and substantially contribute to emotional regulation.Specifically, the study demonstrates that vedanā-based practices rooted in Buddhist teachings-including Goenka Vipassanā, the Mahāsī Tradition, and Body Scan Meditation-can be effectively utilized for psychosomatic healing and anxiety relief in modern society.

71호.title_kr: 불교문화콘텐츠를 활용한 대학생 진로집단독서치료 프로그램 개발 연구
71호.title_en: Integrating Buddhist Cultural Narratives into Career Bibliotherapy: A Group Counseling Program for University Students
71호.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 불교문화콘텐츠에 대한 독서치료적 접근의 제안을 위하여 대학생을 대상으로 진로태도성숙도를 증진시킬 수 있는 집단상담 프로그램을 개발하고, 불교문화콘텐츠를 활용한 진로집단독서치료프로그램이 집단원에게 어떤 의미가 있는지 이해하여 불교문화콘텐츠의 활용 가능성을 알아보는 데 그 목적이 있다. 본 연구는 서울 소재 A 심리상담센터에서 2주간 온·오프라인 게시판을 통해 모집 공고를 실시하고, 자발적으로 참여 의사를 밝힌 대학생 8명을 대상으로 진행되었다. 집단상담은 2024년 5월 18일부터 8월 10일까지 A 심리상담센터에서 주 1회, 1회 90분씩 총 7회기에 걸쳐 운영하였다. 연구 자료의 수집에는 진로태도성숙도 검사, 상담 활동 과정에서의 축어록 및 행동 관찰 기록, 그리고 사후 인터뷰 내용이 활용되었다.본 연구결과는 첫째, 불교 콘텐츠를 활용한 대학생 진로집단독서치료 프로그램에 참여한 집단원의 진로태도 성숙도에서 긍정적인 변화가 나타났다. 둘째, 진로집단독서치료 프로그램에 참여 후, 집단원은 자기 자신을 탐색· 이해·수용하게 되었으며, 자신의 가치관에 따른 실천 행동에 초점을 맞추게 되면서 이전보다 전념 행동을 더욱 적극적으로 하게 되었다. 셋째, 사후 인터뷰와 회기별 기록에서 집단원들은 불교문화콘텐츠가 자연스럽고 흥미로웠으며, 자신에 대한 통찰에 깊은 울림을 주었다고 표현하였다.이러한 연구 결과를 바탕으로, 후속 연구를 위한 제언은 다음과 같다. 첫째, 본 프로그램은 불교문화콘텐츠를 독서치료 자료로 활용하여 집단상담의 형태에 적용한 최초의 연구라는 점에서 큰 의미가 있다. 그러나 본 연구는 소규모 표본과 비교군 부재, 단기 추적 중심의 설계는 결과의 일반화 가능성을 제약하며, 효과의 지속성을 판단하기 어렵다. 이에 후속 연구에서는 진로 행동 변화에 초점을 맞춘 실천 중심 프로그램 구성, 다양한 배경의 참가자에 대한 문화적 반응성 점검, 그리고 사후 모니터링 및 상담 연계 체계 구축 등이 요구된다. 또한, 불교문화콘텐츠 활용에 있어 집단상담의 목표를 효과적으로 달성할 수 있는 다양한 독서치료 자료 구성 방안에 대한 탐색도 필요하다. 둘째, 프로그램의 독서치료 자료로 활용되는 불교문화콘텐츠를 활용한 집단프로그램 진행의 프로토콜을 확립하여 효과의 일관성을 확립하는 것이 필요하다. 셋째, 후속 연구에서는 다양한 불교문화콘텐츠를 활용하여 진로뿐 아니라 다른 목표를 가진 집단 프로그램에 적용하고 그 결과를 비교, 분석하는 연구가 필요할 것이다.
71호.abstract_en: This study proposes a bibliotherapeutic approach to Buddhist cultural content by developing and implementing a group counseling program designed to enhance career attitude maturity among university students. The intervention sought to examine both the psychological efficacy and the experiential significance of Buddhist narratives when used as therapeutic texts. A purposive sample of eight university students was recruited via online and offline announcements posted at a psychological counseling center in Seoul. The program was delivered across seven weekly sessions, each lasting 90 minutes, between May and August 2024.Data collection involved a mixed-method design incorporating a standardized Career Attitude Maturity Inventory, verbatim transcripts and observational field notes from the sessions, and post-program semi-structured interviews. Quantitative results indicated a marked improvement in key dimensions such as decisiveness, sense of purpose, and confidence. Qualitatively, participants reported enhanced self-awareness, greater value clarification, and increased commitment to action. Buddhist cultural content was experienced as emotionally resonant, intellectually engaging, and surprisingly accessible, facilitating meaningful introspection and narrative reorganization.These findings suggest that Buddhist narratives may serve as a culturally grounded yet non-dogmatic medium for fostering psychological insight in young adults navigating career-related uncertainty. Nevertheless, the limited gains in readiness and behavioral implementation underscore the necessity of integrating action-oriented components. The study is further constrained by its small sample size, absence of a control group, and short-term scope, limiting generalizability.Future research should aim to (a) incorporate behavioral and skills-based modules to bridge the intention–action gap, (b) evaluate the protocol across diverse populations with culturally sensitive adaptations, (c) establish a standardized manual to ensure fidelity and replicability, and (d) explore the use of Buddhist cultural content in addressing broader psychosocial goals beyond career development. This study represents an initial yet meaningful step toward the systematic integration of contemplative cultural resources into evidence-based counseling frameworks.

71호.title_kr: 고다 로한 『물 위의 넝마주의(ウッチャリ拾い)』에 나타난 법화경적 사유 연구- ｢수희공덕품｣을 중심으로 -
71호.title_en: A Study on the Lotus Sutra Thought in Kōda Rohan’s Ucchari Hiroi: Focusing on the “Benefits of Responding with Joy” (Suihigōtokubon)
71호.abstract_kr: This study provides an in-depth analysis of the Buddhist thought reflected in Ucchari Hiroi, a short story by Kōda Rohan (1867–1947), from the perspective of Chapter 18, “The Benefits of Responding with Joy” (Sui-ki Kudoku-hon, 隨喜功徳品), of the Lotus Sutra (Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Sūtra). The story takes as its theme the labor of a ragpicker—socially regarded as the most humble of occupations—yet transforms it into an exploration of spiritual value that transcends the material world. This paper argues that the ragpicker’s act of “picking up” discarded objects structurally corresponds to the principle of the “fifty successive transmissions of merit” (gojū ten-ten no kudoku) presented in the Lotus Sutra. Through the seemingly mundane act of salvaging waste, Rohan embodies a Buddhist mechanism in which merit is preserved and transmitted, thereby offering a spiritual response to the material excess and existential nihilism of modern society. In particular, the role of the narrator, who witnesses and praises the ragpicker’s work, corresponds to that of the “joyful respondent” (sui-ki santansha), illustrating how the chain of merit extends beyond the actor to the observer and, ultimately, to the reader. This reading reexamines the Buddhist depth of Rohan’s literature and demonstrates how Ucchari Hiroi conveys a universal message that remains relevant to modern.

70호.title_kr: 길장·원효·지의의 사구논법과 제법실상 해석 비교 연구
70호.title_en: A Comparative Study of Jizang, Wonhyo, and Zhiyi on the Fourfold Dialectic and the Interpretation of the True Aspect of All Dharmas
70호.abstract_kr: This study compares and analyzes the Fourfold Dialectic (四句論法) of Jizang, Wonhyo, and Zhiyi, who played pivotal roles in shaping the East Asian Buddhist understanding of the “true aspect of all dharmas” (諸法實相). Unlike Nāgārjuna’s primarily negative employment of the tetralemma, East Asian thinkers transformed it into an active hermeneutical method for grasping ultimate reality. In this context, the present paper examines Jizang’s logic of mutual dependence (相依相關) and his interpretation of the Middle Way as “neither existence nor nonexistence” (非有非無), Wonhyo’s hwajaeng (和諍)-oriented affirmation of the tetralemma, and Zhiyi’s analytical approach to the Fourfold Dialectic, thereby highlighting the originality of their respective interpretations.Jizang, through his logic of mutual dependence, directed attention to the ultimate Middle Way of “forgetting words and silencing thought” (言忘慮絶). Wonhyo, by affirming all four alternatives of the tetralemma, constructed an open framework of reconciliation that dissolves oppositions. Zhiyi, by treating discriminations of the four alternatives as indispensable to practice, developed a systematic methodology for liberation and the realization of the “perfect teaching’s true aspect” (圓敎實相). While each thinker inherited the Madhyamaka tradition, they creatively reinterpreted the tetralemma within the socio-cultural contexts of sixth- and seventh-century East Asia. Such hermeneutical transformations exemplify the distinctive developments of the East Asian Buddhist philosophical “golden age.”

70호.title_kr: 원효 화쟁(和諍)의 원천(源泉) 탐구(Ⅰ)- ‘판단조건’의 원천을 중심으로 -
70호.title_en: The Exploration for the Original Sources of Wonhyo's Theory of Harmonization (Ⅰ): Focused on the Original Sources of ‘Condition for Judgment’
70호.abstract_kr: This paper explores the original sources of the so-called ‘Condition for Judgment’ that appears in Type 1 among the cases in Wonhyo's theory of Harmonization. The main object of inquiry was the ‘Twofold Truth as a Teaching (二諦是敎)’ in Sān-lùn school and the theory of twofold truth in Chéng-shi-lùn school and Middle Way school was also investigated.First, ‘the Condition for Judgment’ was checked. In Type 1 among the cases in Wonhyo's theory of Harmonization, Wonhyo adds conditions such as ‘if you take the word as it is’ and ‘if you take the meaning of the word’ before he makes a judgment that ‘every theory is wrong’ and ‘every theory is right.’ We call the former phrases ‘the Condition for Judgment.’ Second, the teaching of ‘Twofold Truth as a Teaching’ in Chinese Sān-lùn school was explored. This teaching in the school means that the Buddha said the twofold truth in language to convey the middle way. Jí-zàng (吉藏, 549-623) used ‘the metaphor of finger and moon’ to explain the teaching easily, and Wonhyo also used the metaphor in the theory of Harmonization.And third, we also looked at the theory of twofold truth in 2 more schools. The theory in Chéng-shi-lùn school is theoretically distinguished from the theory in Sān-lùn school, so it could not be viewed as the source of the condition. In addition, since Middle Way school also did not share the same ideas with Sān-lùn school, it could not be judged as the source.

70호.title_kr: 유식 교체론과 수행론의 연속성- 원측의 교체론과 초기 유식 보살도를 중심으로 -
70호.title_en: Continuity Between the Discours on the Nature of Buddha’s Words and the Path of Practice in Yogācāra: Centered on Discours on the Nature of Buddha’s Words as Systematized by Woncheuk and the The Bodhisattva Path of Early Yogācāra
70호.abstract_kr: This study This paper analyzes how the Discours on the nature of Buddha’s words(敎體論) as presented in Woncheuk’s Haesimmilgyŏngso(Commentary on the Saṃdhinirmocana-sūtra) is understood within Yogācāra thought as a practical epistemic structure for the bodhisattva path. Focusing on the second and third of the Five Gateways of Emanation(五門出體)—namely, the Gateway of Resolving Appearances into Consciousness (攝相歸識門) and the Gateway of Following the Real through the Provisional(以假從實門)—this study examines the core framework of the Discours on the nature of Buddha’s words. Drawing on Cheng weishi lun for the second gateway and the Yogācārabhūmiśāstra, specifically the Tattvārtha-paṭala(Chapter on the Meaning of Ultimate Truth), for the third, it elucidates the interrelationship between Yogācāra's theory of language and the theory of self-nature(svabhāva). Through this lens, the non-dual logic is explored in which the existence of conceptually constructed nature (parikalpita-svabhāva) and the existence of inexpressible self-nature (nirabhilāpya- svabhāva) are both negated simultaneously. the Discours on the nature of Buddha’s words unfolds on an epistemological basis wherein conventional truth is constituted as a linguistically constructed order(vyavahāra). This indicates that Yogācāra’s distinctive linguistic world-conception—grounded in meditative experience—provides the operative foundation for the structure of the bodhisattva’s path of practice, as confirmed in the Tattvārtha-paṭala. Accordingly, the linguistic perspective embedded in Woncheuk’s interpretation of the Theory of Teaching-Substance, aimed at explicating the Buddha’s truth, implies a Yogācāra worldview rooted in praxis. This continuity between Woncheuk’s doctrinal model and early Yogācāra practice traditions reveals the enduring link between Chinese Faxiang scholasticism and the soteriological foundations of Indian Yogācāra.
keywords_en: Discours on the Nature of Buddha’s Words

70호.title_en: Fazang’s Huayan Doctrine and the Awakening of Faith in Mahayana
70호.abstract_kr: This paper explores the relationship between Fazang's(法藏, 643-712) Huayan(華嚴) teachings and the Awakening of Faith in Mahayana(大乘起信論), and examines how the Awakening of Faith was understood within Fazang's systems of doctrinal classification. It investigates the meaning of citations of the Awakening of Faith found in early works like the Wujiaozhang(五教章) and later works such as the QixinlunYigi(起信論義記) and the Tanxuanji(探玄記). It clarifies that the Five Doctrinal Classifications(五敎判) and Four Doctrinal Schools(四宗判) have different interests, and there was no change in Fazang's doctrinal classifications between his early and later thought.In the Five Doctrinal Classifications established in the Wujiaozhang, the Awakening of Faith holds the status of the Three Vehicles(三乘), clearly distinguished from the One Vehicle Perfect Teaching(一乘圓敎). While the Awakening of Faith encompasses the Initial Teaching(始敎) and plays a pivotal role in laying the foundation for Fazang's Huayan teachings, it is classified as the Final Teaching(終敎), thus differing in dimension from the One Vehicle Perfect Teaching based on the Huayan Sutra(華嚴經).The QixinlunYigi classifies the Awakening of Faith as the ‘Tathagatagarbha- dependent Arising School(如來藏緣起宗)’ according to the system of the Four Doctrinal Schools. Discussions of True Suchness(眞如) and non-obstruction(無礙) in the QixinlunYigi are based on non-obstruction between principle and phenomenon(理事無礙), which is distant from the non-obstruction between phenomena(事事無礙) dimension presented by the Separate One Vehicle(別教一乘). The Tanxuanji maintains the position of the Wujiaozhang, which places the Awakening of Faith in the category of the Three Vehicle Final Teaching, thereby subordinate to the One Vehicle Perfect Teaching. It is reasonable to view the Five Doctrinal Classifications and the Four Doctrinal Schools as having their own independent meanings within Fazang's doctrinal classification theory. The Four Doctrinal Schools primarily focus on encompassing the Alaya-consciousness(阿賴耶識) of the Yogacara(唯識) tradition through the Tathagatagarbha(如來藏) thought, whereas the Five Doctrinal Classifications seem to be primarily concerned with the non-obstruction between phenomena(事事無礙) discussions of the One Vehicle Perfect Teaching within Huayan teachings.
keywords_en: The Awakening of Faith in Mahayana(大乘起信論)

70호.title_en: The Influence of Southern Chan Buddhism in Tongrun's Direct Commentary on the Vimalakīrti Sūtra
70호.abstract_kr: This study systematically analyzes the reception and application of Southern Chan (南宗禪) Buddhist thought in the Direct Commentary on the Vimalakīrti Sūtra (Weimojing Zhishu, 維摩經直疏) by Yiyu Tongrun (一雨通潤, 1565-1624), an eminent Huayan monk of the late Ming dynasty. In his commentary on the Vimalakīrti Sūtra, Tongrun actively incorporated Southern Chan thought centered on the Sixth Patriarch Huineng(六祖慧能) and Mazu Daoyi(馬祖道一) to reinterpret the scripture's core concepts.The findings reveal that, first, Tongrun employed Huineng’s concepts of inherent purity of self-nature (zixing qingjing, 自性淸淨), the three non-attachments (sanwu, 三無) of no-thought, no-form, and no-abiding, and the emptiness philosophy of “originally not a single thing” (benlai wuyiwu, 本來無一物) as the fundamental framework for interpreting the Vimalakīrti Sūtra. He directly quoted passages from the Zongbao edition of the Platform Sūtra to reinterpret concepts such as mind-only pure land, impermanence, suffering, emptiness, non-self, cessation, and “emptiness of emptiness”(yikongkong, 以空空) from a Southern Chan perspective.Second, through Mazu’s teachings on “the Way requires no cultivation”(dao buyong xiu, 道不用修), “ordinary mind is the Way”(pingchangxin shi dao, 平常心是道), and “this very mind is Buddha”(jixin jifo, 卽心卽佛), Tongrun highlighted the practical significance of the Vimalakīrti Sūtra. By extensively citing dialogues between Nanyue Huairang and Mazu, as well as Mazu’s dharma talks, he interpreted the scripture’s meditation practices and the proper attitude of dharma seekers as the realization of enlightenment in everyday life.Third, Tongrun systematically cited the dharma talks of Mazu’s principal disciples, including Panshan Baoji(槃山寶積), Nanquan Puyuan(南泉普願), and Baizhang Huaihai (百丈懷海), to concretize the non-dual philosophy of the Vimalakīrti Sūtra. He particularly utilized these Chan masters’ insights when interpreting the true meaning of renunciation and the practice of “practicing the non-Way to penetrate the Buddha Way”(feidao xing fodao, 非道行佛道).Tongrun’s hermeneutical methodology represents a paradigmatic example of the unity of Chan and doctrinal teachings (chan jiao yizhi, 禪敎一致) characteristic of Ming dynasty Buddhism, creatively synthesizing doctrinal understanding with Chan experiential realization. This study elucidates the intrinsic relationship between the Vimalakīrti Sūtra and Southern Chan thought, demonstrating how scriptures and Chan thought were harmoniously integrated in Chinese Buddhist history.

70호.title_kr: 『능엄경언해』 한자어의 불교학적 수용 연구*- 음절, 문법, 어휘적 분석을 중심으로 -
70호.title_en: A Study on the Buddhist Academic Acceptance of Sino-Korean Terms in the Nungeomgyeong Eonhae: Focusing on Syllabic, Grammatical, and Lexical Analysis
70호.abstract_kr: This study analyzes the patterns of Sino-Korean vocabulary acceptance in the Nungeomgyeong Eonhae (楞嚴經諺解) from the perspective of East Asian Buddhist cultural exchange, aiming to elucidate the patterns of linguistic adaptation evident in early Joseon Buddhist scripture translation. The Nungeomgyeong Eonhae is recognized as a significant case study, noteworthy not only for its documentation of medieval Korean linguistic phenomena but also as a convergence of creative translation strategies developed within the East Asian Sino-Buddhist cultural sphere for conveying Buddhist concepts. Specifically, the methods of selecting and arranging Sino-Korean vocabulary reflect the philosophical orientation of Joseon Buddhism and its relationship with Chinese Buddhist tradition. This paper conducts a multifaceted examination of the acceptance patterns of Sino-Korean terms in medieval Korean by systematically analyzing the total of 6,208 Sino-Korean words documented in this text. The analysis focuses on three primary aspects: first, the characteristics of syllable distribution, ranging from monosyllabic to 8-syllable words; second, combinatory patterns with various case markers (such as nominative, accusative, and instrumental) and grammatical utilization patterns, including verbalization through the derivative suffix ‘-hota’ (‑다); and third, lexical characteristics centered on specialized Buddhist terminology, encompassing homonyms, synonyms, thesauruses, and loanwords.The findings reveal that, regarding syllable distribution, disyllabic words constituted the highest proportion overall, while a considerable number of 3-4 syllable words and specialized terms of 5 syllables or more—reflecting the specific nature of Buddhist scriptures—were also identified. In terms of grammatical integration, it was observed that Sino-Korean words combined naturally with the entire case marker system of medieval Korean, with the active phenomenon of lexical category conversion, particularly through the ‘-hota’ (‑다) verbalization pattern, being confirmed. Regarding lexical characteristics, specialized Buddhist terminology was prominently manifested through homonyms and loanwords.

70호.title_kr: 중국 고중세 불교와 도교의 관계 재고- 단선적 영향론을 넘어 다층적 상호작용으로 -
70호.title_en: Rethinking Buddhist–Daoist Relations Across Early and Medieval China: From Unidirectional Influence to Multilayered Interactions
70호.abstract_kr: This study reexamines the relationship between Buddhism and Daoism across the early and medieval periods of Chinese history by moving beyond the conventional framework of unilateral influence. It instead proposes a multilayered perspective grounded in the historical dynamics of coexistence, conflict, and competition. Previous Western scholarship has been largely shaped by Erik Zürcher’s Buddhist-centered influence theory and Stephen R. Bokenkamp’s model of Daoist subjectivity. However, these approaches often interpret the interaction in a linear fashion—from Buddhism to Daoism or vice versa—thus overlooking the complexity and reciprocity inherent in the relationship.In response, this paper offers a diachronic analysis of Buddhist–Daoist relations, tracing the trajectory from the syncretic coexistence of the Han dynasty, through the legitimacy debates of the Eastern Jin and Northern–Southern Dynasties, to the institutional competition—particularly through scripture appropriation and the production of apocrypha—during the late Six Dynasties, Tang, and Five Dynasties periods. Rather than focusing exclusively on doctrinal discourse, the study examines concrete instances of interaction as manifested in ritual practices, meditation techniques, visual culture, and textual production.By doing so, the paper articulates an analytical framework that enables a more contextualized and multidimensional understanding of Buddhist–Daoist interactions. Furthermore, by critically engaging with Western discourse that has remained relatively underexplored in Korean scholarship, this study seeks to broaden the theoretical horizons of current debates. Ultimately, it contributes to the fields of Chinese religious history and Buddhist Studies by reframing interreligious dynamics not as one-way influences but as historically situated and multilayered processes of negotiation.

70호.title_kr: 쫑카빠(Tsong kha pa)가 제시한 대승불교의핵심 수행과제 - 티벳어본 『세 가지 긴요한 도  (Lam gtso rnam gsum)를 중심으로 -
70호.title_en: Core Practice Task of Mahāyāna Buddhism as Presented by Tsong kha pa: Focusing on the Tibetan Version of Lam gtso rnam gsum
70호.abstract_kr: This study aims to illuminate the core practice task that a practitioner newly entering Mahāyāna Buddhism must master, focusing on Lam gtso rnam gsum presented by Tsong kha pa, the founder of Tibetan Buddhism's dGe lugs pa tradition. At present, the Korean Buddhist community is actively seeking ways to modernize and popularize Buddhism, not only through traditional practices such as Seon meditation, but also by developing diverse forms of meditation such as Seon-based meditation and loving-kindness meditation. Based on this reality, the present study attempts to make a modest contribution. Accordingly, the main body is structured into three sections.First, this text is a concise epistle composed of 14 stanzas that Tsong kha pa sent to his disciple Tsha kho Ngag dbang Grags pa, systematically presenting the core practice tasks of Mahāyāna Buddhism—renunciation, bodhicitta, and the wisdom realizing emptiness. These elements constitute the central axis of the system of practice found in texts such as Byang chub lam rim che ba, and to this day, it is utilized as a principal practice manual in the devotional, oral transmission, and teaching traditions of Tibetan Buddhist monasteries.Second, renunciation is the mind that seeks to be free from the suffering of saṃsāra. Bodhicitta is the altruistic vow to attain liberation for the sake of all sentient beings, serving as both the direction and the driving force of a Mahāyāna practitioner. The wisdom realizing emptiness functions as an antidote that eliminates both afflictive obstructions and obstructions to the knowledge of objects. These three are organically interconnected and constitute the essential framework of the system of practice of Mahāyāna Buddhism.Third, it clarifies the close correlation between the core content of Lam gtso rnam gsum—namely, renunciation, bodhicitta, and the wisdom realizing emptiness—and the practice tasks of the three types of practitioners—the lesser, middling, and superior—presented in Byang chub lam rim che ba. On the basis of this analysis, it demonstrates that Lam gtso rnam gsum constitutes the doctrinal and practical foundation of Lam rim.Accordingly, this study is expected to provide valuable insight into the core practice task and system of practice of the Tibetan Buddhism dGe lugs pa tradition, while also responding to the historical trend of 21st-century Korean Buddhism, which demands diverse practice methods.

70호.title_kr: 『원종문류집해』의 의문(義門)과 『원종문류』 유문(類門)의 상관성 연구
70호.title_en: A Study on the Correlation between the Doctrinal Topics(義門, Uimun) of the Wonjongmunryu-jiphae(圓宗文類集解) and the Thematic Categories(類門, Yumun) of the Wonjongmunryu(圓宗文類)
70호.abstract_kr: This study analyzes the composition and content of the Wonjongmunryu-Jiphae  and examines its intertextual relationship with the Wonjongmunryu text. The Jiphae is a commentary composed in a question-and-answer format, based on key excerpts from the Wonjongmunryu. It elucidates core concepts of Huayan(華嚴) Buddhist doctrine such as Jongyo(宗要, essential meaning), Jongchwi(宗趣, doctrinal aim), gukt’ohae(國土海, ocean of buddha lands), and the relationship between I(理, principle) and Ji(智, wisdom). The commentary integrates and harmonizes the views of the three major Huayan patriarchs—Zhiyan(智儼), Fazang(法藏), and Chengguan(澄觀).Each section of the Jiphae corresponds to specific classifications in the Wonjongmunryu: the “Jongyo ui” is based on the “Sipji Jongyo ryu,” the “Jongchwi ui” on the “Jemun Jongchwi ryu,” and the “Gukt’ohai ui” on the “Jemun Bulto ryu.” These are primarily interpreted through Fazang’s Tamhyeongi(探玄記), along with Zhiyan and Chengguan’s commentarial texts. The “Jongyo ui” section presents nine themes representing the core thought of the Ten Grounds(十地), while the “Jongchwi ui” analyzes doctrinal organization through the dual lens of jong and chwi. The “Gukt’ohae ui” clarifies the relationship between Bulto(佛土) and Gukt’ohai(國土海). Although there is no direct corresponding passage for the “Choehoe Iji ui” in the Wonjongmunryu, it synthesizes the views of Fazang’s Tamhyeongi and Zhiyan’s Suhyeongi(搜玄記) to explain the interrelation of principle and wisdom.The Jiphae thus systematizes doctrinal discussions found in the Wonjongmunryu and serves as a valuable resource for understanding the development of Huayan thought in mid-Goryeo Korea and the intellectual exchanges within the broader Sinitic Buddhist world. Further comparative research focusing on the individual interpretive questions in the Jiphae will deepen our understanding of Goryeo Huayan scholasticism and East Asian Buddhist intellectual history.

70호.title_kr: 여말선초 고려대장경 인출본과해인사대장경판 중복경판 비교 검토
70호.title_en: Comparative Study of the Printed Editions of the Tripitaka Koreana and the Duplicate Woodblocks of the Haeisa Temple(海印寺) Ttripitaka from the Late Goryeo Dynasty to the Early Joseon Dynasty
70호.abstract_kr: From the Late Goryeo to the Early Joseon Period, the printing of the Tripitaka Koreana was carried out as a state-led project, supported by active governmental sponsorship and the use of administrative organizational systems.The leading agents of printing were often the king or ruling elites, who initiated the projects not only to pray for the peace and stability of the state but also for personal religious faith or specific objectives.Due to the unique nature of the Tripitaka being carved on wooden printing blocks, great care is required in its preservation and consultation. Therefore, a systematic investigation and classification of the printed editions are essential. The extant printed editions were produced at various times, and some show differences in content and format depending on the particular woodblocks used. Each edition can be categorized as prints from the original blocks, prints from newly re-carved blocks, or prints from revised and re-carved blocks. In order to trace and compare the original sources of the printing blocks, a meticulous investigation of the Tripitaka Koreana printed editions across different periods is necessary.For a deeper understanding of each block and to recover the woodblock carving techniques, two primary steps must be taken. First, the various printed editions currently preserved at Haeinsa Temple(海印寺)’s storage facilities and museum should be re-examined and classified according to their printing period and book format. Second, the status of Tripitaka Koreana printed editions housed both domestically and abroad, along with their key characteristics, should be systematically and thoroughly surveyed. Haeinsa Temple should strengthen its role as a central institution by building a database of existing information on the Tripitaka Koreana printed editions, including details on block carving, printing, and related research.

70호.title_kr: 발해 승려들의 對 일본 활동 연구
70호.title_en: A Study on the Japanese Mission of Bohai Monks
70호.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 8~10세기에 발해에서 일본을 오가며 활동한 발해불교계가 일본 사회에 끼친 영향에 대해 살펴보기 위한 것이다. 당과 일본을 연결 시킨 교두보로서의 발해의 역할은 충분히 강조할만 하다. 고구려·백제·신라 승려들 가운데 동해를 건너 일본에 불법을 전한 일군의 승려들이 있었다. 7세기 말에 건국된 발해에서도 승려들이 사신단의 일원이나 여러 가지 이유로 일본에 가서 일본불교계에 여러 가지 영향을 주었다.당시 일본은 동아시아에서 문화적으로 낙후된 지역이었기에 여러 분야에서 기량을 갖춘 전법승들은 통치자의 시선을 단번에 사로잡았던 것으로 보인다. 본고에서는 일본불교계와 관련이 있는 발해 승려들의 활동상을 정리하고, 그들이 일본 사회나 불교계에 어떤 영향을 주었는지 살펴보았다. 발해인들은 고구려를 계승하여 698년에 발해를 건국한 후 실크로드의 연장선인 ‘일본도(日本道)’를 개척하여, 총 35차례에 걸쳐 일본에 사신단을 파견하였다. 그 길을 통해 수많은 인적교류와 다양한 문물교류가 있었다. 불교와 한시를 통한 문화교류, 인도에서 서역, 당을 통해 발해에 이르는 실크로드로 전래된 ‘땅설법’과 일본의 ‘에도끼(繪解き)’의 관련성을 밝혀 한국고대 대외문명교류사의 일부를 복원하고자 한다.

70호.title_kr: 불교 의례에서 꽃과 지화(紙花)의 연원과 상징
70호.title_en: The Origin-Symbolic Meaning of Flowers and Paper-Flowers in Buddhist Rituals
70호.abstract_kr: Religious rituals are held in sacred spaces, with sacred offerings and devout participants, and follow a set format and cyclical pattern. Religious rituals are collective acts where all participants experience the sacred, and their symbolism expresses the ultimate goal of the values pursued by the religion. In Hindu and Buddhist rituals, flowers most concisely embody this symbolism, a fact supported by literary sources.This paper first examines the lotus, widely used in Indian culture as a symbol of the flower itself, accompanying all rituals. Its origins stem from a cosmological view rooted in Indian mythology. Specifically, it examines the significant significance attached to the lotus not only in Buddhism but also in Hinduism, Jainism, and Sikhism. Furthermore, it examines the use of various flowers in rituals, not just the lotus. It then explores the symbolic nature of flowers in Hindu mythology and the life of the Buddha. In Hindu tradition, the lotus flower is widely used in astrology, cosmology, and mythology, and holds diverse meanings in various aspects of human life. The god Vishnu is depicted twirling a lotus flower with one hand, representing the universal flow of the universe and creation. In traditional Indian family rituals, flowers are not merely aesthetically valuable; they are also symbols of happiness, prosperity, and fulfillment of life's purpose.In the life of the Buddha, flowers are used in moments of joy and reverence, as well as moments of sorrow and grief. However, in all instances, reverence for the Buddha remains constant, and the ultimate symbol of reverence is the offering of flowers. The ritual of scattering flowers, with its dynamic visuality, reaches its climax. This use of flowers as a form of reverence continued even after the Buddha's death, establishing them as an important element in Buddhist ritual.Korean Buddhist rituals have traditionally employed paper flowers, and the documentary evidence for this practice can be found in various sources. Based on this, this study examines the specific uses of paper flowers in Korean Buddhist rituals, thereby exploring the meaning and role they embody.

70호.title_kr: 일본 지장보살의 여성화와 민속신앙의 문화적 실천
70호.title_en: The Feminization of Jizō Bodhisattva and the Cultural Practices of Japanese Folk Belief
70호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 일본 지장신앙이 내세 구제와 현세 보호라는 이중적 신앙 구조를 지니는 가운데, 특히 현세적 실천과 민속적 상상력을 통해 지장보살이 여성적 보호신으로 변용되는 과정을 문화사적 관점에서 고찰한 것이다. 지장보살은 경전적으로는 지옥 중생을 구제하는 보살과 현세 복리를 실천하는 존재로 설정되었으나, 일본 민간에서는 일상 속 고통과 불안을 돌보는 친근한 존재로 수용되며, 다양한 문화적 실천 속에서 모성적 이미지와 젠더화된 신격으로 형상화되었다.본고는 엔메이지(延命寺)의 나체지장(裸地蔵)과 교토의 승군지장(勝軍地藏)을 통해 대리 고통과 수행성을 분석하고, 덴코지(伝香寺)의 가스카지장(春日地蔵)의 착의법요와 일본 문학 하이쿠(俳句)에 나타난 표현을 통해 여성적 보호자의 형상화 과정을 고찰하였다. 또한 지장분(地蔵盆), 삿갓지장(笠地蔵) 등 민속적 실천을 통해 지장보살이 현세의 안녕과 정서적 위안을 담당하는 신앙 대상으로 작용하는 양상을 살폈다. 본 연구는 도상 분석에 국한하지 않고, 문헌·의례·신앙 행위 등 다양한 문화 요소를 종합적으로 해석함으로써, 일본 지장신앙의 사회적 기능 변화와 젠더적 재구성을 규명하는 데 그 의의를 둔다.

70호.title_kr: 다중장르와 AI시대 창작찬불가 고찰- 1920년대부터 2025년까지 사회·문화적 배경을 통하여 -
70호.title_en: A study on Creative Buddhist Chants in the Era of Multi-Genre and AI-Driven Creation: Through the Social and Cultural Background from the 1920s to the 2025
70호.abstract_kr: These days, Buddhist monks are creating music using AI as part of their propagation efforts. However, in the 1920s, since the monks did not know how to compose music, they carried out Buddhist enlightenment movements by setting Buddhist lyrics to the melodies of military songs and Japanese pop songs popular at the time. Modern composed Buddhist hymns of Korea originated with monks who were studying abroad in Japan. Their composition of Buddhist hymns was influenced by Japan’s religious policies, which actively embraced modernization and Westernization, as well as by the Western-style Buddhist hymn movement.The phenomenon of simply changing lyrics to existing melodies—commonly known as “Nogaba”—has occurred throughout music history worldwide. In Korean music history, for instance, Goryeo-era folk songs were given lyrics praising the Joseon royal family, eventually evolving into today’s Jongmyo Jeryeak. Similarly, this practice can be seen in Japanese Buddhist hymns and Christian hymns as well.When Venerable Jeongmuk published a collection of Buddhist hymns in 1948, he removed Venerable Johakyu’s piece “The feeling under a Jambuna tree” which had set Buddhist lyrics to a Japanese popular song. This decision was made immediately after Korea’s liberation, at a time when anti-Japanese sentiment was at its peak. However, with the rise of Korean culture (K-culture) on the global stage today, we have gained greater composure and can now view this matter with more generosity. Looking back into history, Japanese Buddhism began with Baekje, and the Buddhism of Goguryeo and Unified Silla formed the roots of their Buddhist culture. In light of this long history, setting Korean Buddhist lyrics to Japanese popular songs was merely a temporary transitional phase.In the 21st century, various music genres, including popular music, coexist. In Korea, a richly diverse landscape of Buddhist music is unfolding, encompassing not only monks chanting in hip-hop style but also celebrities singing songs like "Buddha Handsome. In the upcoming AI era, music listeners will become creators themselves. In the global era brought about by the advancement of digital information and technology, it is necessary to have a balanced sense of identity and uniqueness of Korean Buddhist music, along with its timeliness and universality that can resonate with people worldwide. “To achieve this, it is necessary to maintain a broad perspective while highlighting the distinctive features of each genre in detail, and furthermore, to shift awareness toward a new paradigm in content protection and international copyright.”

70호.title_kr: R. Barthes의 『사랑의 단상(Fragments d’un discours amoureux, 1977)』에 내재하는 불교적 색채 탐구
70호.title_en: An Exploration of the Buddhist Undertones in R. Barthes’s A Lover’s Discourse (Fragments d’un discours amoureux, 1977)
70호.abstract_kr: This study is conducted as a literature-based analysis focusing on the interpretation of Barthes’s A Lover’s Discourse. To this end, it first examines the principles and methods Barthes applied in the writing of A Lover’s Discourse. It then organizes and classifies the literary sources referenced in the text, selecting those that appear to be related to Buddhism. Finally, based on the selected Buddhist-related materials, the study interprets the textual characteristics of Barthes’s work in terms of both content and structure.Through this process, it is revealed that Barthes’s text exhibits structural similarities with the logic of sokuhi (即非), and that concepts such as Nietzsche’s eternal return and nirvana, mentioned in the text, lead to the Buddhist ideas of anātman (non-self) and śūnyatā (emptiness), offering alternatives to overcome the closed nature of the lover’s discourse. Furthermore, connections and similarities with Buddhism are also found in Barthes’s references to Nietzsche, psychoanalysis, and mysticism, indicating that these influences contribute to the Buddhist tone of the text.This study reaffirms that while Barthes’s A Lover’s Discourse outwardly depicts the discourse of lovers, it ultimately presents a discourse of love that opens the path for individuals to transcend the closed structure of romantic relationships and be reborn as subjects of their own love and life.

70호.title_kr: 佛敎 관점에서 본 은희경 소설 『새의 선물』- ‘바라보는 나’와 ‘보여지는 나’를 중심으로 -
70호.title_en: Eun Hee-kyung`s Novel “The Gift of Birds” from a Buddhist Perspecyive: Focusing on the ‘Observing Self’ and the ‘Observed Self’
70호.abstract_kr: This study aims analyze the protagonist Jin-hee`s divided self “The visible self” and “The observing self” in Eun Hee-kyungˊs novel A Gigt from a Bird from a Buddhist perspective, while exploring the confusion of self-identity in modern individuals and the potential for healing. Based on the Thirty Verses on Consciousness-Only, Jin-heeˊs self-division can be interpreted as the discriminative functions of the sixth consciousness(mano-vijñāna) and the seventh consciousness(manas). This structure parallels the Buddhist meditative practices of mindfulness(sati) and Insight(vipassanā). The symbolic “gift from a bird” presented at the end of the novel represents liberation from attachment to the self, corresponding to the Buddhist notions of non-self (anātman) and the wisdom of non-dependence. This study particularly emphasizes that A Gift from a bird was composes within a framework Buddhist thought, thereby illuminating the intersection between literary inquiry and Buddhist practice. While literature highlights the multiplicity and complexity of the self through self-reflection and the search for healing, Buddhist practice fundamentally aims to dismantle attachment to the self in pursuit of liberation from suffering. Jin-heeˊs self-observation and reflective distancing do not culminate in the Buddhist experience of non-self. Nevertheless, her exploration of the self can be understood from the perspective of dependent origination, and her receptive and observational stance toward reality resonates with mindfulness-based approaches to psychological healing. In this regard, the significance of this study lies in applying the Yogācāra model of consciousness and Buddhist meditation theory to Eun Hee-kyungˊs literature, thereby elucidating the meaning of Buddhist self-formation and healing. Furthermore, it suggests the possibility of addressing modern experiences of self-division and Identity crisis through Buddhist perspectives.

69호.title_kr: 오대산 오대결사(五臺結社)의 기원과 호국적 가치
69호.title_en: The Origins of the Odaesan Odae Gyeolsa(五臺結社) and Its  Significance in National Defense
69호.abstract_kr: 본 고는 한국불교사에 기록되어 있는 최초 결사인 오대산 결사에 대한 내용을 검토한 것이다. 오대산의 결사는 신라 하대 보천과 효명이라는 두 왕자에 의해 시작되는 것으로, 이는 일연과 민지閔漬의 오대산 관련 불교문헌들에 기록되어 있다.보천과 효명은 경주의 왕위 계승 과정에서, 소요騷擾로 인해 오대산에 은거한다. 이후 수행 과정에서 진여원眞如院에서 발생하는 문수보살의 이적異蹟을 경험하고, 오대산의 다섯 봉우리에서는 대승불교의 다양한 불·보살들이 출현하는 이적을 경험한다. 이 중 다섯 봉우리에서 불·보살이 나타나는 이적을 바탕으로 국가의 번영과 발전을 위한 오대결사 구조를 완성하게 된다. 이는 진호국가鎭護國家의 호국불교적인 결사로 한국불교 최초의 결사가 띠는 성격을 바로 알게 해준다.또 두 왕자의 기록을 엄밀하게 살펴보면, ‘효명-진여원’과 ‘보천-오대신앙’으로 나뉘고 있다는 점도 분명히 했다. 이러한 구분을 통해, 오대결사의 정립자가 효명보다는 보천이라는 점을 분명히 할 수 있게 된다. 즉 대승불교 신앙의 융합과 호국불교적인 결사의 특징 및 이의 시작자로서 보천의 가능성이 보다 분명하게 정리된 것이다.
69호.abstract_en: This study examines the Odaesan Gyeolsa, the first Buddhist religious association recorded in Korean Buddhist history. The Odaesan Gyeolsa was initiated by two royal princes, Bocheon(普天) and Hyomyeong(孝明), during the late Silla period. Their involvement is documented in Buddhist texts related to Odaesan, written by Il-yeon(一然) and Min Ji(閔漬).Bocheon and Hyomyeong sought refuge in Odaesan due to the political turmoil raised from the royal succession in Gyeongju. During their spiritual practice, they experienced miraculous signs(異蹟) of Mañjuśri bodhi-sattva at Jinyeowon(眞如院). Additionally, on Odaesan’s five peaks, they witnessed various advents of Buddha and Bodhisattva, which led them to establish the Odae Gyeolsa as an organization for national prosperity and development. This organization embodied the principles of Jinho Gukga(鎭護國家), a form of patriotic Buddhism, making it the first recorded Buddhist association in Korea with a strong national defense character.A closer examination of the records of these two princes reveals a distinct division: Hyomyeong is associated with Jinyeowon, while Bocheon is linked to Odaesan faith. This distinction clarifies that Bocheon, rather than Hyomyeong, was the true founder of the Odae Gyeolsa. Consequently, this study reinforces Bocheon’s role as the key figure in integrating Mahayana Buddhist faith with the establishment of a protective Buddhist association in Korea.

69호.title_kr: 미륵 신앙의 한국적 변용 사례 - 화랑의 신앙결사를 중심으로 -
69호.title_en: Korean Adaptations of the Maitreya Faith:Focusing on the Hwarang’s Belief-Association
69호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 신라 화랑도의 미륵 신앙결사를 인도와 중국의 미륵 신앙과 비교하여 그 한국적 변용의 특성을 분석한다. 화랑도는 6세기 신라에서 정치·군사·문화적 중추 역할을 한 청년 조직으로, 불교적 이상과 유교적 실천 윤리를 결합한 독특한 종교적 결사였다. 특히 미륵 신앙은 화랑도의 사상적 기반으로 작용하며, 인도에서 발생한 보살 사상이 중국을 거쳐 한반도에 유입되는 과정에서 현실 참여적 성격으로 재해석되었다.기존 연구는 화랑도를 단순한 엘리트 집단으로 보거나 미륵 신앙과의 관계를 피상적으로 다루었으나, 본 논문은 화랑도를 ‘동아시아 미륵 신앙의 한국적 변용’으로 재조명한다. 인도의 미륵 신앙이 시간적 구원론과 대승보살도로 발전한 반면, 중국에서는 정치적 메시아니즘과 결합했다. 신라에서는 미륵이 화랑으로 화현(化現)한다는 신화적 상상력이 가미되어, 청년 교육·국가 통합·호국적 실천과 연결되었다. 화랑도의 미륵 신앙은 토착 신앙과의 융합을 통해 현세적 목표와 결합했으며, 골품제의 경직성을 완화하는 사회통합의 이념적 도구로 기능했다.문헌 분석과 고고학적 증거를 종합한 결과, 화랑도의 미륵 결사는 인도·중국과 달리 (1) 현실 참여적 성격, (2) 다종교 융합적 문화적 독창성, (3) 청년 리더십 교육과의 결합이라는 특성을 보였다. 이 연구는 동아시아 불교사의 교류사적 관점에서 한국 불교의 로컬 아이덴티티를 규명한다는 점에서 의의가 있다.
69호.abstract_en: This study examines the Korean adaptation of Maitreya faith within the Hwarang organization of Silla Korea (6th century CE), comparing it with Indian and Chinese traditions. The Hwarang, a youth group central to Silla’s political, military, and cultural spheres, uniquely blended Buddhist ideals (Maitreya devotion) with Confucian ethics and indigenous beliefs. While Maitreya faith in India emphasized futuristic salvation and in China merged with political messianism, the Hwarang reinterpreted it as a vehicle for present-world engagement, integrating it into youth leadership training and state ideology.Prior studies often reduced the Hwarang to an elite cadre or superficially addressed its ties to Maitreya. This paper, however, positions them as a Korean transformation of pan-Asian Maitreya cults. Through textual and archaeological analysis, it reveals three distinct features: (1) Practical Engagement: Unlike Indian Maitreya’s transcendental focus or Chinese imperial co-optation, Silla’s Hwarang linked Maitreya worship to national defense (e.g., “Dragon Flower Assembly” for unity) and social mobility, mitigating the rigid Golpum caste system.(2) Syncretic Identity: The Hwarang fused Maitreya devotion with indigenous mountain worship (Sanshin), Confucian ethics (Five Secular Precepts), and Daoist fengliu ideals, creating a localized “cult of youthful bodhisattvas.” (3) Mythopoeic Imagination: Silla narratives depicted Maitreya incarnating as Hwarang leaders (e.g., Mishilang in Samguk Yusa), blending divine authority with human agency.By cross-referencing Samguk Sagi, Samguk Yusa, and East Asian Buddhist texts, this study demonstrates how Silla’s Hwarang redefined Maitreya not as a distant savior but as an immanent force for unification and ethical governance. Their legacy influenced later Korean Buddhist movements, from Goryeo’s Maitreya rebellions to Joseon’s folk religiosity. This research contributes to global Buddhist studies by highlighting local agency in doctrinal adaptation and the socio-political utility of religious networks.

69호.title_kr: 청담대종사의 선사상 연구 - <대한불교>(1960-1980) 수록 법문을 중심으로 -
69호.title_en: The Zen Thoughts of Ven. Cheongdam: Focusing on the Buddhist Newspaper Dharma Talks from 1960-1980
69호.abstract_kr: 근현대 한국 불교사에서 주요한 인물 가운데 청담 순호(靑潭淳浩, 1902- 1971) 대종사(大宗師)는 민족불교운동에 앞장섰던 행동하는 수행자(修行者)였으며 불교정화운동(佛敎淨化運動)의 주역이었다. 청담은 평생 상구보리(上求菩提) 하화중생(下化衆生)을 실천해 온 보살이다. 청담에게 있어서 불교 정화는 단순히 비구승(比丘僧)과 대처승(帶妻僧)간의 싸움이 아니라 국민사상(國民思想) 개조운동(改造運動)이었다.본 논문에서는 이 점에 주목하여 1960년부터 1980년까지 <대한불교(大韓佛敎)>에 게재된 청담의 원고(原稿)이자 법문(法門)이라 할 수 있는 기사(記事)를 조사 및 분석하였다. <대한불교>는 청담에 의해서 정화이념(淨化理念) 홍보를 위한 기관지(機關紙)로 탄생하였지만, 그 이면에는 당시 대중매체(大衆媒體)로서 신문의 특성을 고려한 대중포교(大衆布敎) 및 교화(敎化)에 적합한 매체를 활용한 포교 활동이었다.청담은 인생이란 무엇인가? 라는 화두(話頭)를 시작으로 불탄(佛誕)의 의미와 출가와 재가를 막론하고 헛된 삶을 벗어난 참된 길을 제시하였다. 나아가 청담은 마음 사상을 대중 속으로 끌어냈으며, 수행에 있어서 전제 조건이라 할 수 있는 지계(持戒)를 통한 율(律)의 중요성을 강조하였다. 즉 청정한 계율을 바탕으로 ‘마음자리’를 찾는 수행을 주장하였다. 그리고 참회(懺悔) 정진(精進)을 강조하였다.청담에게 있어서 참회 정신은 내적으로는 나의 본성(本性)인 마음을 찾는 것이고, 외적으로는 참회를 통하여 불교정화운동을 이끄는 길이었다. 또한 청담이 제시한 참된 길은 ‘자기 자신이 우주의 주인공’이란 마음 법문으로 자기 안의 불성(佛性)을 깨우칠 것과, 참회 수행을 통한 불성(佛性)의 개현(開顯)이었다. 이는 한국불교 신행(信行) 결사(結社)의 정신을 잇는 개혁적인 시도이자, 현시대에도 적합한 수행 방법의 제시였다.본 논문에서는 먼저 청담대종사의 사상적 배경을 다루고 <대한불교>에 나타난 청담의 선사상을 대중교화의 측면에서 분석하였다. 청담의 인생관(人生觀)과 수행관(修行觀)에 대한 분석은 청담의 참회 사상과 마음 법문 속에 담긴 선사상(禪思想)을 재조명해보고자 하는 노력의 일환이다.
69호.abstract_en: It is not an exaggeration to say that Master Cheongdam Sunho (1902-1971), who is called one of the most pivotal figures in the history of modern Korean Buddhism, was a practitioner of action who led the national Buddhist movement in dark times and a key figure in the Buddhist purification movement. Cheongdam was also a Bodhisattva who practiced seeking enlightenment from above and saving sentient beings from below throughout his life. For Cheongdam, the purification of Buddhism was not simply a fight between bhikkhu monks and married monks, but a movement to reform the national ideology.This paper focuses on this point and investigates and analyzes articles that can be considered as Cheongdam’s original manuscripts and sermons published in the <Buddhist Newspaper> from 1960 to 1980. <Buddhist Newspaper> was born as an organ for promoting the ideology of purification by Cheongdam, but behind it, it was a missionary activity that utilized a medium suitable for mass evangelization and enlightenment, considering the characteristics of newspapers as a mass media at the time.Cheongdam started with the topic of “What is life?” and presented the meaning of Buddha’s birth and the true path to escape from a vain life regardless of whether one is a monk or a layperson. Furthermore, Cheongdam brought the idea of ​​the mind to the public and emphasized the importance of precepts through keeping precepts, which can be considered a prerequisite for practice. In other words, he advocated practice to find the “place of the mind” based on pure precepts. He also emphasized repentance and diligence.For Cheongdam, the spirit of repentance was internally to find one’s true nature, the mind, and externally to lead the Buddhist purification movement through repentance. In addition, the true path Cheongdam presented was to awaken the Buddha nature within oneself through the mind sermon that “oneself is the master of the universe,” and to realize the Buddha nature through repentance practice. This was a reformative attempt that continued the spirit of the Korean Buddhist faith and practice association, and also a presentation of a practice method suitable for the present age.The analysis of Cheongdam’s outlook on life and practice for popular education as presented in the Buddhist Newspaper, which is discussed in this paper, is part of an effort to reexamine the Zen ideology contained in Cheongdam’s thoughts on repentance and sermons on the mind.

69호.title_kr: 황벽 희운(黃檗 希運)의 삼사(三捨)
69호.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 황벽 희운의 특징적인 선사상으로 『전심법요』에서 언급된 ‘세 가지 버림’, 즉 삼사에 주목하고, 그 사상적 토대와 내용, 의의를 밝히는 데 목적을 둔다. 삼사의 구상에는 삼론종의 삼중이제와 혜능의 36대법, 백장 회해의 삼구가 영향을 주었을 것으로 보인다. 이들은 모두 상대적 개념을 세웠다가 그것을 부정함으로써 분별과 집착을 떠나 중도로 나아가게 하는 방편들이었다. 삼사는 대사·중사·소사를 말하는데, 모든 분별을 버리고 허공과 같은 마음으로 자유롭게 살아가면 대사, 옳은 일을 실천하되 의도와 집착을 버려 바라는 마음이 없으면 중사, 좋은 결과를 바라는 마음으로 선행을 닦다가 가르침을 받고 나서 집착하지 않으려 하면 소사에 해당된다. 이는 황벽 사상의 중추인 무심이 실현되는 과정을 단계적으로 표현한 것이라 할 수 있다. 백장이 제기했던 삼구와 비교하면 삼사는 적용 범위를 수행 경지에 한정하고 있어 보다 간명하며, 최고 단계인 대사의 성취가 목표이므로 대사를 넘어서는 별도의 지향점을 두지 않는 것이 특징이다. 중국 선사상사에서 삼사의 등장은 선종 5가 태동기에 홍주종을 중심으로 나타난 조사선 전통의 계승과 변화를 보여주는 사례로서 의의를 갖는다.
69호.abstract_en: This paper focuses on the “Three Renunciations (三捨),” a distinguishing idea in Huangbo Xiyun (黃檗 希運)’s Chan thought, and aims to examine their philosophical basis, details, and significance. The concepts appear in his analects, Chuanxin Fayao (傳心法要, Essential Teachings on the Transmission of the Mind).It is likely that the Three Renunciations were influenced by the Sanlun School (三論宗)’s “Three Levels of the Two Truths (三重二諦),” Huineng (慧能, 638-713)’s “Thirty-Six Relative Dharmas (三十六對法),” and Baizhang Huaihai (百丈 懷海, 749-814)’s “Three Phrases (三句).” These were the techniques that initially established relative concepts and subsequently negated them, guiding one beyond discrimination and attachment toward the Middle Path (中道).The Three Renunciations refer to “Great Renunciation (大捨),” “Middle Renunciation (中捨),” and “Small Renunciation (小捨).” Great Renunciation is when one lives freely with a mind like empty space, having let go of all discrimination. Middle Renunciation is practicing what is right without clinging to intention or attachment, having no expectation. Small Renunciation is when one engages in good deeds hoping for positive outcomes but, upon receiving proper teachings, begins to let go of attachment. These levels illustrate the gradual process of how “no-mind (無心),” the core concept in Huangbo’s thought, comes to realization. Compared with the Three Phrases proposed by Baizhang, the Three Renunciations are not only more concise, as they are confined to stages of spiritual practice, but also distinct in that they do not set any goal beyond the highest stage, Great Renunciation, whose attainment is regarded as the ultimate aim. In the history of Chinese Chan thought, the emergence of the Three Renunciations holds significance as a case demonstrating the inheritance and change within the tradition of Patriarchal Chan (祖師禪), centered on Hongzhou School (洪州宗), during the early development of the Five Schools of Chan.

69호.title_en: A Study on the Research Trends and Tasks of Zen Buddhism in Kamakura Period in Japan
69호.abstract_kr: 가마쿠라 시대는 나라와 헤이안불교의 학술, 귀족중심 불교에서 벗어나 새로운 불교운동이 일어났다. 그러나 선종은 중국 송나라에서 발전한 선사상을 받아들여 발전한다. 본 논문에서는 이러한 가마쿠라시대 선불교에 대한 연구동향을 알아보고 불교연구가 활발하게 진행될 수 있기 위한 과제를 제시하였다.일본 선불교는 중국에서 전래되어 에이사이를 통해 전해졌다. 이후 중국의 임제종, 조동종, 황벽종의 종풍이 수입되어 에이사이(榮西), 도겐(道元), 은원 융기(隠元隆琦)에 의해 발전하였다.가마쿠라시대 선불교에 대한 연구는 크게 종파와 인물을 중심으로 한 연구와 일본문화에 선종이 끼친 영향을 중심으로 연구되었다. 그 중에서도 역사적인 측면에서 각 종파의 특징과 종조의 사상에 대한 연구가 다수를 차지하고 있다. 시기적으로는 1980년대 까지는 선종의 교학중심, 1990년대 이후부터는 선종이 일본문화에 끼친 영향, 2010년대부터는 문화예술, 과학기술, 다도 등의 다양한 분야와 선의 관계성에 대한 연구가 진행되고 있다.이와 같은 가마쿠라시대 선불교의 연구동향을 바탕으로 불교연구가 활성화될 수 있는 방법으로 연구지역의 확대, 연구대상과 범위의 확장, 사회문제와 불교에 대한 연구, 다양한 분야와의 공동연구를 제시하였다.
69호.abstract_en: During the Kamakura period, new Buddhist movement arise, break away from the Academic Buddhism of Nara Buddhism and Aristocratic Buddhism  of Heian Buddhism. However, Zen Buddhism developed by accepting Zen thought that developed in the Song Dynasty of China.Japanese Zen Buddhism was introduced from China and spread through Eisai(榮西). Afterwards, the styles of the Rinzai Sect(臨濟宗), Soto Sect(曹洞宗), and Obaku Sect(黃檗宗) from China were imported and developed by Eisai(榮西), Dogen(道元), and Gin-en(隱元).Research on Zen Buddhism in the Kamakura period has largely focused on Sects and Individuals, and on the influence of Zen Buddhism on Japanese culture. Among them, there is much research on the Characteristics of each Sects and the Ideology of its founder from a historical perspective.Until the 1980s, the focus was on Zen Buddhism's teachings; since the 1990s, research has been conducted on the influence of Zen Buddhism on Japanese culture; and since the 2010s, research has been conducted on the relationship between Zen and various fields such as culture and art, science and technology, and tea ceremony.Based on the research trends in Zen Buddhism during the Kamakura period, the following were suggested as ways to revitalize Buddhist studies: expanding the research area, expanding the research subjects and scope, research on social issues and Buddhism, and joint research with various fields.

69호.title_kr: ‘좋은 친구와 사귐이 범행의 전부다’라는 번역문에 대한 비판과 깔야나밋따따(kalyāṇamittatā)의의미에 대한 연구
69호.title_en: A Study on the Concept of Kalyāṇamittatā
69호.abstract_kr: ‘훌륭한 친구와 사귐이 청정한 삶의 전부’라는 번역문이 있다. 원문의 출처가 󰡔상윳따니까야󰡕인 이 번역은 ‘좋은 친구가 수행의 전부다’라고 활용되기도 한다. 그러나 이 말은 부처님의 가르침이 아니다. 왜냐하면 청정한 삶이 남에게 달려 있을 리가 없고, 수행은 홀로 외딴곳에서 하라고 하셨기 때문이다. 이 오해는 ‘훌륭한 친구와 사귐’ 또는 ‘좋은 친구’라고 번역된 깔야나밋따따(kalyāṇamittatā)가 지닌 정확한 의미를 파악하지 못한 데서 연유한다.본연구는 니까야와 아비담마에 설명된 깔야나밋따따의 의미를 찾는다. 그것은 ‘훌륭한 사람으로서의 좋은 덕목을 갖춤’ 내지 ‘훌륭한 사람 됨됨이’라는 의미를 지니고 있으며, 여기서 좋은 덕목이란 믿음이 있고, 윤리적이고, 많이 배우고, 관용이 있고, 지혜로움을 말한다. 이 개념은 본격적 수행의 조건으로서 중요한 의의가 있다. 하지만 5부 니까야에 걸쳐서 두루 광범위하게 설해졌음에도 이것은 근현대 불교에선 많이 알려지지 않은 개념이다. 본연구는 니까야의 용례를 함께 파악하면서 이 개념이 지닌 중요한 의의를 분석한다.
69호.abstract_en: There is a translation from Pāli language, which says “Good friends, companions, and associates are the whole of the spiritual life.” This is a Teaching by Buddha which is originally stated in Saṁyuttanikāya. It often refers to Buddhists as “Good friends are the whole of the fulfillment”. However, it does not convey the accurate meaning of what Buddha meant, because Buddhist fulfillment is definitely a personal matter so Buddha let his disciples stay at secluded places for self-training. This improper translation might be caused by the lack of understanding about the word ‘kalyāṇamittatā’ in Pāli original Canon, which is literally translated as ‘good friendship’.This study searches for its originally intended meaning of the word in early Pāli Texts, and finds that it actually represents not just ‘good friendship’ but ‘the virtuousness’ that is to say, the cultivation of desirable virtues for being a sublime personage. Those virtues include faith, morality, learning, tolerance and wisdom. The concept of ‘kalyāṇamittatā’ is as important as the basis of the full scale practice for the Buddhist attainment, but its importance has been lost in modern Buddhism. This study analyses the usages of this word in Pāli Nikāyas and tries to reveal the importance of its concept, and corrects the current translation.

69호.title_kr: Kamalaśīla의 『명상수행의 점진적 단계』 (Bhāvanākrama) 첫 번째 편의 전승과 변용
69호.title_en: Textual Transmission and Transformation of First Bhāvanākrama
69호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 유가행중관학파의 대표적 학승 Kamalaśīla가 저술한 『명상수행의 점진적 단계』(Bhāvanākrama) 첫 번째 편(이하 BhKⅠ)의 문헌 전승 과정에서 발생한 텍스트 변용 현상을 체계적으로 해부한 비교문헌학적 연구이다. 본 연구는 BhKⅠ의 산스크리트어 비판교정본, 돈황 출토 티벳어 필사본(IOL Tib J 648과 PT 825), 『북경판』을 비롯한 후대 목판인쇄본 티벳대장경, 그리고 한문 번역본에 이르는 다층적 문헌 자료를 통시적으로 비교 검토함으로써 네 가지 핵심적 변용 양상을 규명한다.첫째, BhKⅠ텍스트 제목의 의미론적 축약 과정을 문헌학적으로 추적한다. 산스크리트어 원전의 완전한 제목인 ‘보살[이 함양해야 할] 명상수행의 점진적 단계’(Bodhisattvabhāvanākrama, *Byang chub sems dpa'i bsgom pa'i rim pa)가 티벳어 번역 전승에서 ‘Bhāvanākrama(bsGom pa'i rim pa)’로 간소화되는 과정과 그 문헌학적 함의를 해명한다.둘째, BhKⅠ에 인용된 불교 경전 구문의 불일치 현상을 다각도로 조명한다. 돈황 출토 티벳어 필사본, 施護(Dānapāla)의 한문 번역본, 그리고 후대 목판인쇄본 티벳대장경에 수록된 경전 인용구가 산스크리트어 비판교정본과 보이는 상이성의 전형적 사례를 제시하며, 이러한 차이가 함의하는 바를 탐구한다.셋째, 산스크리트어, 티벳어, 한문 전승 간 게송(偈頌) 인용 구절의 불일치 양상을 비교 분석한다.넷째, 가장 주목할 만한 발견으로서 연민명상(karuṇābhāvanā) 개념의 철학적 전환을 추적한다. 초기 전승에서 “자기 자신과 중생의 평등”에 중점을 둔 실천적 명상수행법이 후대 전승에서 “마음의 평등”이라는 보다 내적이고 심리적인 개념으로 진화하는 과정을 교리사적 관점에서 정밀하게 분석한다.본 연구는 단순한 언어학적 또는 판본학적 비교를 넘어서, 불교 명상수행 매뉴얼이 인도에서 티벳과 동아시아로 전파되는 과정에서 겪은 문화적 재맥락화와 교리적 재해석의 양상을 ‘텍스트와 트랜스-텍스트’ 방법론을 통해 조명한다. 이를 통해 불교 문헌의 역동적 전승 과정과 그 문화적 적응 매커니즘에 대한 새로운 이해를 제공한다.
69호.abstract_en: This study conducts a systematic comparative philological investigation into the textual transformations that emerged during the transmission history of the first chapter of the Bhāvanākrama(BhK I), composed by Kamalaśīla, a preeminent scholar of the Yogācāra-madhyamaka tradition. Through rigorous diachronic analysis of stratified manuscript evidence—encompassing Sanskrit critical editions, Dunhuang Tibetan manuscripts (IOL Tib J 648 and PT 825), subsequent xylographic recensions of the Tibetan canon including the Peking edition, and Chinese renditions—this investigation delineates four distinctive taxonomies of textual metamorphosis.First, the research meticulously reconstructs the semantic compression trajectory of the BhK I title through precision philological methodology. It elucidates the evolutionary process whereby the comprehensive Sanskrit designation “The Progressive Stages of Meditation [to be Cultivated by] Bodhisattvas” (Bodhisattvabhāvanākra- ma, Byang chub sems dpa'i bsgom pa'i rim pa) underwent systematic abbreviation to “Bhāvanākrama (bsGom pa'i rim pa)” within Tibetan transmission lineages, while examining the broader philological ramifications of this titular transformation.Second, the study provides multifaceted analysis of textual discrepancies in scriptural citations embedded within BhK I. It presents paradigmatic instances where canonical quotations preserved in Dunhuang Tibetan manuscripts, Dānapāla's (Shīhù 施護) Chinese translation, and later xylographic Tibetan canonical collections exhibit substantive divergences from extant Sanskrit critical editions, thereby interrogating the hermeneutical significance of such textual variations.Third, the research undertakes comparative examination of incongruities in versified (gāthā) citations across Sanskrit, Tibetan, and Chinese transmission traditions, investigating how prosodic adaptation strategies and semantic transfer mechanisms reflect distinctive translational paradigms within respective cultural matrices.Fourth, constituting the study's most significant contribution, the investigation traces the philosophical reconfiguration of compassion meditation(karuṇābhāvanā) conceptualization. It provides meticulous doctrinal-historical analysis demonstrating how praxis-oriented meditative techniques emphasizing “equality between self and sentient beings” in earlier transmissions underwent systematic transformation into the more psychologically internalized notion of “mental equanimity” in subsequent traditions.Transcending conventional linguistic or codicological comparison, this study deploys an innovative “text and trans-text” methodological framework to illuminate the sophisticated dynamics of cultural recontextualization and doctrinal reinterpretation characterizing Buddhist meditation literature as it traversed from the Indian subcontinent to Tibetan and East Asian civilizations. This approach yields unprecedented insights into the dynamic transmission mechanisms of Buddhist textuality and their adaptive cultural strategies, demonstrating that manuscript transmission constitutes not mere mechanical reproduction but rather a continuous process of creative hermeneutical reconstruction informed by the distinctive religious sensibilities and philosophical horizons endemic to each cultural milieu.
keywords_en: Transmission and Transformation of the First Bhāvanākrama

69호.title_kr: 불교 경전의 공간인식과 종교지리학적 원형- 보리수와 4대 성지를 중심으로 -
69호.title_en: Spatial Cognition in Buddhist Scriptures and the Religious-Geographical Prototype: Focusing on the Bodhi Tree and the Four Sacred Sites
69호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 불교 경전에 나타난 보리수와 4대 성지의 공간 서사를 종교지리학적 관점에서 분석하여 불교 공간 인식의 원형(prototype)과 구조적 특성을 규명한다. 기존 종교지리학의 초월 중심적 성스러운 공간 이론, 특히 엘리아데의 히에로파니(hierophany) 개념을 비판적으로 검토하고, 불교의 공간 성화가 수행자와 공동체의 반복적 실천 및 윤리적 관계망을 통해 형성되는 ‘수행 중심적 성화(practice-centered hierophany)’임을 밝혔다. 경전 속 보리수와 4대 성지는 단순한 역사적 기념비가 아니라, 명상, 예경, 순례 등 다양한 실천을 통해 지속적으로 의미가 갱신되는 역동적 공간으로 기능한다. 불교 공간 인식은 고정된 우주적 중심축이나 신적 현현에 의존하지 않고, 수행과 윤리적 실천, 공동체적 전승을 통해 성스러움이 재구성된다는 점에서 독자적 특성을 지닌다. 본 연구는 종교지리학의 기존 이론을 보완하고, 성스러운 공간의 동적·관계적 구조에 대한 새로운 해석을 제시한다. 또한, 불교 공간 인식의 현대적 적용 가능성, 다양한 종교 전통과의 비교 연구, 그리고 학제적 대화의 확장 가능성을 모색하여 학술적 의의를 지닌다.
69호.abstract_en: This study analyzes the spatial narratives of the Bodhi tree and the Four Sacred Sites (Lumbini, Bodh Gaya, Sarnath, and Kushinagara) found in Buddhist scriptures from a religious-geographical perspective, aiming to clarify the prototypes and structural characteristics of Buddhist spatial cognition. It critically examines the transcendence-centered theory of sacred space in traditional religious geography—particularly Mircea Eliade’s concept of hierophany—and reveals that the sacralization of space in Buddhism occurs through the repetitive practices and ethical networks of practitioners and communities, forming what may be called a practice-centered hierophany. The Bodhi tree and the Four Sacred Sites, as depicted in the scriptures, are not merely historical monuments, but dynamic spaces whose meanings are continually renewed through various religious practices such as meditation, veneration, and pilgrimage. Notably, Buddhist spatial cognition does not rest on fixed symbols such as cosmic axes or divine manifestations. Instead, sacredness is reconstituted through lived practices, moral discipline, and communal transmission, indicating a distinctively Buddhist model of spatial sacrality. This analysis supplements existing theories in religious geography and offers a new interpretation of sacred space as dynamic and relational. Furthermore, it holds academic significance in exploring the contemporary applicability of Buddhist spatial understanding, its potential for comparative studies across religious traditions, and the possibilities for interdisciplinary dialogue.

69호.title_kr: 수(受)와 유식의 심소법(心所法)을 중심으로 본 불교심리학의 정서 연구
69호.title_en: A Study on Emotion in Buddhist Psychology: Focusing on Vedanā and the Caitasikas of Yogācāra
69호.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 수(受)와 유식의 심소법을 중심으로 불교심리학의 정서 영역을 논한다. 먼저 수(受)는 ‘느낌(feening)’으로, 정서 반응의 구성요소이자 동시에 다양한 개별 감정으로의 분화를 가능하게 하는 토대이다. 수(受)는 초기경전에서 탐·진·치의 잠재성향으로 서술된다. 그러나 모든 수(受)가 탐·진·치를 발생시키는 것은 아니다. 불교는 모든 느낌을 부정하는 것이 아니다. 자극에 의해 발생된 느낌의 무상함을 알고 이에 집착하지 않는다면 무탐, 무진, 무치로 이어질 수 있음을 말한다. 유식의 심소법 중에서 정서와 관련하는 심소법은 변행심소, 선심소, 번뇌심소, 수번뇌심소이다. 이중 변행심소는 감정을 비롯한 심리작용의 발생과정을 보여준다. 선심소와 번뇌·수번뇌심소는 ‘탐-무탐’, ‘진-무진’, ‘치-무치’가 구조적 중심을 이룬다. 이들을 근본으로 하여 다양한 인지·의지 작용을 비롯한 감정 작용들로 다양화된다. 이들을 기능적으로 분류하면, 선심소는 바른 삶을 사는 데 도움을 주는 적응적 정서이며, 번뇌·수번뇌심소는 그렇지 못한 부적응적 정서로 정의할 수 있다. 불교심리학에서 정서 개념의 중심에는 번뇌가 아닌 ‘선심소(善心所)’가 있다. 정서는 수(受)와 관련 심소들과의 유기적인 연결을 통해 발생하며, 이 과정에서 부적응 감정의 발생에 적극적으로 대처할 수 있는 가능성을 보여주는 것이 선심소이다.
69호.abstract_en: This study explores the domain of emotion in Buddhist psychology, focusing on vedanā (受, feeling) and the caitasikas (mental factors) of Yogācāra (Vijñānavāda). Vedanā refers to “feeling” and serves as both a constituent of emotional responses and the foundation that enables differentiation into specific emotions. In early Buddhist scriptures, vedanā is described as a potential ground for the latent tendencies (anusaya) of greed (rāga), hatred (dveṣa), and delusion (moha). However, not all feelings necessarily lead to these afflictive states. Buddhism does not advocate the denial of all feelings; rather, it emphasizes the impermanence of sensations and the possibility of cultivating non-attachment. When one recognizes the transient nature of feelings without clinging, this awareness can lead to non-greed (alobha), non-hatred (adveṣa), and non-delusion (amoha).Among the mental factors (caitasikas) discussed in Yogācāra, those most relevant to emotion include the universal mental factors (sarvatraga-caitasika), wholesome mental factors (kuśala-caitasika), and both primary and secondary unwholesome mental factors (kleśa-caitasika and upakleśa-caitasika). The sarvatraga factors illustrate the general processes of emotional and psychological activity. The kuśala, kleśa, and upakleśa factors are structurally centered on key polarities such as rāga–alobha, dveṣa–adveṣa, and moha–amoha. From these fundamental affective tendencies, diverse cognitive, volitional, and emotional functions emerge. Functionally categorized, kuśala-caitasikas represent adaptive emotions conducive to ethical living, while kleśa and upakleśa caitasikas may be seen as maladaptive emotional patterns.Notably, in Buddhist psychology, the core of emotional understanding is not rooted in kleśa (afflictions), but in kuśala-caitasikas (wholesome mental factors). Emotion arises through the organic interplay between vedanā and related mental factors, and it is through this dynamic that wholesome mental factors reveal the potential to actively address and transform maladaptive emotions.

69호.title_kr: 불교 식생활 규범의 실천과 종교적 신념 분석 - 조계종 신도를 중심으로 -
69호.title_en: Analysis of Buddhist Dietary Norms and Religious Beliefs: Focusing on the Jogye Order Lay Buddhists
